In numerical simulations of up to 64 qubits, channel QGP regression with the Lebesgue kernel exhibits a strong inductive bias for local channels, enabling faithful extrapolation. For global 64-qubit channels, the rescaled kernel restores learnability, with predictions improving systematically with the shot budget. Results from a noisy quantum computer further demonstrate the robustness of QGP regression under experimental conditions. Beyond regression, we validate QGPs as Bayesian-optimization surrogates for state preparation under noisy XXZ dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 论文研究在未知量子演化输出端，仅用有限测量预测给定输入态下 Pauli 可观测量期望值的问题，并将量子高斯过程回归从酉动力学推广到一般量子信道。作者证明在量子信道的均匀先验下，信道输出收敛到量子高斯过程，并推导闭式核函数；但核中的维度因子决定所需观测精度，当子系统随系统规模扩展时会因指数抑制而难以学习。为适应更实际的非均匀先验，作者提出经验贝叶斯启发式方法，用可学习尺度参数替代维度因子，同时保留态重叠相关结构，并在最高 64 量子比特的数值模拟中进行检验。
authors: Jonas Jäger, Yaroslav Khmelnitskiy, Paolo Braccia, Artur Miroszewski, Diego García-Martín, M. Cerezo, Piotr Czarnik

articles.title: Heteroscedastic Neural Surrogate Modeling for Robust and Rapid Bayesian Inference in Fusion Plasma Diagnostics
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Bayesian inference via Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) provides effective parameter estimation, but its real-time application in complex physical systems is hindered by heavy computational bottlenecks and extreme sensitivity to statistical noise. We address this by proposing a neural-network-based probabilistic surrogate framework for rapid and robust MCMC inference. Using fusion plasma Thomson scattering diagnostics as a challenging, noise-dominated testbed, our approach employs a dual-head architecture to simultaneously estimate the expected physical emission spectrum and the channel-wise intrinsic measurement noise variance. By optimizing a Gaussian Negative Log-Likelihood (GNLL) objective, the learned aleatoric uncertainty dynamically buffers the sampler against pathological shot noise. Evaluations demonstrate that this surrogate framework achieves > 1500x acceleration over exact physical forward models, while simultaneously reducing inference error (RMSE) by >20% compared to standard homoscedastic neural baselines, offering a highly promising paradigm for real-time physical analysis.
authors: Liyun Zhang, Naoya Mamada, Kentaro Sakai, Takeo Hoshi, Toru Aonishi

articles.title: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.19880v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM agents learn by interacting with environments, yet these environments are hand-built and static: blind to an agent's weaknesses, and quickly left behind as it improves. While recent environment generation methods attempt to address this, they require domain-specific pipelines, rely on expensive or unreliable verifiers, and still produce static environments. To alleviate the engineering burden of rebuilding environments from scratch, we propose Environment Harness (EnvHarness), a programmable layer of plug-in components that wraps a static environment to reshape its behavior without modifying the underlying logic. Operating through standard interfaces, EnvHarness applies across diverse domains while ensuring every reshaped environment retains its original verifier. To automate this process, we introduce EnvRigger, which treats the target policy as a black box, observing its execution trajectories to synthesize EnvHarness components targeting diagnosed flaws, and validating them via fresh rollouts. Across five benchmarks in four domains, EnvHarness outperforms both original environments and domain-specific environment generation pipelines, achieving up to a 9.0-point improvement on held-out instances with 9.8% fewer execution steps. Furthermore, EnvHarness provides a superior optimization signal for reinforcement learning, enabling continuous, targeted co-evolution of the policy and its environment.
authors: Chengsong Huang, Zifeng Wang, Rujun Han, Jun Yan, Yanfei Chen, Zoey CuiZhu, Ke Jiang, Peng Xia, Han Yu, Yufan Zhuang, Yifei Ming, Jiaqi Pan, Bhavana Dalvi Mishra, Jiaxin Huang, Burak Gokturk, Tomas Pfister, Chen-Yu Lee

articles.title: What You Can't See Is What You Learn: Restricted Evidence Visibility Favors Compositional Generalization in Shared-Genome Language-Model Societies
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.20054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Multi-module systems often expose every module to the full input. We test whether restricting evidence visibility changes which solutions gradient-based training discovers. Four-cell societies share one frozen pretrained language model and one low-rank adapter, communicating only through two model-width continuous vectors in a fixed relay. On a prospectively sealed natural-language function-composition task, we train ten matched restricted/global pairs sharing initialization bytes, training order, token layout, parameters, and computation; only the attention mask differs. Restricted societies outperform their globally visible twins by at least 20 points at both depths in 9 of 10 pairs, with median paired advantages of 0.7648 and 0.6050. Cutting communication reduces every restricted society to chance, and the depth-three advantage remains 0.558 on programs whose composite function never appeared in training. Across six audited restricted societies, same-value packet transplants preserve behavior at 0.94-1.00 across all tested interfaces; destructive interventions collapse performance; and counterfactual packets redirect outputs toward the mathematically predicted answer. The sole high-performing global model also requires communication, but its same-value packets are not interchangeable across episodes. Restricted visibility is thus not necessary for composition; under this protocol it substantially increases the probability of a generalizing relay and favors a reusable, value-indexed interface. The complete preregistered battery nevertheless formally fails because restricted-arm median depth-three accuracy is 0.6988, below the 0.70 floor. An earlier qualification cohort likewise yielded 0/10 complete passes: one model met every task-performance gate, but all ten failed ordinary-language preservation, confining the system to explicitly task-gated use.

articles.title: Virtual Sensing to Enable Real-Time Monitoring of Inaccessible Locations & Unmeasurable Parameters
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.00107v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Real-time monitoring of safety-critical interior states is an open problem across energy, environmental and industrial systems where direct instrumentation is infeasible. Approaches based on governing equations, discrete state vectors or fixed sensor locations cannot deliver mesh-independent, field-level reconstruction at arbitrary interior coordinates in real time. Here we introduce neural operator-based virtual sensing, a framework for recovering inaccessible interior fields from sparse boundary measurements, instantiated with MIMONet, a multi-input, multi-output neural operator that fuses heterogeneous inputs and decodes coupled fields through a shared latent representation. Across three engineering-grade evaluations of escalating complexity - confined recirculating flow, pressurized water reactor subchannels and compact power-system heat exchangers - MIMONet attains relative reconstruction error below 5% with sub-millisecond inference, with calibrated uncertainty and noise resilience. We validate the framework on three independent real-world datasets spanning electrochemical energy, atmospheric science and physical oceanography: current-density mapping in a hydrogen fuel cell, wind-speed profiling on meteorological towers, and North Atlantic ocean state from a global reanalysis. MIMONet improves on classical virtual-sensing baselines by 72-84%, including 84% for fuel-cell internal fields recovered from 10% sensor coverage and 83% for hub-height wind speed recovered from lower-level tower sensors. Most notably, it recovers sea-surface height, a field with no direct sensors, from its learned coupling to observed temperature and salinity at 4.1x lower error than the best classical predictor. These results establish operator-based virtual sensing as a practical route to real-time field observability in systems where the states that matter most cannot be measured directly.
authors: Kazuma Kobayashi, Farid Ahmed, Jaewan Park, Subhankar Sarkar, Seid Koric, Souvik Chakraborty, Syed Bahauddin Alam

articles.title: Reducing the Complexity of Matrix Multiplication by Quantum Computing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.05541v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Matrix multiplication is a fundamental operation in compute-intensive tasks and a key component of modern quantum acceleration frameworks. Here we present a quantum matrix multiplication algorithm based on quantum kernels (QKMM), achieving an elementary gate complexity of (O(N²łog₂N)), with amplitude encoding overhead explicitly included and without assuming a QRAM oracle. This scaling is asymptotically lower than that of the best-known classical matrix multiplication algorithm (O(N².³⁷¹³³⁹)). Building upon QKMM, we establish a family of quantum linear algebra operators, including Quantum Vector Inner Product (Vscriptstyle 2V), Quantum Vector-Matrix Multiplication (Vscriptstyle 2M), QKMM (Mscriptstyle 2M), Quantum One-to-Many Matrix Multiplication(Oscriptstyle 2M) and Quantum Sequential Matrix Multiplication (SMM), providing a unified framework from vector operations to parallel and sequential matrix transformations. Through noiseless simulations, realistic noise modelling and experiments on a superconducting quantum processor, we systematically characterize the numerical accuracy, resource requirements and hardware execution limits of this operator framework. Furthermore, we integrate SMM into deep neural-network inference, enabling intermediate features to propagate coherently across layers without repeated measurement and re-encoding. These results establish a pathway from quantum circuit-level algorithm design to end-to-end coherent computation, providing a quantum computing framework for matrix-centric compute-intensive applications.
authors: Jiaqi Yao, Tianjian Huang, Tonghe Zhang, Ding Liu

articles.title: The Value of Finite Observation in Positive-Data Learning of Multiple Context-Free Languages
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.11644v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Positive data can show that two tuple occurrences share a successful sentence context without certifying that they are safely interchangeable. We study finite compositional observations, represented by finite-monoid homomorphisms, as semantic side information for learning bounded-fan-out multiple context-free languages from positive data. For every fixed fan-out bound f and supplied finite observation h, we define observation-guarded tuple substitutability and give a canonical set-driven learner that exactly reconstructs every language in the full semantic slice {Lin f-MCFL:L is (f,h)-tuple-substitutable}. Under a fixed branching cap, hypothesis construction is polynomial. More generally, polynomial exposure of a presentation implies polynomial characteristic data; binary single-spine presentations provide an explicit sufficient condition. We then vary how much observation information is available. A fixed bound on the size of an unknown observation can be compiled into a universal finite refinement, restoring identifiability slicewise, whereas the unbounded latent-observation union is not identifiable. Moreover, universal finite refinements have an unavoidable exponential dependence on the observation bound, and a separate deletion obstruction shows that no family of set-driven identifiers can have characteristic data polynomial jointly in that bound and presentation size. Intrinsic observation size alone therefore does not determine latent-slice data complexity: the quantitative behavior also depends on whether the witnessing semantic slice is supplied or must be resolved inside a larger ambient class.

articles.title: Continuous Behavioral Authentication via Multi-Expert BERT Log Analysis for Secure Data Sharing
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.21900v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Continuous authentication for mobile and zero-trust systems requires nonintrusive evidence confirming the enrolled user-device context remains valid after initial login. This paper presents a BERT log analysis framework for continuous behavioral authentication using Android system logs. The proposed pipeline parses logcat streams into event templates and dynamic variables, pre-trains a domain-adapted BERT encoder on Android log syntax, and fine-tunes three expert models for network/device identity, battery-transition timing, and Wi-Fi topology. The expert confidence scores are fused through a log-space transformation and a 5-nearest-neighbor distance classifier to generate a normality score that is provided to a Policy Decision Point (PDP) for risk-aware access control. Experiments on normal traces, controlled anomaly injections, and benign Wi-Fi perturbations indicate that multi-expert BERT log analysis can detect semantic, battery-timing, and topology deviations in the evaluated setting while maintaining sub-1% False Positive Rate (FPR). The results suggest that Android system logs are a practical sensor-free signal for continuous authentication and user-device context assurance.
authors: Stergios Lantzos, Ilias Syrigos, Apostolos Apostolaras, Thanasis Korakis

articles.title: When Is Shallow Enough? Adaptive Split Federated Learning with Client-Specific Sufficiency Estimation
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.15639v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Split Federated Learning (SFL) enables distributed model training by splitting networks between the server and clients. However, under client heterogeneity, the conventional static split strategy may be suboptimal because clients can differ in data distributions, adaptation dynamics, and representation learning progress, making a single split point insufficient to accommodate client-specific training states. In this paper, we propose textscFedSGA, a Sufficiency-Guided Adaptive split Federated learning framework that addresses this question through client-specific shallow sufficiency estimation. First, we introduce a client-specific adaptation channel based on private prompt tokens, which tracks local adaptation dynamics separately from the shared backbone and provides a lightweight signal for detecting whether client adaptation remains active. To further avoid repeated online probing over multiple candidate depths, we design a shallow sufficiency estimator that combines cross-client semantic alignment, temporal interface stability, and prompt-state variation to estimate whether the shallowest split is already sufficient. Finally, we introduce a split-compatible interface harmonization module that projects activations from different split depths into a shared semantic space, improving the comparability of heterogeneous client interfaces before server-side prediction. Extensive experiments on multiple heterogeneous benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of textscFedSGA in improving model performance compared with state-of-the-art methods while reducing unnecessary client-side computation.
authors: Wenhao Yuan, Chenchen Lin, Wentao Hu, Jian Chen, Jinfeng Xu, Shujie Li, Edith Cheuk Han Ngai

articles.title: SSLfmm: An R Package for Semi-Supervised Learning with Mixed Missingness
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.03322v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Partially labelled samples arise when features are observed for all data, but class labels are available for only a subset. In such settings, the mechanism governing label availability may itself contain information relevant to classification, yet it is typically left unmodelled in standard semi-supervised learning procedures. The SSLfmm package implements likelihood-based Gaussian finite-mixture classification in which the label-missingness process is modelled jointly with the class distribution. It supports complete-case, missing completely at random (MCAR), entropy-based missing at random (MAR), and mixed MCAR/MAR analyses. For the mixed mechanism, the source of a missing label may be observed or latent, allowing the same modelling framework to accommodate different forms of information about label availability. A common R interface is provided for model fitting, prediction, performance assessment, simulation, and entropy-based diagnostics. We describe the statistical formulation and software implementation, position SSLfmm relative to existing finite-mixture and semi-supervised learning software, and demonstrate its use through a reproducible simulation comparing observed- and latent-source analyses. A semi-synthetic application to the Blood Transfusion data further illustrates how alternative assumptions about label missingness can be fitted, compared, and diagnosed in practice.

articles.title: Atomic-Layer-Deposited ZnF2 on Al Enabling in situ NaF/Na–Zn Interphase for Robust Anode-Free Sodium Batteries
articles.abstract: Achieving high-energy-density "anode-free" sodium batteries remains a daunting challenge due to rapid capacity decay caused by poor reversibility and uncontrolled dendritic growth on bare current collectors. To overcome these limitations, we propose a potent interfacial engineering strategy: an aluminum current collector modified with a precisely engineered atomic-layer-deposited ultrathin ZnF2 layer. We demonstrate that the ZnF2 coating undergoes in situ electrochemical transformation during initial sodiation, forming a dense and conformal NaF/Na–Zn interphase. The sodiophilic Na–Zn alloy markedly lowers the nucleation overpotential, promoting highly uniform Na plating across the interface. Working synergistically, the NaF component stabilizes the solid-electrolyte interphase by regulating Na+ flux. Enabled by this dual-functioning framework, the ZnF2-modified aluminum current collector achieves an exceptionally high average Coulombic efficiency of ~ 99.76% under aggressive plating/stripping conditions (0.5 mA cm− 2, 1.0 mAh cm− 2). Furthermore, anode-free full cells pairing this modified current collector with high-mass-loading Na3V2(PO4)3 cathodes (11.6–14.3 mg cm− 2) exhibit significantly improved cycling stability. This work establishes, to the best of our knowledge, the first example of atomic-layer-deposited ZnF2 on aluminum deliberately converted into a NaF/Na–Zn interphase for anode-free sodium batteries, providing a simple and scalable strategy for high-performance sodium-based energy storage systems.

articles.title: Density Functional Theory Guided Mechanistic Study and Predictive Modeling of Pb(II) Adsorption onto Pretreated Chicken Feather Biomass
articles.abstract: Sustainable valorization of poultry waste offers an attractive strategy for mitigating heavy metal contamination in water. This study integrated experimental, computational, and machine learning investigation of Pb2+ adsorption onto ethanol-pretreated chicken feather biomass (PCFB). Batch adsorption was optimized using central composite design, while adsorption mechanisms were elucidated through FTIR, SEM, equilibrium and kinetic modeling, density functional theory, and predictive modeling using response surface methodology (RSM), linear regression (LRM), and artificial neural networks (ANN). FTIR and SEM analyses confirmed the participation of hydroxyl, amino, and sulfur-containing functional groups and pronounced surface morphological changes following Pb2+ adsorption. The Freundlich isotherm provided the best description of adsorption equilibrium (R² = 0.9376), indicating multilayer adsorption on a heterogeneous surface, whereas pseudo second order kinetic (R2 = 0.9999) demonstrated that chemisorption governed the adsorption rate. Regeneration studies showed excellent reusability, with EDTA retaining >77% desorption efficiency after five adsorption-desorption cycles. DFT calculations agree with the experimental observation by exhibiting energetically favorable Pb²⁺ coordination with keratin functional groups through significant charge redistribution and electronic structure modification. Among the predictive models, ANN exhibited superior performance (R² = 0.9473; RMSE = 0.9641), substantially outperforming RSM and LRM, confirming the highly nonlinear nature of the adsorption system. The combined experimental computational framework establishes PCFB as a regenerable, low cost biosorbent and demonstrates that coupling quantum chemical analysis with machine learning provides a robust strategy for the rational design and optimization of sustainable biosorption systems.

articles.title: Internet gaming disorder: dynamic functional connectivity and graph theory
articles.abstract: Background Internet gaming disorder (IGD) is a behavioral addiction whose resting-state brain signature may be expressed in transient connectivity configurations rather than in a scan-wide average.Methods Resting-state fMRI data from 58 participants with IGD and 56 healthy controls were analysed with Dosenbach-160 regional time series, 60-TR sliding windows, and a four-state k-means solution evaluated by geometric-elbow, repeated-initialisation, split-half, and window-length analyses. State-specific AUC graph metrics and temporal metrics were compared with covariate-adjusted models and residual-permutation inference. Linear SVR with leave-one-out cross-validation tested prediction of Internet Addiction Test (IAT) scores within the IGD group, with repeated nested cross-validation as a robustness analysis.Results Under within-state FDR correction, group differences in graph topology were confined to State 4: IGD showed lower clustering, global efficiency, local efficiency, normalised clustering, and small-worldness, together with longer characteristic path length. Local efficiency, normalised clustering, and small-worldness remained significant after correction across all 28 state-by-metric tests. IGD showed lower fractional occupancy and shorter mean dwell time in States 1 and 4 and higher fractional occupancy and longer mean dwell time in State 3 (nine-outcome FDR q < = 0.024); State 2 temporal measures and total transitions did not differ. State-specific graph features predicted IAT scores in State 2 (r = 0.56, q = 0.010, n = 58) and State 4 (r = 0.57, q = 0.015, n = 45); repeated nested cross-validation yielded median r values of 0.54 and 0.58, respectively.Conclusions IGD was characterised by a state-dependent redistribution of temporal occupancy, together with State 4-specific topological disruption. State-resolved graph features also tracked symptom severity in States 2 and 4. These findings support complementary temporal and topological characterisation of dynamic brain-network alterations in IGD, while requiring replication in larger independent samples.

articles.title: Universal pattern revealed in quantum matter
articles.title_zh: 量子物质中揭示的普适模式
articles.abstract: When different materials transition from one phase to another, such as water coming to a boil or a magnet losing its ability to attract metals, something remarkable can happen: They begin to behave identically, following the same mathematical rules. "Physicists call this trait universality—the messy, microscopic details wash out and only a few essential features survive," explains Jason Alicea, William K. Davis Professor of Theoretical Physics. The math underlying these universal traits is commonly described by a theoretical framework called conformal field theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 不同材料在相变过程中会表现出相同的行为规律，例如水沸腾或磁体失去磁性时，微观细节会被“洗掉”，只剩少数关键特征。本文介绍了物理学中的“普适性”概念：复杂系统在临界附近遵循相同的数学规则。其背后的理论框架通常用共形场论来描述。

articles.title: Connecting the power of the stars to geometry
articles.title_zh: 将恒星能量与几何学联系起来
articles.abstract: In the world of fusion energy, scientists and engineers study the fourth state of matter known as plasma in an effort to design and build a new type of power plant. Relying on the heat produced by two small atoms smashing together, a network of such facilities would help create a novel source of stable electricity and help ensure America's energy independence. And while scientists in this endeavor are devoting their attention to complex machinery and temperatures hotter than the surface of the sun, they are also trying to determine the best designs for such a power plant by focusing on geometry.
articles.abstract_zh: 聚变能源研究关注等离子体这一第四态物质，目标是利用轻原子碰撞释放的热量实现稳定发电。除了复杂装置与极端温度，研究者也在从几何设计角度优化聚变电站布局。该文强调了几何形状在提升装置性能与工程可行性中的作用。

articles.title: WTFFN-YOLO: An Improved Lightweight Method for Surface Defect Detection on Wind Turbine Blades
articles.title_zh: WTFFN-YOLO：用于风力涡轮机叶片表面缺陷检测的轻量化改进方法
articles.abstract: As critical components of wind turbines, blade surfaces may develop defects such as cracks and wear, which significantly affect operational stability and service life.Therefore, accurate and efficient defect detection is essential for the maintenance and safe operation of wind turbines.This paper proposes a blade surface defect detection method based on the WTFFN-YOLO framework.First,the C3K2 module is replaced with the C3K2-SACA attention mechanism.Second,the traditional upsampling layer is replaced with a frequency-aware feature fusion module (FreqFusion).Finally,we designed the neck network introduces the WTFFN module to replace the conventional concatenation layer.This design enables more effective multi-scale feature integration,achieving accurate detection while reducing model parameters and computational cost,thereby improving both efficiency and feature representation capability.Experimental results show that the improved model achieves 6.9% increase in mean average precision (mAP), In small-object mAP improvement 8.2%,and 8% reduction in model parameters, satisfying both accuracy and lightweight design requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 针对风机叶片表面裂纹、磨损等缺陷对运行安全与寿命的影响，本文提出一种基于WTFFN-YOLO的缺陷检测方法。该方法用C3K2-SACA注意力模块替换原C3K2模块，用频率感知特征融合模块FreqFusion替代传统上采样，并在颈部网络中引入WTFFN模块以增强多尺度特征融合。实验表明，该模型在保持轻量化的同时提升了检测精度，mAP提高6.9%，小目标mAP提高8.2%，参数量减少8%。

articles.title: Production-network embedding and embodied carbon–energy footprints in semiconductor supply chains: An MRIO scenario analysis of Taiwan, Japan, and the United States
articles.title_zh: 半导体供应链中的生产网络嵌入与隐含碳—能足迹：基于台湾、日本和美国的MRIO情景分析
articles.abstract: Resilience-oriented reconfiguration of strategic supply chains may create environmental co-benefits or trade-offs, yet its embodied carbon and energy consequences remain poorly understood. Using the Eora Full multi-region input–output (MRIO) database, we compare Taiwan’s Semiconductors sector with observed semiconductor-related production structures in Japan and the United States. These comparisons are scenario-based footprint envelopes, not relocation forecasts or identical-fab efficiency estimates. Relative to Taiwan’s baseline, EDGAR CO₂ multipliers are 88.9% lower for the descriptive midpoint of the two Japanese sector scenarios and 93.6% lower for the US sector scenario; Eora I-ENERGY multipliers, interpreted only as 2022 cross-sector diagnostics, are 96.4% and 97.4% lower. Under cumulative B1b, which retains Taiwan’s upstream input structure while substituting the host target-sector direct intensity and reassigning only the direct electricity input, CO₂ reductions are 20.4% for the Japan midpoint and 22.9% for the United States. Upstream decomposition links Taiwan’s high multiplier to identifiable domestic electricity and heavy-industry sectors, while strict residual-account shares remain below 0.5% in all CO₂ decompositions. The results suggest that the environmental implications of semiconductor reconfiguration are associated mainly with upstream production-network embedding rather than siting or cleaner host electricity alone. The analysis covers embodied CO₂ and energy requirements, not material, water, social, or economic sustainability outcomes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文利用Eora多区域投入产出数据库，对台湾半导体部门与日本、美国的观察到的半导体生产结构进行情景比较，评估供应链重构对隐含碳与能源足迹的影响。结果显示，不同情景下的足迹水平存在显著差异，台湾的较高乘数可追溯到国内电力与重工业等上游部门。作者强调这些比较是情景边界分析，不是迁移预测或等效工厂效率估计。

articles.title: Latent debt in PINNs with SIR Models: Dynamical Compensation and Topological Bottlenecks
articles.title_zh: PINN与SIR模型中的隐性债务：动力补偿与拓扑瓶颈
articles.abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for parameter inference in nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), with increasing relevance in data-scarce domains such as digital health, where reliable inference under limited observations is critical for decision-making. However, their behaviour in early dynamical regimes, characterised by sparse information and near-linear system dynamics, remains insufficiently understood, particularly regarding loss landscape geometry and error propagation. By analyzing the Normalized Hessian within a subdetermined SIR model, we show that parameter inference becomes fundamentally ill-conditioned during the exponential growth phase, where the loss landscape exhibits a locally flat, rank-deficient structure. In this regime, optimization algorithms can minimize residual losses while converging to incorrect parameter values, compensating through systematic distortions in unobserved latent state variables. Temporal domain decomposition further introduces failure mechanisms whereby small initial-condition errors propagate across windows. As a result, the model may produce solutions that are numerically accurate yet associated with incorrect parameter estimates, reflecting a trade-off between insufficient curvature in short windows and the embedding of early-phase artefacts in longer horizons. These findings reveal that the limitations of PINNs arise from deeper topological pathologies in the optimization landscape and underscore the need to move beyond standard residual minimization toward structurally informed regularization strategies, providing a principled foundation for more robust and biologically consistent scientific machine learning models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究物理信息神经网络（PINN）在SIR传染病模型参数反演中的早期动力学行为。结果表明，在指数增长阶段，由于损失景观局部平坦且秩亏，参数识别会变得根本上病态，优化过程可能在残差变小的同时收敛到错误参数，并通过未观测隐变量的系统性偏差进行补偿。时间域分解还会放大初值误差传播，导致数值上看似正确但物理上失真的解。

articles.title: Deep Learning-Driven Multi-Objective Optimization of Surface Finish and Tool Wear in CNC Dry Turning
articles.title_zh: 基于深度学习的CNC干式车削表面质量与刀具磨损多目标优化
articles.abstract: Achieving fine surface finish without sacrificing tool life is the defining trade-off of computer numerical control (CNC) turning, yet parameter selection on production-grade lathes still relies largely on conservative handbook values. This paper develops a fully data-driven, deep-learning-enabled multi-objective optimization framework for dry turning of medium-carbon steel and validates it experimentally on a production CNC lathe. A three-factor, three-level full factorial experiment spanning the practical operating envelope of spindle speed, feed rate, and depth of cut provides the training dataset. Analysis of variance establishes that surface roughness and tool wear are governed by different, partly conflicting subsets of the cutting parameters, confirming a genuine two-objective conflict. Deep neural network regression surrogates are trained for both responses and benchmarked against classical power-law models under leave-one-out cross-validation; the superior surrogates are then embedded in the reference-point-based evolutionary algorithm NSGA-III to trace the Pareto front, and TOPSIS ranking with knee-point identification and weight-sensitivity analysis converts the front into operatorready recommendations in which feed rate and depth of cut collapse to single robust values, leaving spindle speed as the sole trade-off dial. Quantitatively, the deep networks reduce the cross-validated mean absolute percentage error of the roughness model from 9.79% to 7.65% and of the wear model from 6.68% to 1.01%; the predicted Pareto front extends 28% deeper into the fine-finish region than the power-law front, exposing an experimentally observed optimum that the parametric model overestimates by 40% and would therefore misprice; and the knee-point compromise recommendation is complemented by a TOPSIS ranking that is robust for all roughness weightings up to 55%.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文面向中碳钢干式车削，构建了一个数据驱动的深度学习多目标优化框架，用于同时改善表面粗糙度与刀具磨损。作者通过三因素三水平全因子试验获取训练数据，并用神经网络回归代理模型替代传统幂律模型，再结合NSGA-III搜索Pareto前沿。结果表明，表面粗糙度与刀具磨损受不同且部分冲突的工艺参数控制，说明该问题具有真实的双目标权衡。

articles.title: Cascading Congestion Collapse and Proactive Admission Control in Quantum Networks
articles.title_zh: 量子网络中的级联拥塞崩塌与主动准入控制
articles.abstract: Quantum repeater networks distribute entanglement using quantum memories with finite coherence time. Under load, a hop whose entangled pair must wait for sibling hops can decohere and time out, forcing regeneration at the very node that is already congested — a feedback loop we show produces a genuine cascading congestion collapse: a phase transition from stable operation to network-wide congestion above a critical arrival rate λc. We formalize this as a fold bifurcation in a mean-field loss-network model, derive an explicit stability criterion, and validate our core fidelity and decoherence formulas to floating-point precision against SeQUeNCe, an independent quantum network simulator. This decoherence-timeout-driven cascade mechanism has not, to our knowledge, been previously characterized. We propose DALSAC, a proactive admission-control policy that estimates per-node cascade risk from occupancy, trend, and timeout signals and sheds load before it can propagate. Across four topologies, three baselines, a four-parameter sensitivity analysis, and a scale-up to 100-node networks, DALSAC delays or avoids collapse, delivers 23–152% higher throughput and 19–125% higher success rate than baselines at high demand (significant in eleven of twelve comparisons), recovers about twice as fast from a transient demand shock, and does so without sacrificing fidelity — its advantage growing, not shrinking, with network scale. We further show that structural robustness to targeted attack depends on background congestion load, a dependency invisible to evaluations that test attacks on idle networks. All code, data, and figures are reproducible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，在量子中继网络中，由于量子存储器相干时间有限，某一跳的纠缠对若需等待兄弟链路而超时，会在已拥塞节点触发再生请求，从而形成拥塞—超时—再拥塞的反馈回路。作者将其形式化为平均场丢失网络模型中的折叠分岔，并给出稳定性判据，证明系统在临界到达率以上会发生真正的级联拥塞崩塌。为缓解该问题，作者提出DALSAC主动准入控制策略，可在多种拓扑中延缓或避免崩溃，并提升吞吐率与成功率。

articles.title: JURY: A Comprehensive Training-Free to Fully-Supervised Framework for Evaluating Chemical Language Models
articles.title_zh: JURY：用于评估化学语言模型的从无训练到全监督综合框架
articles.abstract: Language models have reshaped computational chemistry by learning from SMILES strings, a compact textual notation for a molecule's atoms and bonds. Trained on millions of such strings, these models compress each molecule into a fixed-length embedding usable for tasks like property prediction and de novo generation. To predict a property, researchers attach a prediction head and finetune the model, but a capable head can learn much of a property from labels alone, reaching strong results even on embeddings that carry little relevant chemistry. Since most models in the literature are evaluated only through such finetuned heads, reported performance conflates the model with the head, its training, and the labelled dataset's size and quality, leaving what the model itself contributes unclear. To close this gap, we present JURY, a stringent evaluation framework that probes chemical language models directly. Two probes require no training: the Neighbourhood Probe predicts from a molecule's nearest neighbours in embedding space, and the Cluster Probe groups molecules by that space alone and predicts from each group's labels. Two probes are trained: the Linear Probe fits a single linear map from embedding to property, and the Nonlinear Probe trains a small network on as few as two labelled molecules up to the full training set. Together the four span zero-shot to fully supervised prediction. We apply each probe to 10 chemical language models across 3 architecture families on 73 ADMET tasks, we find these models are far more alike than prior evaluation suggests: no model dominates across probes, and ECFP fingerprints, used as a baseline, sit comfortably among them. Scientific Contribution: A powerful prediction head recovers what a weak one cannot, and in doing so hides what the model failed to supply. JURY makes this distinction visible, replacing a single performance value with a profile across four probes, where agreement marks what a model encodes. Across ten chemical language models and ECFP, this profile shows an embedding space is defined by three properties, how much chemistry it holds, in what form, and how readily it can be recovered, none conveyed by a single prediction head.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对化学语言模型评估中“模型本身贡献不清”的问题，提出JURY框架，直接检验模型嵌入的有效性。该框架包含无需训练的邻域探针和聚类探针，以及需要训练的线性探针等方法，用以区分嵌入是否真正编码了化学信息。作者旨在将模型表示能力与下游分类头、训练过程及标注数据质量解耦，从而更严格地评价化学语言模型。

articles.title: Fast probabilistic spike deconvolution using optimized Markov chain Monte Carlo
articles.title_zh: 基于优化马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛的快速概率性脉冲反卷积
articles.abstract: Two-photon calcium imaging allows monitoring of large populations of neurons, but individual action potentials are often obscured under typical recording conditions. Algorithms for spike deconvolution estimate the underlying spike train of a neuron given an observed calcium trace. One powerful approach, Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) spike inference, models the underlying calcium dynamics, iteratively adding, removing, and shifting spikes in an inferred spike train in continuous time to sample from the posterior probability of the spike train given the observed calcium signal. However, MCMC is computationally taxing, requiring many hours of compute time for typical datasets. Here, we introduce a method for Optimized MCMC Spike Inference (OMSI) that preserves the performance of the full probabilistic framework while achieving a >90% reduction in compute time. Benchmarking using simulated data and simultaneous electrophysiology and calcium imaging confirms that our approach maintains accuracy comparable to traditional MCMC and matches or exceeds non-probabilistic alternatives. These performance gains establish continuous-time probabilistic inference as a practical, high-throughput tool for large-scale calcium imaging pipelines.
articles.abstract_zh: 两光子钙成像可用于观测大量神经元，但单个动作电位通常被钙信号掩盖，因此需要脉冲反卷积来恢复隐含脉冲序列。本文提出优化MCMC脉冲推断方法（OMSI），在保持完整概率框架性能的同时，将计算时间降低90%以上。基于模拟数据以及同步电生理与钙成像实验的验证表明，该方法的准确性可与传统MCMC相当，并可达到或优于非概率方法。

articles.title: Marine Cold Spells Induced by Tropical Cyclone Seroja in the Savu Sea
articles.title_zh: 热带气旋Seroja在萨武海引发的海洋冷事件
articles.abstract: Tropical Cyclone (TC) Seroja was the only TC recorded in the Savu Sea in 2021 and was among the first TCs to cause extensive damage to buildings and infrastructure on Indonesian land. Despite its significant impact, the TC effect on the oceanic thermal energy balance in this region remains poorly studied. This study examines the dynamical ocean response of the Savu Sea to TC Seroja using a combination of satellite-derived sea surface temperatures (SST) observations, TC best-track records, and atmosphere-ocean reanalysis output. The findings indicate that the Savu Sea is highly susceptible to cyclogenesis, as long-term mean SST consistently exceed 28°C. Elevated Tropical Cyclone Heat Potential (TCHP) values above 80 kJ/cm2 were observed prior to the development of TC Seroja, suggesting that substantial subsurface heat may have contributed to cyclone intensification in the Savu Sea. During the cyclone, TCHP values declined markedly below the climatological mean. The cyclone also induced a pronounced marine cold spells and Ekman pumping, which was associated with upwelling. Mixed-layer heat budget analysis demonstrates that upper Savu Sea cooling during TC Seroja was primarily driven by latent heat loss due to intense wind speeds. Furthermore, heat loss attributed to the residual term, representing turbulent mixing, was also considerable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文结合卫星海表温度、气旋路径和海洋—大气再分析数据，研究了2021年热带气旋Seroja对萨武海海洋热量平衡的影响。结果显示，该海域长期海表温度偏高且热含量充足，具备较强的气旋生成条件；气旋期间海洋热含量显著下降，并触发明显的海洋冷事件与Ekman抽吸上升流。混合层热收支分析表明，气旋造成的上层海水冷却主要由上升流等动力过程驱动。

articles.title: Predictingthe Trainability of Variational Quantum Circuits: A Data-Driven Model for BarrenPlateaus
articles.title_zh: 预测变分量子电路的可训练性：面向贫瘠平台的数据驱动模型
articles.abstract: Barren plateaus are the main obstacle to training quantum machine-learning models. On a barren plateau, the cost-function gradient shrinks exponentially as the circuit grows, and training stalls. Today the only reliable test is to measure it. That means sampling many gradients for every candidate circuit, which is expensive. We ask a different question. Can a classical model predict trainability from the circuit architecture alone? The architecture here means qubit count, depth, ansatz type, entanglement pattern, entangler gate, and cost-observable locality. We test this directly. We use an exact statevector simulator to build a dataset of Nrows{} random variational circuits. For each circuit we estimate the gradient variance Var[partial C/partialθ] from Samples{} random parameter vectors, using the parameter-shift rule. This variance is the label. A gradient-boosted regressor then predicts łog₁₀Var with R² = RsqHold{} on held-out architectures. A classifier separates barren from trainable circuits with an area under the ROC curve of AucHold{}. We also test transfer to larger circuits. We train only on small circuits and test on the two largest unseen sizes (n=11,12). The model still reaches R² = RsqExtrap{}. Permutation importance then recovers established theory. Cost-observable locality and entanglement structure matter most. We make no quantum-advantage claim. This is classical machine learning about quantum circuits. It offers a cheap way to screen ansätze, and it shows which design choices cause untrainability.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文讨论变分量子电路中的“贫瘠平台”问题，即电路规模增大时梯度指数级衰减，训练难以进行。作者提出仅根据电路结构特征——如量子比特数、深度、ansatz类型、纠缠模式、纠缠门和代价算符局域性——预测电路可训练性的经典模型。通过随机电路数据集与梯度方差标签训练的模型，可区分可训练与不可训练电路，并检验其向更大规模电路的泛化能力。

articles.title: A Hybrid Deep-Quantum Framework for Robust Stress Classification from EEG Signals
articles.title_zh: 用于EEG应激分类的鲁棒混合深度—量子框架
articles.abstract: Mental stress detection through electroencephalography (EEG) signals faces difficulties because EEG signals display non-stationary behavior and are vulnerable to artifact interference. The research introduces a hybrid deep-quantum learning framework which combines a one-dimensional convolutional neural network (1D-CNN) with a quantum support vector classifier (QSVC) to differentiate between stress and calm states. The CNN functions as a trainable feature extractor which converts raw EEG time-series data into compressed latent representations that undergo mapping to a quantum Hilbert space through ZZFeatureMap before being classified by a quantum kernel. The research demonstrates through experiments on a multi-subject EEG dataset that the hybrid model reaches its highest accuracy of (81.00%) (F1: 0.81) under optimal configuration using 8-dimensional features with MinMax scaling to [0,1] and 1000 training samples because it surpasses both the classical SVM (76.80%) and end-to-end CNN (78.85%) baselines. The analysis demonstrates that quantum kernel performance depends on feature dimensionality and scaling because lower dimensions (F-4) lack expressivity while higher dimensions (F-12) reach a performance limit and scaling to [-1,1] causes accuracy loss of 16 percentage points when compared to [0,1] scaling. The quantum classifier shows good sample efficiency because it gains more from additional training data compared to the traditional model. The research demonstrates that hybrid deep-quantum architectures function in the NISQ era while creating a performance standard for quantum-based physiological signal processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于EEG应激识别的混合深度—量子学习框架，将一维卷积神经网络与量子支持向量分类器结合，以区分应激与平静状态。CNN先从原始EEG时序中提取特征，再通过ZZFeatureMap映射到量子希尔伯特空间，由量子核完成分类。实验表明，在合适的特征维度、归一化设置和训练样本条件下，该方法优于传统SVM和端到端CNN基线，说明量子核性能对特征表达与尺度较为敏感。

articles.title: Electronic structure modulation in coupled indium δ -doped diluted magnetic nanostructure: role of uniform and nonuniform dopant distributions
articles.title_zh: 耦合铟 δ 掺杂稀磁纳米结构中的电子结构调控：均匀与非均匀掺杂分布的作用
articles.abstract: Publication date: 5 September 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 274 Author(s): H. Azmi, E. Ozturk, K. El-Bakkari, A. Mazouz, O. Ozturk, A. Sali
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕耦合铟 δ 掺杂稀磁纳米结构的电子结构调控展开，重点比较均匀与非均匀掺杂分布对体系性质的影响。研究旨在阐明掺杂空间分布如何改变局域电子态、磁性耦合及相关输运行为，具体结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Polarization enhancement and ferromagnetism induction in sliding ferroelectric materials via defect engineering
articles.title_zh: 通过缺陷工程增强滑移铁电材料的极化并诱导铁磁性
articles.abstract: Publication date: 5 September 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 274 Author(s): Tenglong Zhu, Cong Sun, Jing Weng, Fei Chen, Xuefeng Zi, Erjun Kan, Jintong Guan
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过缺陷工程调控滑移铁电材料的结构与电子性质，探索极化增强与铁磁性诱导的可能路径。工作表明，缺陷可作为有效调控手段，协同影响铁电响应与磁性行为，为多铁耦合器件设计提供思路。

articles.title: ESM–RISM-based evaluation of reaction-condition electron chemical potential, activation barrier, and local solute effects for elementary Al dissolution at an oxide-free Al(001)/acidic NaCl–HCl(aq) interface
articles.title_zh: 基于 ESM–RISM 的无氧化层 Al(001)/酸性 NaCl–HCl(aq) 界面初始铝溶解反应条件电子化学势、活化势垒与局域溶质效应评估
articles.abstract: Publication date: 5 September 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 274 Author(s): Koichi Kano, Minoru Otani, Fumiaki Kuroda, Takahiro Igarashi, Kenji Koga, Tatsuya Yamaue, Hitoshi Washizu
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用 ESM–RISM 方法，评估无氧化层 Al(001) 在酸性 NaCl–HCl 水溶液界面上初始铝溶解的反应条件电子化学势、活化势垒及局域溶质效应。研究聚焦电极/电解液界面上的原子级反应描述，可为铝腐蚀与溶解机理分析提供理论依据。

articles.title: Observation of Altermagnetic Spin-Splitting in an Intercalated Transition Metal Dichalcogenide
articles.title_zh: 插层过渡金属二硫族化物中交替磁性自旋劈裂的观测
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 20 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76784-x Altermagnets combine characteristics of both antiferromagnetism and ferromagnetic ordering. Here, the authors identify Co1/4TaSe2 as a layered altermagnetic material and show clear signatures of altermagnetic spin splitting at the Fermi surface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道层状材料 Co1/4TaSe2 具有交替磁性特征，即兼具反铁磁的零净磁化倾向与类似铁磁的动量依赖自旋劈裂。作者在费米面上观察到清晰的交替磁性自旋劈裂信号，为过渡金属二硫族化物中实现和探测交替磁态提供了实验依据。

articles.title: Breaking the mutual exclusivity between metallicity and ferroelectricity in a non-polar covalent semiconductor via orbital selective doping
articles.title_zh: 通过轨道选择性掺杂在非极性共价半导体中打破金属性与铁电性的互斥
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mutual exclusion of ferroelectricity and metallic conductivity is a long-standing tenet because itinerant electrons screen long-range Coulomb forces that stabilize the bulk polar order. Here, we break this paradigm by heavily doping a non-polar covalent semiconductor of cubic silicon carbide (3C-SiC) with nitrogen. This introduces heavy electron doping, inducing metallicity and driving a structural transition from the non-polar F-43m to the polar R3m symmetry via the pseudo-Jahn-Teller effect. Remarkably, we provide direct, atomic-scale visualization of about 180deg polarization reversal under an external voltage bias in a ferroelectric metal. The strongly directional character of antibonding orbitals occupied by conduction electrons prevents them from screening the local Si-C polarization, resulting in the coexistence of metallicity and ferroelectricity. Ferroelectric tunnel junctions demonstrate nonvolatile memory properties with a well-defined high-resistance state (HRS) and low-resistance state (LRS), an ultrahigh response speed (~50 ns), an ultralow operating voltage (1 V), an endurance exceeding 85927 cycles, and a projected retention time of 100 years. Our results provide a novel strategy for pioneering ferroelectricity in a metal, a new ferroelectric metal platform for exploring exotic properties, and a ferroelectric device with high performance that meets the requirements for low consumption and high-speed non-volatile devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过对立方碳化硅 3C-SiC 进行重氮掺杂，引入金属性并诱导由非极性 F-43m 到极性 R3m 的结构转变，挑战了巡游电子会屏蔽铁电极化的传统图像。作者将该机制归因于赝 Jahn-Teller 效应以及导电电子占据的强方向性反键轨道，使局域 Si-C 极化未被有效屏蔽。实验还在铁电金属中直接观察到约 180° 的电压驱动极化翻转，并展示了铁电隧道结的非易失存储、高速、低电压和较好循环耐久特性。
authors: Hui Li, Yunfan Yang, Junquan Huang, Yukun Feng, Guobin Wang, Qinci Wu, Jun Deng, Zhaolong Liu, Subi Du, Dongliang Gong, Zaihui Shen, Anmin Nie, Yang Xu, Junwei Yang, Zesheng Zhang, Huaping Song, Jiangang Guo, Wenjun Wang, Hailin Peng, Yongjun Tian, Xiaolong Chen

articles.title: Chern insulator boundary criticality
articles.title_zh: 陈绝缘体边界临界性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18199v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate signatures of chirality at Chern insulator transitions in the presence of a boundary. The transition between a trivial insulator and a Chern insulator with Chern number C=1 is described by a massless Dirac fermion whose parity anomaly gives a critical Hall conductivity σₓy=frac12frace²h. Using a Dirac mass domain wall construction, we show that the chiral edge mode delocalizes into the bulk at criticality, but the boundary fermion correlation function retains a chiral structure and acquires the scaling dimension of the bulk fermion. We compute current correlation functions and demonstrate that the anomaly of the bulk Hall response is matched by delocalized chiral modes near the boundary. Using only the residual conformal symmetry of a (2+1)d conformal field theory (CFT) in a half-space, we identify parity-odd terms in current and energy-momentum tensor correlation functions that encode these modes and determine their electromagnetic and gravitational anomaly coefficients. Our analysis therefore applies to general time-reversal breaking (2+1)d CFTs, beyond the free Dirac transition. We also extend our results to higher Chern number transitions and to the transition between a (3+1)d topological insulator and a trivial insulator.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究带边界的陈绝缘体相变中手征性的临界表征，重点讨论平庸绝缘体到 C=1 陈绝缘体转变时无质量 Dirac 费米子的边界响应。作者利用 Dirac 质量畴壁构造表明，临界点处手征边缘模离域进入体相，但边界费米子关联函数仍保留手征结构并获得体费米子的标度维数。通过电流及能动张量关联函数分析，工作将体 Hall 响应反常与边界附近离域手征模相匹配，并推广到更一般的破坏时间反演对称的 2+1 维 CFT 及更高陈数情形。

articles.title: Writing and erasing skyrmions by single ultrafast laser pulses in monolayer Janus 2D magnets
articles.title_zh: 单个超快激光脉冲在单层 Janus 二维磁体中写入与擦除斯格明子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18278v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Skyrmions in 2D magnets are promising candidates for nonvolatile, low-power, and high-density spintronic memories. However, their experimental realization at the 2D limit remains challenging, owing to the difficulty in engineering the required chiral magnetic interactions. Here, we report the creation and direct imaging of Néel-type skyrmions in Janus 2D chromium chalcogenides using synchrotron X-ray photoemission electron microscopy, and scanning nitrogen-vacancy magnetometry, which exhibit field-free stability, nonvolatility, and size tunability. First-principles calculations and micromagnetic simulations reveal that Janus-surface-induced inversion-symmetry breaking enhances the Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interaction, providing the microscopic mechanism for skyrmion stabilization and tunability. We further achieve reversible skyrmion writing and erasing using a single ultrafast laser pulse in a magnetic field as low as 300 Oe, demonstrating the excellent manipulability of this 2D magnetic system. These results establish Janus engineering as a route to creating and manipulating nonvolatile skyrmions in atomically thin magnets, with implications for skyrmion-based low-power spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 Janus 二维铬硫族化物中实现并直接成像 Néel 型斯格明子，使用同步辐射 X 射线光电子显微镜和扫描氮空位磁ometry 表征其零场稳定性、非易失性和尺寸可调性。第一性原理与微磁模拟表明，Janus 表面导致的反演对称性破缺增强 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用，是斯格明子稳定和调控的微观来源。作者进一步在低至 300 Oe 的磁场下用单个超快激光脉冲实现可逆写入和擦除，展示了原子级薄磁体中操控非易失斯格明子的可行路径。
authors: Guangyao Miao, Yonglong Ga, Chang Liu, Pan Chen, Yichen Jin, Florian Kronast, Wenxin Cheng, Zhaoqing Ding, Kai Hu, Zongnan Zhang, Nikolai Severin, Chenxi Meng, Patil Shubhada, Sergio Valencia, Meng Meng, Qinlin Guo, Xiaoran Liu, Jiandi Zhang, Yangmu Li, Carlos-Andres Palma, Jürgen P. Rabe, Hongxin Yang, Weihua Wang, Jiandong Guo

articles.title: Rare-earth spin textures and a route to electronic inhomogeneity in Pr₂Ir₂O₇
articles.title_zh: Pr2Ir2O7 中稀土自旋织构及其诱导电子非均匀性的途径
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18301v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The pyrochlore iridate Pr₂Ir₂O₇ remains metallic at low temperatures where its family members insulate. Recently, scanning tunneling spectroscopy experiments have revealed an inhomogeneous mixture of Kondo-screened and Kondo-destroyed regions when its surface is produced by cleaving at room temperature while it remains uniform when cleaved at low temperatures. We ask whether the frustrated praseodymium spin texture seeds this inhomogeneity. To study this, we produce Monte-Carlo-sampled Pr spin-ice configurations, presumed to evolve slowly in time, and couple through a local Kondo exchange J_K to an eight-band Hartree-Fock model of the Ir electrons. We further find the charge gap of the all-in-all-out state common in the other family members closes smoothly with the coupling J_K, and the recently proposed monopole-rich ``jellyfish'' textures further suppress the insulating behavior by Δ JKcapprox 0.03,t. Additionally, scanning a small cluster across a large Pr surface yields a synthetic tunneling map that fractures into islands within a sea. Although our classical simulable theory omits the Kondo singlet, the spatial modulation of the Fermi-level density of states it produces is, through the exponential Doniach sensitivity of the Kondo temperature, sufficient to tip the local balance between screening and magnetic order; a frustration-driven route to the observed Kondo/Kondo-destroyed inhomogeneity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对 Pr2Ir2O7 在低温保持金属性以及扫描隧道谱中出现 Kondo 屏蔽与 Kondo 破坏区域共存的问题，考察受挫 Pr 自旋织构是否可作为空间非均匀性的种子。作者生成 Monte Carlo 采样的 Pr 自旋冰构型，并通过局域 Kondo 交换耦合到 Ir 电子的八带 Hartree-Fock 模型。结果显示，all-in-all-out 态的电荷隙随耦合平滑闭合，富含单极子的“水母”织构进一步削弱绝缘行为；合成隧道图呈现岛状破碎结构，表明稀土自旋背景可导致电子性质的空间调制。
authors: Kyle G Sherman, Michael J Lawler

articles.title: Interface-Controlled Spin-Orbit Torques in Rare-Earth Synthetic Ferrimagnets Probed by Sagnac Magneto-Optics and Harmonic Hall Measurements
articles.title_zh: 利用 Sagnac 磁光与谐波 Hall 测量探测稀土合成亚铁磁体中的界面调控自旋轨道力矩
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18370v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin-orbit torque (SOT) provides an efficient route for manipulating magnetization in spintronic devices, and its accurate quantification is essential. Here, we investigate Co/Gd-based synthetic ferrimagnets using complementary magnetotransport and magneto-optical techniques. We use a Sagnac magneto-optical interferometry method to directly quantify current-induced magnetization tilting and extract the damping-like SOT effective field. The Sagnac measurements show good agreement with harmonic Hall analysis across different Co/Gd and Gd/Pt/Co heterostructures, providing a quantitative determination of the damping-like SOT effective field that does not rely on electrical transport signatures. By varying the Gd thickness and multilayer stacking order, we demonstrate that the damping-like torque is strongly influenced by spin transport and angular momentum conversion at rare-earth and heavy-metal interfaces. The observation of a finite torque in Gd/Pt/Co/Pt structures, where conventional Pt spin Hall contributions are expected to compensate, highlights the active role of the Gd layer in SOT generation. Furthermore, interface engineering enables perpendicular magnetic anisotropy in Gd/Pt/Co/Al heterostructures with a 2-nm-thick Co layer, allowing current-induced SOT switching at current densities of 8-10 MA/cm². These results establish rare-earth-based synthetic ferrimagnets as a versatile platform for engineering spin-orbit phenomena and optimizing low-power spintronic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合磁输运和磁光手段定量表征 Co/Gd 基合成亚铁磁体中的自旋轨道力矩。作者采用 Sagnac 磁光干涉直接测量电流诱导的磁化倾斜并提取阻尼型 SOT 有效场，其结果与不同 Co/Gd 和 Gd/Pt/Co 异质结构中的谐波 Hall 分析相一致。通过改变 Gd 厚度和堆垛顺序，工作表明阻尼型力矩强烈依赖稀土/重金属界面的自旋输运与角动量转换，且 Gd 层本身在 SOT 产生中具有主动作用。
authors: Akilan K, Koral Aykin, Jose-Luis Ampuero, Laurent Badie, Stephane Mangin, Sébastien Petit-Watelot, Michel Hehn, Andrew D. Kent, J. -Carlos Rojas-Sánchez

articles.title: Magnetic interactions and origin of high Curie temperatures in high Mn content (MnSb2Te4)x(Sb2Te3)1-x quantum materials
articles.title_zh: 高 Mn 含量 (MnSb2Te4)x(Sb2Te3)1-x 量子材料中的磁相互作用与高居里温度起源
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18378v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding the magnetic interactions that promote high TC in topological quantum materials is essential to effectively design materials whose magnetic configuration persists at high temperatures and are thus practical to integrate into commercial spintronic devices. Here we provide evidence of the origin of the high TC observed in mixed Mn1+ySb2-yTe4 septuple layers and Sb2-yMnyTe3 quintuple layer structures. Analysis of the quintuple layer/septuple layer structures explored their magnetic behavior through different models of Mn-incorporation in the crystal, evidenced as Mn spin S = 5/2, and provided an explanation for the low magnetization per Mn atom observed, signature of competing ferromagnetic and antiferromagnetic interactions between Mn2+ ions. Our studies provide insight to better understand and control the Mn incorporation in our samples to optimize their properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨混合 Mn1+ySb2-yTe4 七层和 Sb2-yMnyTe3 五层结构中高 Curie 温度的磁相互作用来源，目标是为高温可用的磁性拓扑量子材料设计提供依据。作者分析不同 Mn 掺入晶格模型下的磁行为，认为 Mn 主要表现为 S=5/2 自旋。低的单位 Mn 磁化强度被归因于 Mn2+ 离子之间铁磁与反铁磁相互作用的竞争，这为优化 Mn 掺入和材料性能提供了线索。
authors: Candice R. Forrester, Christophe Testelin, Kaushini Wickramasinghe, David Hrabovsky, Lia Krusin-Elbaum, Maria C. Tamargo

articles.title: Optical Voltage Profiling of 2D Semiconductors via Proximal Exciton Sensing
articles.title_zh: 通过邻近激子传感实现二维半导体的光学电压成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18382v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High contact resistances in atomically thin semiconductors often mask intrinsic electrical transport properties, particularly at low carrier densities where exotic correlated states emerge. We introduce optical voltage profiling, a noninvasive wide-field technique that replaces local voltage probes with a proximal monolayer MoSe₂ exciton sensor. Isolated by thin hexagonal boron nitride, this sensor converts the target's local electrostatic potential into spatially resolved modulations of exciton reflectance. Through pixel-wise in situ calibration, these signals yield quantitative two-dimensional voltage maps of an actively biased semiconductor device. Using this method, we demonstrate the carrier-density-driven metal-insulator transition in bilayer MoSe₂ and obtain channel resistances below 1 kØmega despite MØmega-scale two-terminal resistances in the metallic region. The optically derived resistance exhibits a metal-insulator crossover near the resistance quantum h/e², and the voltage maps and reconstructed local conductivity reveal pronounced spatial heterogeneity in both insulating and metallic regimes. Beyond resolving channel resistance under high contact-resistance conditions, the technique provides spatially resolved access to microscopic transport heterogeneity in functional van der Waals devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种非侵入式宽场光学电压成像方法，用邻近单层 MoSe2 激子传感器替代局域电压探针。传感层与目标器件由薄 hBN 隔开，可将局域静电势转化为激子反射率的空间调制，并经逐像素原位校准得到定量二维电压图。作者将其用于双层 MoSe2，揭示载流子密度驱动的金属-绝缘体转变、低于双端测量表观值的沟道电阻，以及绝缘和金属区中的显著空间非均匀性。
authors: Ha-Leem Kim, Hyungbin Lim, Yuanyi Yang, Ruishi Qi, Ruichen Xia, Can Uzundal, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Feng Wang

articles.title: Isolating the natural edges of bilayer graphene in gate-defined mesoscopic devices
articles.title_zh: 在栅定义介观器件中隔离双层石墨烯的天然边缘
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18384v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a graphite-gated architecture for bilayer graphene devices in which the active device is completely isolated from the natural graphene edges. Using a single patterned graphite-gate layer, we realize a fully electrostatically defined Hall-bar. Longitudinal and Hall measurements reveal mesoscopic transport features, including Hall-effect quenching and magnetoresistance peaks associated with boundary scattering. The dependence of the mesoscopic features on the carrierdensity shows that the effective channel width increases with the Fermi level and the electrostatic confinement at the gate-defined boundaries, and indicates that the carriers scatter at the electrostatic boundary. Raman spectroscopy and Kelvin probe force microscopy suggest that this boundary is disordered due to the used fabrication methods. Comparably, the quantum mobility in a fieldeffect transistor fabricated with the same architecture is not limited by boundary scattering and the visibility of quantum oscillations down to 4 mT suggests a record value of 2.5 x 10⁶ cm2/Vs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种石墨栅双层石墨烯器件结构，使有源区域完全远离石墨烯天然边缘，并用单个图形化石墨栅实现全静电定义的 Hall bar。纵向与 Hall 测量显示 Hall 效应淬灭和与边界散射相关的磁阻峰等介观输运特征，其载流子密度依赖性表明有效沟道宽度随费米能级和栅定义边界约束而变化。Raman 和 Kelvin 探针力显微结果提示该电静边界因工艺而较为无序；同架构场效应晶体管中量子迁移率不受边界散射限制，低至 4 mT 的量子振荡可见性对应约 2.5×10⁶ cm2/Vs 的高迁移率。
authors: Francesco Blanda, Grazia Raciti, Thilo Glatzel, Aurin Strathmann, Fabrizio Volante, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Ilaria Zardo, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin, Andrea Hofmann

articles.title: Localized Excitons and Exciton-Phonon Coupling in Antiferromagnetic AgCrP2S6
articles.title_zh: 反铁磁 AgCrP2S6 中的局域激子与激子-声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AgCrP2S6 combines a low-symmetry thiophosphate framework with an antiferromagnetic Cr sublattice and nonmagnetic Ag sites, providing a setting in which covalency and magnetic localization compete in the low-energy optical response. We combine single-crystal x-ray diffraction, Raman spectroscopy, lattice-dynamical calculations, and self-consistent vertex corrected Feynman diagrammatic many-body approaches to determine the structural, electronic, and excitonic properties of bulk AgCrP2S6. The material remains monoclinic between 100 and 300 K, with additional Ag-site disorder resolved at low temperature, and the optimized structure is dynamically stable. The many-body calculations yield a reduced quasiparticle gap relative to Cr trihalides, but the lowest excitons remain predominantly local: the calculated low-energy (~1.4 eV) excitation cluster is best described as a weakly bright, strongly anisotropic Frenkel exciton with dominant onsite d-d character and substantial ligand-assisted d-p admixture. Symmetry analysis in the C2h setting identifies this state as predominantly Bu and constrains its leading exciton-phonon coupling channels to Ag diagonal renormalization and Bg-mediated bright-dark mixing. These results place AgCrP2S6 in a localized excitonic regime in which the stronger p-d hybridization, relative to the more ionic Cr trihalides, narrows the quasiparticle gap, while the antiferromagnetic exchange and Ag-site dilution disfavor the intersite coherence associated with strongly delocalized low-energy excitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合单晶 X 射线衍射、Raman 光谱、晶格动力学和自洽顶角修正多体计算，研究反铁磁 AgCrP2S6 的结构、电子与激子性质。结果表明材料在 100–300 K 保持单斜结构，低温存在额外 Ag 位点无序，优化结构动力学稳定。多体计算显示其准粒子带隙小于 Cr 三卤化物，但最低能激子仍高度局域，约 1.4 eV 的低能激发主要为弱亮、强各向异性的 Frenkel 激子，具有主导的在位 d-d 特征和配体辅助 d-p 混合。
authors: Jessica McDivitt, Dimitar Pashov, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Justin C. Johnson, Jeffrey L. Blackburn, Anna A. Berseneva, Swagata Acharya

articles.title: Solidification-cell confinement of domain-wall pinning in additively manufactured ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 增材制造铁磁体中凝固胞对畴壁钉扎的限制效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18418v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As-built printed ferromagnets typically exhibit higher coercivity than optimized wrought materials, yet existing explanations rely on empirical fits or costly simulations. Herein, we provide a missing analytical theory that links print parameters directly to cooling rates, cellular spacing, dislocation density, and domain-wall pinning coercivity. Informed by metallographic grain data and using a single fitted constant, our model predicts six experimental datasets for pure Fe, Fe-6.9Si, and a multicomponent alloy within a factor of 1.9. We demonstrate that configurational lattice distortion is negligible, implying that single-phase printed alloys follow dilute-pinning laws. Critically, we introduce a confinement factor, E=sqrtłambdac/2δw, proving that solidification-induced dislocation packing makes cellular microstructures harder than conventionally cold-worked metals. The framework enables an alloy-sensitivity map to screen and rank compositions before manufacturing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文建立解析模型，将增材制造参数与冷却速率、胞状间距、位错密度和畴壁钉扎矫顽力直接联系起来，以解释打印铁磁体通常较高的矫顽力。模型在金相晶粒数据约束下仅使用一个拟合常数，对纯 Fe、Fe-6.9Si 和多组元合金的六组实验数据实现了因子 1.9 内的预测。作者指出构型晶格畸变贡献可忽略，单相打印合金服从稀释钉扎规律；提出的限制因子说明凝固诱导的位错堆积可使胞状组织比常规冷加工金属更难发生畴壁运动。
authors: Dennis Boakye, Eric K. K. Abavare, Chuang Deng

articles.title: Optical poling of a quantum ferroelectric metal across the order-disorder phase transition
articles.title_zh: 跨越有序-无序相变的量子铁电金属光学极化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18427v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Electron-doped strontium titanate has emerged as a prototypical quantum ferroelectric metal. It provides a fertile ground to explore how ferroelectric instability intertwined with itinerant electrons creates quantum phenomena, including unconventional superconductivity. Despite extensive studies, the microscopic origin of the ferroelectric transition remains unsettled, with distinct interpretations based on displacive mechanism driven by soft mode and order-disorder alignment of local dipoles. In particular, the local dipoles form nanoscale, spatially heterogeneous clusters, termed polar nanoregions, posing a significant challenge for probing or manipulating them. Here, using rotational anisotropy second harmonic generation, a symmetry-resolved probe, we quantify the orientational statistics of polar nanoregions in dilute electron-doped Sr₀.₉₅Ba₀.₀₅Ti₁₋ₓNbₓO₃. By tracking the alignment and meltdown of polar nanoregions in thermal cycles, we unambiguously demonstrate the order-disorder nature of the ferroelectric transition. We further show that, above transition temperature, femtosecond optical fields enable deterministic control of otherwise disordered polar nanoregions, realizing reversible write and readout of polar textures on ultrafast timescales. Our findings provide new insight into ferroelectric instability and establish an all-optical route of controlling polar metal systems where conventional electrical approaches are not feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以稀电子掺杂 Sr0.95Ba0.05Ti1-xNbxO3 为对象，利用旋转各向异性二次谐波产生这一对称性分辨探针，定量分析极性纳米区的取向统计。通过跟踪热循环中极性纳米区的取向排列与熔解，作者证明该体系的铁电转变具有有序-无序特征，而非单纯软模位移机制。进一步地，工作表明在相变温度以上，飞秒光场可对极性纳米区取向实施确定性控制，为量子铁电金属中光学极化调控提供了路径。
authors: Mohamed Kandil, Yasuhide Tomioka, Yafei Ren, Ryan Comes, Isao H. Inoue, Wencan Jin

articles.title: Room-Temperature Polarity Control of the Anomalous Nernst Effect in a High-Magnetic-Anisotropy Topological Nodal-Line MnAlGe
articles.title_zh: 高磁各向异性拓扑节线 MnAlGe 中室温反常能斯特效应极性调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18462v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling the polarity of anomalous Nernst thermopower is a promising strategy for enhancing the performances of thermoelectric applications. However, realizing such control at room temperature (RT) in topological ferromagnets with high magnetic anisotropy (Ku) remains challenging. Here, we report RT polarity control of the anomalous Nernst effect (ANE) in quasi-two-dimensional nodal-line MnAlGe epitaxial thin films through Al/Ge compositional tuning while preserving robust high Ku. This polarity reversal originates from intrinsic Berry curvature contributions modulated by sublattice-selective carrier doping, as supported by spin-resolved electronic band structure analysis and hard X-ray photoemission spectroscopy. To demonstrate the practical feasibility, we also fabricated a meander-structured device combining MnAlGe with positive and negative polarity enhanced the thermoelectric output. Our results demonstrate that tuning the Fermi level relative to the nodal-line electronic structure while preserving high Ku enables controllable ANE polarity reversal within a single material, providing a route toward RT transverse thermoelectric devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在准二维节线拓扑铁磁体 MnAlGe 外延薄膜中，通过调节 Al/Ge 组成实现室温反常能斯特效应极性反转，同时保持较高磁各向异性。自旋分辨能带分析和硬 X 射线光电子能谱表明，反转源于子晶格选择性载流子掺杂对费米能级及本征 Berry 曲率贡献的调制。作者还制备了由正、负极性 MnAlGe 单元组成的蛇形器件，展示了横向热电输出增强的可行性。
authors: Nanhe Kumar Gupta, Keisuke Masudaa, Masaaki Kakoki, Benugopal Bairagya, Satoki Tazawaa, Weinan Zhoua, Hirofumi Sutoa, Ryo Toyama, Akio Kimura, Yuya Sakuraba

articles.title: Efficient calculation of real-space lattice propagators in the presence of a Fermi sea
articles.title_zh: 存在费米海时实空间晶格传播子的高效计算方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18466v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an efficient method for computing the real-space propagators (lattice Green's functions) of any tight-binding Hamiltonian in the presence of a Fermi sea with carrier concentration x. The method is valid for any lattice, dispersion, and dimension, provided the corresponding x=0 propagators are known. We show that suitable combinations of the finite-x particle-addition propagators have a real or imaginary part trivially related to their x=0 counterpart, while the remaining part follows from a Kramers-Kronig relation that can be evaluated for all energies at once using the fast Fourier transforms. The computational cost is therefore independent of the dimensionality, unlike that of direct Brillouin-zone integration. The particle-removal propagators follow from general identities. We validate the method against direct integration for hypercubic lattices in one, two, and three dimensions, and use the 2D square lattice to illustrate how the shape of the Fermi surface is imprinted on the spatial structure of the propagators. In particular, at energies far outside the band, the propagator maps converge to the Fraunhofer diffraction pattern whose aperture is the unoccupied part of the Brillouin zone.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种计算任意紧束缚哈密顿量在有限载流子浓度费米海中实空间晶格格林函数的高效方法，适用于任意晶格、色散和维度，前提是已知零掺杂传播子。该方法利用有限掺杂粒子添加传播子的特定组合与零掺杂结果的简单关系，并通过 Kramers–Kronig 关系和快速傅里叶变换一次性求得全能量范围结果，计算代价不随维度增长。文中以一、二、三维超立方晶格验证方法，并展示二维方格中费米面形状如何反映在传播子的空间结构中。

articles.title: Room-temperature ferroelectrically switchable quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2 for complementary in-memory computing
articles.title_zh: 少层 WTe₂ 中室温铁电可切换量子几何及其互补存内计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18467v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry, describing the inherent geometric structure of electron wavefunctions in momentum space, transcends the traditional charge degree of freedom and provides a novel physical basis for information encoding and processing. The key to such new computing paradigms is the non-volatile electrical programming of quantum geometric states at room temperature, which, however, has not been established. Here, we demonstrate ferroelectrically switchable quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2, which uniquely enables complementary convolutional processing. By employing the intrinsic coupling between ferroelectric polarization and quantum geometry in few-layer WTe2, we show that the second- and third-order nonlinear anomalous Hall effects (NLAHE) can be deterministically and electrically switched in a nonvolatile and correlated manner. The switching is robust at room temperature for ~104 cycles and retention of ~105 s. Furthermore, leveraging the opposite switching behaviors of second- and third-order NLAHE at room temperature, we demonstrate complementary in-memory computing and implement a hardware-level complementary convolution kernel. This kernel overcomes the inherent directional specificity of conventional convolutional networks and achieves a texture recognition accuracy of 98%, thereby illustrating a viable pathway towards physics-native computing through exploiting exotic physics in quantum materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了少层 WTe₂ 中由铁电极化非易失调控的量子几何态，并用于互补卷积处理。利用铁电极化与量子几何的内禀耦合，作者实现了二阶和三阶非线性反常霍尔效应在室温下确定性、电控、非易失且相关的切换，并达到约 10⁴ 次循环和约 10⁵ s 保持。基于二阶与三阶响应相反的切换行为，文中进一步演示了互补存内计算和硬件级互补卷积核。
authors: Ruihan Wang, Pengfei Wang, Haoyun Chen, Yunze Peng, Bingyan Liu, Junlin Xiong, Xueyuan Zhang, Chen Pan, Xin Chen, Shengyuan A. Yang, Shi-Jun Liang, Feng Miao, Peng Song

articles.title: Superfast hole spin qubits enabled by uniaxial strain-boosted spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 单轴应变增强自旋–轨道耦合实现超高速空穴自旋量子比特
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18483v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) electron/hole gases confined in semiconductor heterostructures suffer from weak Rashba spin-orbit coupling (SOC) for manipulating spin degreee of freedom via an electric rather than a magnetic field. Here, we show that complementary metal-oxide-semiconductor technology-accessible strain could substantially enhance the linear Rashba SOC of the top hole subband in Ge/SiGe quantum wells (QWs) to a level comparable to that of 2D Rashba materials through enhancing the mixture of the light-hole and heavy-hole bands. We further show that strongly enhanced Rashba SOC boosts the Rabi frequency of hole spin qubits confined in Ge/SiGe QWs by two orders of magnitude to an unprecedented 40 GHz, more than one order of magnitude faster than other qubit platforms. We also demonstrate that the hole spin rotation with Rabi frequency > 25 GHz enters a new regime being immune to gate control-induced electric noise, opening a new avenue to simultaneously improve the gate speed and gate fidelity. Our findings provide a new routine to substantially enhance the Rashba SOC in 2D semiconductor hole gases to a level that is great for spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，可由 CMOS 工艺实现的单轴应变能显著增强 Ge/SiGe 量子阱顶部空穴子带的线性 Rashba 自旋–轨道耦合，其机制是增强轻空穴与重空穴能带混合。增强后的 Rashba 耦合可将 Ge/SiGe 空穴自旋量子比特的 Rabi 频率提高两个数量级，达到约 40 GHz，明显快于多数现有量子比特平台。作者还提出当 Rabi 频率超过 25 GHz 时，空穴自旋操控进入对栅控电噪声不敏感的新区域，有望同时提升门速度和保真度。
authors: Yi-Xu Wang, Yang Liu, Shan Guan, Jun-Wei Luo, Shu-Shen Li

articles.title: Topology is not silent in the transport noise of multiband bosons
articles.title_zh: 多能带玻色子的输运噪声中拓扑并非沉默
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18527v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For electrons at a Fermi surface, the topological part of the Berry curvature drops out of the transport noise: the anomalous Hall conductivity is quantized, and the fluctuations of the Hall current know nothing about the Chern number. We show that this cancellation is an accident of the Fermi surface, and that it fails for bosons. Magnons and phonons thermally populate every band, each with its own Chern number, so the harmonic sector of the Hodge decomposition of the curvature is not a single constant and a variance does not annihilate it. What survives is the occupation-weighted dispersion of Chern numbers across populated bands. That band geometry is visible in current noise is known, and at zero temperature the antisymmetric part of the noise sum rule already returns a Chern number; what is new is an object with no zero-temperature analogue, existing only when several bands are populated and weighted differently. We derive it from a fluctuating Boltzmann equation and settle the energy-magnetization subtraction at the level of fluctuations: the subtracted term is the curl of a bounded magnetization density, so it contributes exactly zero to the current any transport measurement records, realization by realization. Is the quantity measurable? A driven protocol is not: the excess noise sits twelve orders below the equilibrium floor. An equilibrium protocol is, through a sum rule on the antisymmetric part of the current cross-spectrum, which carries no drive and hence no suppression. We prove that the frequency-integrated form of that sum rule cannot separate the topological from the geometric content, and show that the frequency-resolved cross-spectrum does separate them at accessible resolution. The protocol is specified for Cu(1,3-bdc), with its robustness to nuisance-model completeness and to dispersion, thermometry and field calibration.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作指出，电子费米面输运噪声中 Berry 曲率的拓扑部分会因反常霍尔电导量子化而被抵消，但这一抵消并不适用于玻色体系。对热占据多个能带的磁振子或声子，不同能带的陈数以占据权重进入噪声，留下跨占据能带陈数分布的可观测贡献。作者从涨落 Boltzmann 方程推导该效应，并讨论能量磁化扣除在涨落层面的处理，表明多带玻色输运噪声可探测无零温对应物的拓扑几何信息。

articles.title: High-field fate of the Kitaev quantum spin liquid in α-RuCl₃
articles.title_zh: α-RuCl₃ 中 Kitaev 量子自旋液体的高场命运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18530v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Kitaev quantum spin liquids (KQSLs) host fractionalized excitations described by itinerant Majorana quasiparticles and gapped Z₂ fluxes (visons), providing a platform for emergent topological matter. Whether such a state survives under strong magnetic fields, however, remains an open question. The layered honeycomb magnet α-RuCl₃ is a leading candidate material: an in-plane field of sim 7 T suppresses antiferromagnetic order and induces a quantum-disordered phase exhibiting signatures consistent with Majorana excitations, including an anomalous thermal Hall effect and field-angle-dependent specific heat. At higher fields, the magnetization approaches saturation, suggesting a transition to a spin-polarized state, yet the microscopic evolution between these limits remains unresolved. Here we report high-field specific heat measurements up to 24 T that reveal a distinct crossover at μ₀H^*approx15 T, beyond which the perturbative Kitaev description breaks down. Above H^*, the characteristic six-fold angular modulation of the specific heat collapses and the excitation gap deviates from the predicted H³ scaling. Meanwhile, the gap decreases with increasing field and the in-plane magnetization anisotropy persists up to sim 24 T, both in sharp contrast to a trivial spin-polarized state, indicating that KQSL signatures are preserved even at sim 90 % of magnetization saturation. These results reveal that the KQSL in α-RuCl₃ extends well beyond the perturbative window, persisting as a nonperturbative regime in which the Majorana and vison energy scales merge, before eventually giving way to spin polarization. This thermodynamic roadmap provides a basis for understanding how fractionalized phases evolve under strong magnetic fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过最高 24 T 的高磁场比热测量考察 Kitaev 候选材料 α-RuCl₃ 中场诱导量子无序态向高场自旋极化态的演化。实验发现约 μ₀H*≈15 T 处存在明显交叉，在此以上微扰 Kitaev 图像失效：比热中标志性的六重角向调制塌缩，激发能隙也偏离预期的 H³ 标度。结果为理解 α-RuCl₃ 中高场 Majorana/vison 相关激发及其最终消失提供了热力学约束。
authors: K. Imamura, R. Ohno, Y. C. Tsuzuki, Y. Akui, R. Namba, K. Ishihara, M. Akaki, M. Kimata, N. Kurita, H. Tanaka, N. Kimura, S. Imajo, A. Matsuo, K. Kindo, Y. Matsuda, K. Hashimoto, Y. Mizukami, T. Shibauchi

articles.title: Hubb_DMFT and Wan2mb_DMFT: Continuous-Time Quantum Monte Carlo Solvers for Single- and Multi-Orbital Hubbard Model
articles.title_zh: Hubb_DMFT 与 Wan2mb_DMFT：用于单轨道和多轨道 Hubbard 模型的连续时间量子蒙特卡罗求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.18540v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present two related customized software packages, Hubb_DMFT and Wan2mb_DMFT, designed to solve the Dynamical Mean-Field Theory (DMFT) equations for strongly correlated electron systems.
