The method is validated on a four-story steel frame with nonlinear hysteretic braces under sparse and noisy measurements. Results show parameter identification comparable to or more accurate than Bayesian model updating with lower computational cost in the considered cases, recovery of unmodeled nonlinear restoring forces under incomplete physics, and joint identification of residual restoring forces and structural parameters within the same framework. Overall, RO-PINN provides a unified framework for structural identification by integrating reduced-order modeling, adaptive basis refinement, and physics-informed learning within a single formulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种带自适应基细化的降阶物理信息神经网络（RO-PINN），用于已知或不完整物理条件下的结构动力学参数与残余恢复力识别。方法通过投影将降阶控制方程嵌入PINN损失函数，使学习在低维潜空间中进行，并在训练过程中更新投影基以适应结构参数变化或未建模力的演化。该框架旨在缓解高维结构系统中直接PINN训练的维数瓶颈和模型形式误差问题。
authors: Rui Zhang, Konstantinos Vlachas, Eleni Chatzi

articles.title: Ostrogradsky's Theorem is Incompatible with Background Independence in Quantum Gravity
articles.title_zh: Ostrogradsky定理与量子引力中的背景无关性不相容
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17364v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ostrogradsky's theorem shows that higher-derivative dynamical systems inevitably yields a Hamiltonian featuring a ghost mode that is unbounded from below. However, we argue that this theorem is inapplicable to gravitational systems, as the Hamiltonian constraint, which encodes background independence by dictating that the total Hamiltonian vanishes, holds strictly. The ghost mode obeying this constraint constitutes an indispensable component in the construction of space and time. Nevertheless, it should be underscored that the use of the weak-field (graviton) approximation, being a background-dependent scheme presupposing the existence of absolute time, invokes this theorem; consequently, it is allowed only in the domain below the Planck scale, where second derivative terms dominate.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者论证，尽管Ostrogradsky定理指出高阶导数动力学系统通常具有能量无下界的鬼模，但该定理不适用于严格满足哈密顿约束的引力系统。原因在于背景无关性要求总哈密顿量为零，相关鬼模在这种约束下并非可简单排除的病态自由度，而是构造时空的一部分。文中同时强调，弱场引力子近似依赖固定背景和绝对时间，因此会重新触发Ostrogradsky问题，只应在普朗克尺度以下、二阶导数项占优的区域使用。

articles.title: Quantum sensors that compute: quantum computational magnetic-field sensing using a superconducting qubit
articles.title_zh: 会计算的量子传感器：基于超导量子比特的量子计算磁场传感
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17400v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A measurement of a single-qubit quantum sensor reveals at most 1 bit of information about the signal that was sensed. To perform a classification task on the signal, the conventional approach is to repeat a sensing protocol many times, averaging the measurement results to obtain a high-precision estimate of the sensed signal, and then to apply classical postprocessing. Quantum computational sensing (QCS) is an alternative approach that breaks with the paradigm of first obtaining a classical estimate of the signal and then computing a function of the estimated signal in postprocessing. QCS instead combines quantum sensing with quantum computing to concentrate information about the signal relevant to the task into the solitary bit revealed by each measurement. Here, we report on the experimental demonstration of QCS where sensing and computing were both performed by the same single superconducting transmon qubit. We consider various binary classification tasks based on static and oscillating magnetic fields induced by current through a flux line. The fields were sensed through a double-junction superconducting quantum interference device (SQUID) loop that was part of the qubit. We used a protocol based on quantum signal processing to preprocess the sensed signals in the quantum domain prior to measurement. For tasks on static magnetic fields, our protocol outperformed the conventional baseline of Ramsey-based phase estimation by as much as 15 percentage points. For tasks on oscillating magnetic fields, we classified signal amplitude and frequency with up to 20 and 15 percentage points higher accuracy, respectively, compared to the conventional baseline of optimized dynamical-decoupling protocols. Our results illustrate how quantum computing can enhance quantum sensing even with a minimally sized quantum system subject to the practical limitations of decoherence and error-prone operations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文实验演示了量子计算传感（QCS）：不先高精度估计被测信号再做经典后处理，而是把与分类任务相关的信息压缩到单次量子测量可读出的1比特中。实验中，同一个超导transmon量子比特同时承担磁场传感与量子计算，针对由通量线电流产生的静态和振荡磁场执行多种二分类任务。该工作展示了单量子比特传感器在任务导向信号判别中的计算化使用方式。
authors: Purnendu Sen, Mathieu Ouellet, Saeed A. Khan, Wayne Wang, Sridhar Prabhu, Alen Senanian, William P. Banner, William D. Oliver, Peter L. McMahon

articles.title: Engineering of Dual Wavelength, Polarization Selective Metalenses in Silicon Carbide
articles.title_zh: 碳化硅中双波长、偏振选择性超透镜的工程设计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17506v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spin defects in silicon carbide (SiC) are promising candidates for integrated quantum photonics, offering long-lived spin states and near-infrared emission suitable for low-loss photonic integration and fibre-based quantum communication. However, light extraction from these defects remains challenging due the relatively high refractive index of SiC. Metalenses offer a compact approach to enhance light collection by engineering the wavefront directly at the material interface. Here, we design and fabricate monolithic metalenses from SiC bulk material that simultaneously operate at 860 and 1240 nm, matching with emission from the nitrogen vacancy and silicon vacancy colour centers. By independently engineering the phase response at both wavelengths, the metalens enables collection and polarization manipulation of the emitted light. We further employ the metalenses to demonstrate optically detected magnetic resonance of both defects simultaneously. These multifunctional metalenses provide a compact optical interface for scalable integrated SiC photonic devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向碳化硅中氮空位和硅空位色心的集成量子光子学需求，设计并制备了由SiC体材料直接构成的单片超透镜。该超透镜可同时在860 nm和1240 nm工作，并通过分别调控两个波长的相位响应，实现发射光的收集增强与偏振操控。作者进一步利用该器件同时观测两类缺陷的光探测磁共振，表明其可作为可扩展SiC集成光子器件的紧凑光学接口。
authors: Xiaoying Huang, Ziwei Yang, Konosuke Shimazaki, Kritsana Saego, Otto Cranwell Schaeper, Evan Williams, Dragomir Neshev, Hark Hoe Tan, Igor Aharonovicha, Mehran Kianinia

articles.title: Fast high-order solvers for the Lippmann--Schwinger equation in piecewise-smooth heterogeneous media
articles.title_zh: 分片光滑非均匀介质中Lippmann–Schwinger方程的快速高阶求解器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17615v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This article presents a fast, high-order Nyström solver for the two-dimensional Lippmann--Schwinger equation arising from time-harmonic scattering by penetrable, piecewise-smooth heterogeneous media. Relying on high-order evaluation of the Newtonian potential on unstructured grids adapted to interfaces of discontinuity, the methodology achieves high-order accuracy using existing fast algorithms such as the fast multipole method. As an iterative method the solver exhibits rapid convergence when coupled to a preconditioning strategy that exploits a class of structured-grid solvers---fast solution methods offering quasi-linear time and memory complexity and nearly-constant iteration counts, but long limited in accuracy. The preconditioning strategy couples the Nyström discretization---given by high-order quadrature nodes over a (curved) unstructured mesh conforming to the support of the spatially varying contrast---to a uniform Cartesian grid underlying the fast preconditioner via a pair of transfer operators. The resulting preconditioner inherits the frequency-robust behavior of its Cartesian counterpart without sacrificing the geometric flexibility and high-order accuracy of the unstructured discretization. We prove that invertibility of the proposed preconditioner holds under explicit conditions on the mesh sizes and on the Cartesian preconditioner. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the preconditioned system requires significantly fewer GMRES iterations than its unpreconditioned counterpart, with iteration counts almost independent of mesh size and wavenumber, and illustrate the method's robustness for inhomogeneities with piecewise-smooth refractive indices and jump discontinuities across interfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于二维时谐穿透型分片光滑非均匀介质散射问题的快速高阶Nyström求解器。方法在适配不连续界面的非结构网格上高阶计算牛顿势，并可结合快速多极子等算法获得高阶精度与快速求解。为改善迭代收敛，作者构造了将高阶非结构Nyström离散与均匀笛卡尔网格快速预条件器耦合的传输算子，使预条件器保持频率鲁棒性，同时避免牺牲复杂几何下的离散精度。
authors: Thomas G. Anderson, Juan Burbano-Gallegos, Luiz M. Faria, Carlos Pérez-Arancibia

articles.title: Irradiation-Induced Spin Bath Evolution and as-Grown Hydrogen Defects in CVD Diamond Revealed by NV-Based DEER Spectroscopy
articles.title_zh: NV基DEER谱揭示CVD金刚石中辐照诱导自旋浴演化与生长态氢相关缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17619v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The aim of this paper is to provide the reader with a review and current state of the art of the fabrication of high T2 coherence diamond, optimised by the use of double electron-electron resonance (DEER) spectroscopy. Using DEER, we study the formation, transformation, and annealing of paramagnetic defects in as-grown CVD diamond and after post-processing. Electron irradiation leads to the formation of an additional S = 1/2 resonance in the DEER spectrum, which we consider to be a composite X ensemble. By tracking the concentrations of X and P1 point defects during annealing from 650C to 1200C, we find that the X ensemble initially consists of a mixture of V- spins and interstitial spins, which disappear at about 650C. Vacancies migrate during annealing, forming clusters that persist to 1000C and disappear upon annealing at 1200C, contributing to the X ensemble signal. We have developed a model of the influence of the mixed spin bath on the coherence of NV centers, which includes independent couplings with P1 centers, V-, divacancies, and interstitials. Detailed DEER studies allowed us to reveal and resolve a weak signal from two additional S = 1/2 species associated with hydrogen: NVH- and consistent with a substitutional hydrogen defect, which overlaps the vacancy spectral line. Taken together, these results show that the NV-DEER method is a powerful tool for investigating paramagnetic defects in diamond with high precision and nanoscale resolution, essential for material optimisation. The achieved high T2 coherence time is consistent with the spin bath model, and the crystals reach the quality required for advanced quantum sensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文综述并研究了利用双电子–电子共振（DEER）谱优化高T2相干金刚石制备的最新进展，重点跟踪CVD金刚石生长态及后处理后顺磁缺陷的形成、转化和退火行为。电子辐照会在DEER谱中产生额外的S=1/2共振，作者将其归因于复合X自旋 ensemble，并通过650–1200°C退火过程中X与P1缺陷浓度变化分析其组成。结果表明X信号与V−、间隙自旋、空位迁移形成的团簇等有关；作者还建立了混合自旋浴对NV中心相干性的影响模型，并解析出弱的氢相关缺陷信号。
authors: Olga Rubinas, Jeroen Prooth, Michael Petrov, Remy Vandebosch, Emilie Bourgeois, David Chvatil, Milos Nesladek

articles.title: A Semi-Analytical Theory for Improved Orbit Design of the GARATÉA-L
articles.title_zh: 改进GARATÉA-L任务轨道设计的半解析理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17672v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This work proposes a semi-analytical theory for improving orbit design of the GARATÉA-L Brazilian lunar mission. The dynamical model incorporates the lunar gravitational potential up to degree 12 and order 3 harmonics and a third-body perturbation model accounting for the eccentricity and inclination of the Earth's orbit with respect to the Moon. Through Hori's method, short- and medium-period terms are eliminated from the Hamiltonian to derive a first-order theory in mean orbital elements. It is demonstrated that nominal frozen orbits designed under simplified circular and equatorial assumptions for the motion of the third body are not maintained in this more realistic dynamical environment, leading to significant eccentricity growth and potential collisions of the probe with the lunar surface. The inclusion of the third body's inclination and eccentricity breaks the system's axial symmetry, introducing the longitude of the ascending node into the double-averaged variational equations and rendering stationary frozen orbits practically unattainable. Consequently, the problem is addressed through a parametric study around the simplified model's frozen conditions to identify ``low-drift" states where eccentricity variations are highly decreased. A new nominal orbit is proposed for GARATÉA-L. Numerical validation against high-fidelity propagation and JPL ephemeris confirms that this new configuration maintains the ``low-drift" behaviour throughout the mission, ensuring orbital safety and avoiding the collision predicted by simpler models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文为巴西GARATÉA-L月球任务提出一种改进轨道设计的半解析理论，动力学模型包含最高12阶3次的月球引力场谐项，并考虑地球绕月相对运动的偏心率和倾角引起的第三体摄动。作者用Hori方法从哈密顿量中消去短周期和中周期项，得到平均轨道根数的一阶理论。研究表明，在更真实的动力学环境中，基于圆形、赤道第三体假设设计的标称冻结轨道无法保持，可能出现显著偏心率增长甚至撞月风险；第三体倾角和偏心率破坏轴对称性，使严格定常冻结轨道实际难以实现。
authors: Luiz Arthur Gagg Filho, Sandro da Silva Fernandes

articles.title: High-Harmonicity Planar Penning Traps for Single-Electron Qubits
articles.title_zh: 用于单电子量子比特的高谐性平面Penning阱
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17984v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a detailed account of the design choices required for planar Penning traps that feature a highly harmonic confining potential. High harmonicity is indispensable for a number of applications, particularly for confinement of single electrons as qubits in quantum-information processing. The present work extends previous studies [D. Goldmann and G. Gabrielse, Phys. Rev. A 81, 052335 (2010)] by a fully analytic treatment of finite electrode gaps and their relevance for small traps on the millimetre size scale and below, when relative gap sizes are non-negligible. We derive the overall trap potential with a particular focus on different models of finite-gap potentials and show how to find the optimum trap geometry and electrode voltages to minimize anharmonicities. The analytic calculations are compared with detailed finite-element simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文系统讨论了具备高度谐性约束势的平面Penning阱设计，目标应用包括将单电子囚禁为量子信息处理中的量子比特。作者在已有研究基础上给出有限电极间隙的全解析处理，强调当阱尺寸降至毫米及以下时相对间隙不可忽略。文中推导了总阱势，比较不同有限间隙势模型，并给出优化电极几何和电压以最小化非谐性的策略，同时用有限元模拟验证解析结果。
authors: Kedar Mal, A. N. Agnihotri, Sugam Kumar, Wolfgang Quint, Manuel Vogel

articles.title: Time-Aligned Multichannel Coherence Estimation under Intermittent Observations
articles.title_zh: 间歇观测下的时间对齐多通道相干性估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20678v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Time misalignment and intermittent readout can bias multichannel dependence estimates by mixing timing error with missing data. Time-Aligned Multichannel Coherence Estimation (TAMCE) reports a causal network coherence statistic G together with an explicit observation-support state Q using normalized recursive channel states, independent timing calibration, and confidence-weighted correlation. A non-saturated benchmark with 16 independent seeds compares coincidence, zero filling, pairwise-complete correlation, causal hold-last completion, non-causal interpolation, diagonal intermittent-observation Kalman filtering, and TAMCE. At channel-correlated missingness 0.60, TAMCE obtains AUC 0.749 and latent-target RMSE 0.554, versus 0.723 and 0.713 for aligned zero filling and 0.826 and 0.418 for Kalman filtering. The TAMCE-zero-fill AUC difference is not statistically significant (p = 0.087). Same-record statistic ablations and selective risk-coverage tests show that Q is useful for abstention but carries essentially the same availability information as direct mask-derived pair support. Heavy-tail and drift stresses do not reverse the Kalman fidelity advantage. TAMCE is therefore supported as a model-light coherence-and-provenance interface for online monitoring and data-quality logic, not as a universally superior estimator.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究时间错位与间歇读出如何共同偏置多通道依赖性估计，并提出时间对齐多通道相干性估计（TAMCE）方法。TAMCE利用归一化递归通道状态、独立时间校准和置信度加权相关，同时报告因果网络相干统计量G和显式观测支持状态Q。在16个独立随机种子的基准测试中，TAMCE相较零填充在部分指标上改善有限且AUC差异未达统计显著；Q对选择性弃权有用，但主要承载与掩码派生配对支持相近的可用性信息。

articles.title: Local shear induces long-range suppression of cellular motion in stiff epithelial monolayers
articles.title_zh: 局部剪切在刚性上皮单层中诱导细胞运动的长程抑制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.24486v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: As small particles skim our airways during breathing, or our intestines during digestion, the surface epithelium is subjected to local exogenous shear that deforms hundreds to thousands of tightly interacting cells. Unlike shear deformations applied at the macro-tissue scale or the micro-cell scale, the effects of such perturbations at the meso-scale remain largely unexplored. To address this, we developed a mesoscopic probe that adheres to the apical surface of an epithelial monolayer and applies magnetically driven local shear. We find that localized shear suppressed cellular migratory dynamics far beyond the immediate neighbors in stiffer layers, whereas in softer layers the same perturbation produced no detectable long-range change in dynamics. This mechano-transductive relationship is further supported by unconfined mature layers, in which increased stiffness was accompanied by restored shear responsiveness. Viewed at the level of collective dynamics, shear-induced migratory suppression in stiff layers was often accompanied by reduced MSD scaling exponents and changes in cell shape, but these responses were not fully captured by the epithelial jamming framework. Together, these observations provide a new perspective on how a local mechanical perturbation traverses the epithelial monolayer to influence both nearby and distant cellular environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究呼吸道或肠道等上皮表面受到颗粒引起的介观尺度局部外源剪切时，细胞集体运动如何响应。作者开发了可黏附于上皮单层顶端并由磁场驱动施加局部剪切的介观探针。结果显示，在较硬的上皮层中，局部剪切会在远超近邻细胞的范围内抑制细胞迁移动力学，而较软层中同样扰动未产生可检测的长程效应；这一力学转导关系也在刚度提高的成熟未限域层中得到支持。
authors: Shahar Nahum, Adi Y. Elkabetz, Matan Elbaz, Liav Daraf, Yael Lavi, Lior Atia

articles.title: Rapid estimation of global sea surface temperatures from sparse streaming in situ observations
articles.title_zh: 由稀疏流式现场观测快速估计全球海表温度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21913v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reconstructing high-resolution sea surface temperatures (SST) from staggered SST measurements is essential for weather forecasting and climate projections. However, when SST measurements are sparse, the resulting inferred SST fields are rather inaccurate. Here, we demonstrate the ability of Sparse Discrete Empirical Interpolation Method (S-DEIM) to reconstruct the high-resolution SST field from sparse in situ observations, without using a model. The S-DEIM estimate consists of two terms, one computed from instantaneous in situ observations using empirical interpolation, and the other learned from the historical time series of observations using recurrent neural networks (RNNs). We train the RNNs using the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration's weekly high-resolution SST dataset spanning the years 1989-2021 which constitutes the training data. Subsequently, we examine the performance of S-DEIM on the test data, comprising January 2022 to January 2023. For this test data, S-DEIM infers the high-resolution SST from 100 in situ observations, constituting only 0.2% of the high-resolution spatial grid. We show that the resulting S-DEIM reconstructions are about 40% more accurate than earlier empirical interpolation methods, such as DEIM and Q-DEIM. Furthermore, 91% of S-DEIM estimates fall within ± 1ⁱ̧rcC of the true SST. We also demonstrate that S-DEIM is robust with respect to sensor placement: even when the sensors are distributed randomly, S-DEIM reconstruction error deteriorates only by 1-2%. S-DEIM is also computationally efficient. Training the RNN, which is performed only once offline, takes approximately one minute. Once trained, the S-DEIM reconstructions are computed in less than a second. As such, S-DEIM can be used for rapid SST reconstruction from sparse streaming observational data in real time.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出用稀疏离散经验插值方法（S-DEIM）从稀疏现场观测重建高分辨率海表温度场，且不依赖显式物理模型。S-DEIM估计由两部分组成：一部分来自瞬时现场观测的经验插值，另一部分由历史观测时间序列训练的循环神经网络学习得到。作者使用1989–2021年NOAA每周高分辨率海表温度数据训练模型，并在2022年1月至2023年1月测试，展示了仅用100个现场观测点（约占空间网格0.2%）进行全球高分辨率重建的能力。
authors: Cassidy All, Kevin Ho, Maya Magnuski, Christopher Nicolaides, Louisa B. Ebby, Mohammad Farazmand

articles.title: Evaluating Skill and Stability of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen under Multi-Decadal Climate Simulations
articles.title_zh: 多年代气候模拟中 ArchesWeather 与 ArchesWeatherGen 的技巧与稳定性评估
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.29976v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We evaluate the climate simulation capabilities of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen, two machine learning models originally trained for weather forecasting and evaluated up to a 10-day lead time. ArchesWeather is a deterministic model, while ArchesWeatherGen is a probabilistic flow-matching model leveraging ArchesWeather's forecasts, enabling ensemble-based uncertainty quantification. In this work, we adapt these models to act as forced atmospheric models by using additional conditioning on the monthly mean sea surface temperature (SST) and sea ice cover (SIC) as boundary conditions. In particular, we follow the AI Model Intercomparison Project (AIMIP) Phase 1 protocol, which, analogous to the Atmospheric Model Intercomparison Project (AMIP), proposes a standardized experimental setup to evaluate the climate skill of ML-based forced atmospheric models. We present a comprehensive evaluation of both models under these conditions, including comparison against numerical climate models, ablation studies that examine key design choices in the extension, and an analysis of forced versus unforced configurations. Despite being originally developed for weather forecasting, we demonstrate that forced configurations of ArchesWeather and ArchesWeatherGen produce stable long-term climate simulations, have a stable annual cycle, and capture the drift of many climate variables. The models faithfully reproduce ERA5's climatology, large-scale circulations and interannual variability, and they capture the tails of the distributions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了原本用于最长 10 天天气预报的两个机器学习模型 ArchesWeather 与 ArchesWeatherGen 在气候模拟中的能力。作者将月平均海表温度和海冰覆盖作为边界条件，使其作为受迫大气模型运行，并遵循类似 AMIP 的 AIMIP Phase 1 协议进行标准化评测。工作比较了确定性模型与概率流匹配集合模型的表现，并包含与数值气候模式的对比、设计消融以及受迫/非受迫配置分析。
authors: Renu Singh, Robert Brunstein, Antonia Jost, Yana Hasson, Thomas Rackow, Claire Monteleoni, Christian Lessig, Guillaume Couairon

articles.title: Magnetron Sputtering Formation of Nanoparticles from Natural Olivine Rock for Atmospheric CO2 Capture
articles.title_zh: 利用磁控溅射由天然橄榄岩制备纳米颗粒用于大气 CO2 捕集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27389v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The two-birds-one-stone mineralization of CO2 by olivine, is a promising method to both capture carbon directly from the atmosphere and at the same time locking it for storage or utilization. Converting olivine to the nanoscale considerably enhances the kinetics without the need for high temperatures or pressures. Here we present the fabrication of olivine nanoparticles from a natural rock that were fabricated in a gas aggregation magnetron nanoparticle generator. The nanoparticle yield was optimized by enhancing the argon plasma sputter plasma by hydrogen introduction and varying the aggregation distance. The hysteresis of the argon sputter plasma with respect to power is a promising property towards energy efficiency. The formation of well-defined olivine nanoparticles and their subsequent absorption of atmospheric CO2 was confirmed by a suite of techniques. The olivine sputter target surface revealed an intricate interplay between the sputter plasma and olivine composition in terms of crystallinity and morphology. More broadly, this work forms the next step in the practical application of Olivine nanoparticles for economical carbon capture and storage, it also is the starting point for the use of this specific nanoparticle technology for mineral-to-nanoparticle conversion.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出用气体聚集磁控纳米颗粒发生器将天然橄榄岩制备为纳米颗粒，以加速橄榄石矿化捕集并固定大气 CO2 的动力学过程。作者通过引入氢气增强氩等离子体溅射并调节聚集距离来优化纳米颗粒产率，同时指出氩溅射等离子体随功率变化的滞后特性可能有利于能效提升。多种表征证实了橄榄石纳米颗粒的形成及其对大气 CO2 的吸收，并揭示靶材表面晶体性、形貌与溅射等离子体和橄榄石组成之间的耦合关系。
authors: Brendan Matulis, Greyson Wells, Stefania Crespi, Nicola Rotiroti, Alessandro Podestà, Yuwei Zhang, Alberto Calloni, Gianlorenzo Bussetti, Fernando Cámara, Marcel Di Vece

articles.title: Temporal Evolution of Blackbody Radiation in a One-Dimensional Photonic Time-Crystal
articles.title_zh: 一维光子时间晶体中黑体辐射的时间演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.10577v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: One of the most intriguing phenomena in time varying-media photonics is the amplification of light in a photonic time crystal (PTC). However, studies to date have focused exclusively on PTC-based amplification of coherent light. Here, we theoretically investigate the PTC-based amplification of thermal radiation, specifically blackbody radiation. Such amplification is not only fundamentally intriguing due to the thermal radiation's stochastic nature, but also technologically relevant because thermal radiation's ubiquity, which implies that its amplification generally accompanies that of coherent radiation. For simplicity, and due to the experimental relevance of PTC amplification in transmission lines, we consider amplification in a one-dimensional medium. To analyze the amplification of blackbody radiation in a PTC, we examine the electromagnetic fields' spatial correlations and spatial spectra. We show that the spatial spectra of initially blackbody radiation converge periodically toward Gaussian profiles with progressively increasing amplitudes, coherence lengths, and spatial- and wavenumber-domain purities. We demonstrate that these asymptotic behaviors are governed by the PTC momentum band structure and can be understood using a rotating-wave approximation for the pseudo-Hermitian dynamics of the electromagnetic field in a PTC. Beyond revealing the fundamental evolution of thermal radiation in time-varying media, our numerical framework provides a general approach for analyzing the dynamics of stochastic electromagnetic fields in PTCs and time-varying media, in general. The results also provide physical insight and practical guidance for the design of PTC-based amplifiers, where the concurrent amplification of parasitic thermal radiation may occur.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论研究关注光子时间晶体对热辐射，特别是黑体辐射的放大，而非以往主要讨论的相干光放大。作者以一维介质为模型，通过电磁场空间关联和空间谱分析黑体辐射在时间晶体中的演化。结果表明，初始黑体辐射的空间谱会周期性趋向振幅逐渐增大、相干长度增加且在空间域和波数域纯度提高的高斯型轮廓。
authors: Luis Cortes-Herrera, Naren Ganesh, Jack Hasty, Yuzhe Xiao

articles.title: Quantum evolution with classical fields
articles.title_zh: 经典场实现的量子演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.24275v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Wave guides for classical electromagnetic fields can realize the discrete quantum evolution of the wave function for a system of qubits. Phase shifts, switches and beam splits allow for the construction of arbitrary quantum gates. They can act at once on a large number of qubits. For this correlation based photonic quantum computer the channels of the wave guides represent basis states of a multi-qubit system rather than individual qubits. With probabilistic initial conditions for a large number of channels the classical fields in wave guides realize the density matrix for a probabilistic quantum computer obeying the von Neumann equation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论利用经典电磁场波导实现量子比特系统波函数的离散量子演化。通过相移器、开关和分束器，可构造任意量子门，并可同时作用于大量量子比特；在这种基于关联的光子量子计算方案中，波导通道表示多量子比特系统的基态而非单个量子比特。对于大量通道的概率初态，经典波导场可实现满足 von Neumann 方程的概率量子计算密度矩阵。

articles.title: Electrometry of extremely-low frequencies from kHz to sub-Hz with a Rydberg-atom sensor
articles.title_zh: 基于里德堡原子传感器的 kHz 至亚 Hz 极低频电场测量
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.13827v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Rydberg-atom electric field sensing has shown great potential from near-DC to THz with state-of-the-art measurement metrics realized in sensitivity, phase extraction, multi-band receptivity, etc. While Rydberg-atom sensors have shown exceptional performance in the GHz regime, low-frequency operation has remained challenging because of electric-field-screening in conventional vapor cells, which suppresses externally applied fields. We overcome this limitation by combining auxiliary modulation and lock-in detection with a paraffin-coated vapor cell, and demonstrate an electrode-free, wideband method for sensing frequencies, ranging from 0.5 Hz to 10 kHz. Our work extends Rydberg-atom sensor range to VLF, ULF, SLF, ELF and sub-ELF frequency bands. In our method, high state-of-the-art sensitivities have been achieved - 819 μV/cm/sqrtHz for 1 Hz, 33 μV/cm/sqrtHz for 10 Hz, 10 μV/cm/sqrtHz for 100 Hz and 2 μV/cm/sqrtHz for 1 kHz.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将里德堡原子电场传感扩展到 0.5 Hz 至 10 kHz 的低频和极低频范围，克服了传统蒸汽池中电场屏蔽导致外加低频场难以探测的问题。作者结合辅助调制、锁相探测和石蜡涂层蒸汽池，实现了无需电极的宽带低频电场测量方法。报道的灵敏度为 1 Hz 下 819 μV/cm/√Hz、10 Hz 下 33 μV/cm/√Hz、100 Hz 下 10 μV/cm/√Hz、1 kHz 下 2 μV/cm/√Hz。
authors: Aveek Chandra, Narongrit Paensin, Rainer Dumke

articles.title: Information fusion and machine learning for sensitivity analysis using physics knowledge and experimental data
articles.title_zh: 融合物理知识与实验数据的敏感性分析信息融合与机器学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17248v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: When computational models (either physics-based or data-driven) are used for the sensitivity analysis of engineering systems, the sensitivity estimate is affected by the accuracy and uncertainty of the model. This paper considers global sensitivity analysis (GSA) for situations where both a physics-based model and experimental observations are available, and investigates physics-informed machine learning strategies to effectively combine the two sources of information in order to maximize the accuracy of the sensitivity estimate. Two representative machine learning (ML) techniques are considered, namely, deep neural networks (DNN) and Gaussian process (GP) modeling, and two strategies for incorporating physics knowledge within these techniques are investigated, namely: (i) incorporating loss functions in the ML models to enforce physics constraints, and (ii) pre-training and updating the ML model using simulation and experimental data respectively. Four different models are built for each type (DNN and GP), and the uncertainties in these models are included in the Sobol indices computation. The DNN-based models, with many degrees of freedom in terms of model parameters and training options, are found to result in smaller bounds on the sensitivity estimates when compared to the GP-based models. The proposed methods are illustrated for additive manufacturing and lake temperature modeling examples.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在同时具备物理模型和实验观测时，如何通过物理信息机器学习提高工程系统全局敏感性分析的准确性。作者考察深度神经网络和高斯过程两类模型，并比较两种融合物理知识的策略：在损失函数中强制物理约束，以及先用仿真数据预训练再用实验数据更新。每类方法构建四种模型，并将模型不确定性传播到 Sobol 指数计算中，以评估敏感性估计受模型精度和不确定性的影响。

articles.title: Tight Bounds for Data-driven Multiple Hyper-parameter Tuning with Structured Loss Function
articles.title_zh: 具有结构化损失函数的数据驱动多超参数调优紧界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17343v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data-driven algorithm design frames hyperparameter tuning as a statistical learning problem, but establishing generalization guarantees remains challenging due to the implicit, non-smooth dependence of model performance on hyperparameters. Existing multi-dimensional bounds under piecewise-polynomial assumptions remain theoretically loose and lack comprehensive lower bounds. We resolve this by establishing tight pseudo-dimension bounds for multi-dimensional data-driven tuning. First, we refine the learning-theoretic upper bound using real algebraic geometry; by analyzing invariant connected sign cells during block elimination rather than isolated sign vectors, we avoid topological over-counting to derive strictly sharper sample complexities. Second, we present a multi-regime lower-bound framework that disentangles combinatorial and algebraic capacities. By constructing shattered problem instances across distinct regimes, we prove our upper bounds are tightly saturated. Finally, we extend our topological framework to accommodate general bi-level validation-loss tuning and broader semi-algebraic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从数据驱动算法设计角度研究多维超参数调优的泛化保证，重点处理模型性能对超参数的隐式、非光滑依赖。作者利用实代数几何改进学习理论上界，通过分析块消元过程中不变连通符号胞而非孤立符号向量，减少拓扑过计数并得到更紧的样本复杂度。论文还构造多机制下界框架，区分组合容量与代数容量，证明所得上界可被紧致达到，并将拓扑方法扩展到一般双层验证损失调优和更广泛半代数应用。
authors: Anh Tuan Nguyen, Viet Anh Nguyen

articles.title: Inverse Problems for Partial Differential Equations with Jump Discontinuities in Coefficients via Two-Stage Physics-Informed Deep Learning and Statistical Mixture Models
articles.title_zh: 基于两阶段物理信息深度学习与统计混合模型的含系数跳跃间断偏微分方程反问题
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.14656v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This work proposes a two-stage physics-informed deep learning framework that combines neural-network-based sampling with statistical inference and constrained parameter refinement. In the first stage, a dual-network physics-informed architecture is used, where a main network approximates the PDE solution and an auxiliary coefficient sub network provides a relaxed continuous surrogate of the true discontinuous coefficient field. A gradient-adaptive weighting strategy is incorporated into the physics residual to improve residual training and enhance sampling reliability near possible discontinuity regions. The sampled coefficient values are then analyzed using Bayesian learning for Gaussian mixture models and birth-death Markov chain model selection, which estimate the number of coefficient regimes and provide heuristic search intervals for coefficient values and candidate transition regions. In the second stage, the inverse problem is reformulated as a constrained physics-informed estimator, in which the coefficient is represented explicitly as a hard piecewise-constant function over the spatiotemporal domain. Numerical experiments on different PDE types with jump-discontinuous coefficients demonstrate that the proposed framework achieves accurate parameter estimation with acceptable computational costs compared to existing methods. This work provides an effective integrated workflow for inverse problems governed by PDEs with discontinuous parameter structures, particularly in nonstationary and heterogeneous systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种两阶段物理信息深度学习框架，用于求解系数存在跳跃间断的 PDE 反问题。第一阶段采用双网络结构，主网络近似 PDE 解，辅助系数子网络给出真实间断系数场的连续松弛代理，并通过梯度自适应权重改善间断区域附近的残差训练与采样可靠性。随后利用高斯混合模型的贝叶斯学习和出生-死亡马尔可夫链模型选择估计系数状态数，并给出系数值和转变区域的启发式搜索区间；第二阶段将系数显式表示为分片常数函数，并进行受约束的物理信息参数细化。
authors: Zhikun Zhang, Guanyu Pan, Xiangjun Wang, Yong Xu, Guangtao Zhang

articles.title: The Problem Is the Problem: Towards Scalable Mathematical Discovery
articles.title_zh: 问题即问题：迈向可扩展的数学发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16977v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: AI systems are increasingly capable of contributing to mathematical research. In research practice, frontier-model reasoning is a limited resource, and expert mathematical review is even more sharply constrained. Allocating these scarce resources well is therefore central to making AI-assisted mathematical discovery efficient. In most current AI-for-math workflows, human effort is concentrated at the beginning and end, in selecting suitable research problems and later reviewing the resulting artifacts. These two stages are becoming bottlenecks for research-level mathematics. We address them by proposing a new human-AI discovery paradigm. The human input is no longer a single problem selected in advance, but a research direction in which the experts have interest and expertise. The system then searches a broad literature corpus for candidate problems in that direction. Inspired by search and recommender systems, we build Find, Attempt, and Recommend (FAR), a literature-to-review cascade that automates the search for suitable problems and focuses human attention on artifacts that have passed several stages of filtering. In a combinatorics pilot, the pipeline starts from 5,245 combinatorics papers, recovers 6,453 candidate conjectures or open problems, and filters them to 4,717 apparently well-posed and still-open conjectures. Subsequent reasoning and automated triage stages surface 598 potential resolutions and select 77 items for author-team review. Among them, we identify many interesting discoveries, including results on conjectures and questions of Davies--Jenssen--Perkins--Roberts, Erdős--Straus, Ikenmeyer--Pak--Panova, and Lund--Saraf--Wolf. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of this new mode of human-AI collaboration for mathematical discovery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注 AI 辅助数学研究中两个瓶颈：前期选择合适研究问题和后期专家审查成果。作者提出一种新的人机协同发现范式，人类不再预先指定单个问题，而是给出感兴趣且具专业背景的研究方向，系统再从大规模文献语料中搜索候选问题。受搜索与推荐系统启发，论文构建 Find, Attempt, and Recommend（FAR）级联流程，对候选问题及其尝试结果进行多阶段筛选，从而将有限的前沿模型推理能力和专家审查资源集中到更有价值的数学产物上。
authors: Zeyu Zheng, Shengtong Zhang, Jeremy Avigad, Prasad Tetali, Sean Welleck

articles.title: Auditing Self-Evolution in Financial Agents: Capability Gains, Security Drift, and Execution-Interface Mismatch
articles.title_zh: 金融智能体自我演化审计：能力增益、安全漂移与执行接口不匹配
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17684v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-evolving agents turn experience into reusable skills, workflows, or memories, but post-evolution accuracy alone does not show whether learned behavior preserves previously correct behavior or security. We audit SkillOpt, Agent Workflow Memory (AWM), and ReasoningBank in simulated e-banking using matched benign acquisition trajectories, sealed evaluation endpoints, execution-grounded checks, and independent state replay. On Qwen 3.7 Flash, SkillOpt raises benign utility from 0.741 to 0.837 while exposure to injected content rises from 0.820 to 0.943. Conditional attack success after exposure falls from 0.605 to 0.562, yet overall attack success rate (ASR) rises from 0.496 to 0.530 and unauthorized financial state changes rise to 0.685. Across three independently evolved lineages, capability, exposure, and unauthorized-state changes increase in all three, whereas ASR increases in only two. ReasoningBank raises utility to 0.859 without increasing aggregate ASR, although unauthorized state changes remain slightly above Static. AWM reveals a separate evaluation hazard: a literal WebArena text-action envelope disrupts tool execution in our native function-calling executor. In a post-hoc sensitivity test, removing only that envelope restores utility from 0.319 to 0.756, while exposure rises from 0.299 to 0.909 and ASR from 0.195 to 0.575. Auditing self-evolving financial agents therefore requires tracking regressions, attack-surface contact, unauthorized financial-state change, and artifact-executor compatibility, not accuracy alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究审计自我演化智能体在模拟电子银行场景中将经验转化为技能、工作流或记忆后，是否在提升能力的同时保持原有正确性和安全性。作者评估 SkillOpt、Agent Workflow Memory 和 ReasoningBank，采用匹配的良性采集轨迹、封闭评测端点、执行落地检查和独立状态重放。结果显示，在 Qwen 3.7 Flash 上 SkillOpt 将良性效用从 0.741 提升到 0.837，但暴露于注入内容的比例和未授权金融状态变更也上升；ReasoningBank 将效用提升到 0.859 且未提高总体攻击成功率，但未授权状态变更仍略高于静态基线。AWM 还揭示了评测风险：WebArena 文本动作封装与实际工具执行接口可能不匹配。

articles.title: ComNetX: Local Hierarchical Adaptation for Dynamic Community Detection
articles.title_zh: ComNetX：用于动态社区检测的局部层次自适应框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16906v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamic community detection is commonly addressed either by full-snapshot recomputation or by solver-specific dynamic procedures. Full recomputation preserves the semantics of mature static solvers, but it repeatedly processes unchanged graph regions when updates are small. Solver-specific dynamic methods can reduce this cost, but their update rules often have limited transferability across objectives, feature representations, and implementations. In addition, localizing computation only by graph distance may omit community context needed by high-quality solvers. We introduce ComNetX, a solver-agnostic hierarchical adaptation framework for local dynamic updates. ComNetX maintains a multi-level community state, expands the updated region, closes it over affected communities, and contracts these communities into compact local instances. This affected-community closure and contraction preserve solver context while restricting computation to the changed part of the graph. The same interface can wrap modularity heuristics, graph-clustering models that use node features, and native dynamic solvers as local backends. We evaluate ComNetX through a multi-backend study on six real networks, longer real-data streams for topology-based backends, and controlled dynamic stochastic block model stress streams. The results show that ComNetX can preserve the quality of strong modularity-based solvers while reducing update time on large graphs: in paired runs on the largest real graph, Local Leiden keeps final modularity within 0.006 of full-snapshot recomputation while achieving a 41.9 +/- 0.2x speedup. The combined protocols also identify regimes where locality breaks down and a full refresh is preferable.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 ComNetX，一种与具体求解器无关的动态社区检测局部更新框架。它维护多层社区状态，在更新区域周围进行扩展、对受影响社区做闭包处理，并将其收缩为紧凑的局部实例，从而在保留上下文的同时只计算图中变化部分。该接口可封装基于模块度的启发式方法、使用节点特征的图聚类模型以及原生动态求解器。
authors: Aleksandr Konovalov, Anna Uporova, Alexander Drobyshev, Iaroslav Egorov, Grigoriy Bokov

articles.title: Cross-Model Memory Transfer via Target-Side Reader Adaptation
articles.title_zh: 通过目标端读取器适配实现跨模型记忆迁移
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17050v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes. Non-parametric retrieval offers flexible access to external knowledge, but adds retrieval latency, context overhead, and only shallow integration with the backbone. Parametric adaptation is efficient at inference time, but entangles knowledge with model weights and can be hard to update, audit, or transfer. Engram-style hashed memory occupies a middle regime: it stores learned information in an external, addressable table, yet consumes that table through a small learned reader. This raises a basic question: when such a memory is moved across backbones, what matters more, the frozen memory itself or the target-side reader? We study this question through cross-model frozen-memory extraction, in which a memory trained on a source model is frozen and attached to a different target model, with only a lightweight reader trained. Ablations show that learned memory content and correct addressing both matter, but the transferred table becomes useful only through a reader aligned to the target model. In downstream question answering tasks, a dual-layer, four-branch reader nearly closes the gap between same-model and cross-model reuse, achieving an average score of 38.8 under our controlled evaluation protocol. Moreover, when the provider reader is directly compatible with the target interface, the frozen artifact can provide substantial utility without target-side training, while optional reader adaptation yields further improvement. These results suggest that Engram can serve as a reusable external knowledge artifact, provided that the target has access to a compatible reader interface; target-side adaptation can further improve alignment when direct reader reuse is insufficient.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究将外部记忆从一个语言模型迁移到另一个模型时，冻结记忆内容与目标端读取器各自的重要性。作者通过跨模型冻结记忆提取实验发现，记忆内容和地址定位都重要，但记忆表真正发挥作用依赖于与目标模型对齐的读取器。结果表明，跨骨干迁移时，读取器适配是决定可用性的关键环节。
authors: Mingyuan Li, Guangsheng Yu, Xu Wang, Shaoxiong Ji

articles.title: Authorization Before Context: A Model-Neutral Audience Boundary Against Cross-Audience Memory Leakage in Agentic Systems
articles.title_zh: 先授权后组上下文：防止智能体系统跨受众记忆泄露的模型无关边界
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17148v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A personal language agent learns a fact from one audience and may later place it in the prompt it assembles for another. This memory-to-context step is an attack surface: ambiguous or inconsistent channels, cross-audience prying, and poisoned memory can each cause the system to assemble context containing a fact relevant to the query yet unauthorized for the current viewers. We introduce authorization before context: a single, anti-monotone audience-membership rule applied at the memory-to-context transition. Each item carries the audience present when it was recorded; the current viewer set is read from channel metadata and falls back to public when ambiguous; and the item is admitted only when every current viewer already belonged to its audience. We prove that this rule gives every participant cross-channel recall while ensuring, by exclusion rather than by model behavior, that nothing recorded for a narrower audience reaches a broader one and that poisoned memory cannot widen its own audience. The boundary is a model-neutral invariant on the exact assembled context: a forbidden fact must be absent before the model is called. On a synthetic Contextual-Integrity suite, no forbidden fact entered the context our boundary assembled, whereas unscoped baselines included such facts by construction; we further audit that every read path fails closed. The evidence is preliminary and synthetic.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文指出，个人语言智能体在从记忆组装上下文时，可能把只对窄受众可见的信息带入更广受众的提示中，从而形成攻击面。作者提出“先授权后组上下文”规则：每个记忆项携带记录时的受众，当前查看者集合由通道元数据读取，只有当当前所有查看者都已属于该受众时才允许纳入上下文。该规则以排除而非模型行为来保证跨通道回忆能力，同时阻止跨受众泄露和污染记忆扩权。

articles.title: Iterative Grasp Pose Refinement: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Approach for 2D Vision
articles.title_zh: 迭代式抓取位姿细化：面向二维视觉的深度强化学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17628v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Developing robots capable of understanding and manipulating objects requires compact, interpretable, and generalizable representations. This work proposes a reinforcement learning-based framework for robotic grasp refinement, integrating keypoint-based object representations with a Deep Q-Network (DQN). Using 2D overhead images captured in a simulated environment, a geometric-based algorithm generates initial grasp candidates, which are iteratively refined by the proposed framework, transforming failed grasps into successful ones. Experiments conducted on 300 objects from the Dex-Net dataset using a UR5 manipulator demonstrate the framework's effectiveness, achieving a 100% success rate on objects previously deemed ungraspable by geometrical methods. The framework's sim-to-real transferability is further validated through physical experiments on a Delta parallel robot, where a refined grasp successfully manipulates an object that was previously ungraspable. The findings underscore the effectiveness of reinforcement learning in addressing challenges in robotic grasping, offering a scalable and adaptable solution for contact-rich manipulation tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种用于机器人抓取细化的强化学习框架，将基于关键点的目标表示与深度 Q 网络结合。系统以二维俯视图为输入，先由几何算法生成初始抓取候选，再通过迭代细化将失败抓取修正为成功抓取。作者在 Dex-Net 数据集的 300 个物体及 UR5 机械臂仿真上验证了方法有效性，并进一步在实体平台上展示了从不可抓取到可抓取的迁移能力。
authors: Amir Arsalan Nematollahi, Shayan Ahmadi, Mehdi Tale Masouleh, Ahmad Kalhor

articles.title: Every Picture Tells a Dangerous Story: Memory-Augmented Multi-Agent Jailbreak Attacks on VLMs
articles.title_zh: 每张图片都可能讲述危险故事：面向视觉语言模型的记忆增强多智能体越狱攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.12616v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) expand the attack surface of safety-aligned systems by coupling visual perception with text generation. Existing multimodal jailbreak attacks primarily rely on crafted visual content, adversarial perturbations, or image-specific attack strategies, leaving the potential of reusable visual anchors in benign natural images largely unexplored. To address the problem, we introduce MemJack, a memory-augmented multi-agent framework for automated VLM red-teaming with natural images. MemJack combines visual-anchor discovery, visual-semantic camouflage, response evaluation, reflection-guided repair, and dynamic replanning within a closed-loop attack pipeline. Beyond attack generation, MemJack automatically transforms public images into attack anchors, enables the construction of MemJack-Bench, a dataset of over 113,000 interactive multimodal jailbreak trajectories for safety evaluation and defensive alignment. Extensive empirical evaluations across full, unmodified COCO val2017 images demonstrate that MemJack achieves a 71.48% attack success rate (ASR) against Qwen3-VL-Plus, scaling to 90% under extended budgets. Compared with representative multimodal jailbreak baselines under the same natural-image evaluation setting, MemJack achieves the highest ASR while requiring fewer mean rounds to success, demonstrating superior jailbreak effectiveness on VLMs. These results demonstrate that benign natural images can act as transferable jailbreak anchors and reveal substantial vulnerabilities in current safety-aligned VLMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 MemJack，一种面向视觉语言模型的记忆增强多智能体自动红队框架，利用自然图像构造越狱攻击。该框架集成了视觉锚点发现、视觉语义伪装、响应评估、反思修复和动态重规划，形成闭环攻击流水线。作者还据此构建了包含 11.3 万余条交互轨迹的 MemJack-Bench，并在 COCO 2017 原始图像上展示了较强的攻击成功率。
authors: Jianhao Chen, Haoyang Chen, Hanjie Zhao, Haozhe Liang, Zheng Wang, Tieyun Qian

articles.title: Complexity-Aware Model Selection for Structural Simulation Surrogates: Defining the Boundary Between Descriptor Models and Mesh-Based Graph Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向结构仿真代理模型的复杂度感知模型选择：划定描述符模型与网格图神经网络的边界
articles.abstract: Machine-learning surrogates can approximate finite element analysis cheaply, but the choice of surrogate is usually made by convention rather than measured complexity. Using a parametric L-bracket extended into four part families of increasing geometric and topological complexity under a common linear-elastic pipeline, this study defines the boundary at which a descriptor-based surrogate ceases to be adequate and a geometry-aware graph neural network becomes justified. The boundary is a graded shift in representational effort rather than a single accuracy cliff: descriptor models are near-saturated at low complexity, whereas at rich topology a fixed-length encoding either becomes unstable or requires bespoke feature engineering. On the mesh-converged distributed targets, the compact graph model reduces mean absolute error by 30–42 % relative to the best descriptor, yielding a complexity-aware, representation-driven model-selection rule and a reproducible benchmark for structural simulation surrogates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在有限元结构仿真代理建模中，何时应使用基于描述符的模型，何时应采用具备几何感知能力的网格图神经网络。作者以复杂度递增的 L 形支架家族为对象，指出模型选择并非由单一精度阈值决定，而是随几何与拓扑复杂度逐步转移的表示能力问题。结果表明，在低复杂度下描述符模型接近饱和，而在复杂拓扑下图模型能明显降低误差。

articles.title: One-step synthesis of NiS2/Ni3S4 under atmospheric pressure using deep eutectic solvent as dual reaction medium and morphology regulator
articles.title_zh: 利用深共熔溶剂在常压下一步合成 NiS2/Ni3S4，并兼作反应介质与形貌调控剂
articles.abstract: Nickel sulfides are of broad interest for electrocatalysis and energy storage due to their mixed valence states and metallic conductivity. However, their synthesis typically relies on high-pressure autoclaves and organic solvents, hindering both scalability and mechanistic understanding. Here, we report an atmospheric‑pressure method for synthesizing a NiS2/Ni3S4 composite using choline chloride‑ethylene glycol (ChCl‑EG) deep eutectic solvent (DES) as the reaction medium and Ni(NO3)2·6H2O and Na2S2O3·5H2O as the reactants. It is demonstrated that the DES not only acts as a stable reaction medium but also serves as an intrinsic morphology regulator, constraining particle sizes to 50–100 nm. Through monitoring pH, oxidation‑reduction potential, and SO42− concentration, we uncover a disproportionation pathway in which S₂O₃²⁻ is simultaneously oxidized to SO42− and reduced to S2−/S22−, leading to the concurrent formation of Ni3S4 and NiS2. The prepared NiS2/Ni3S4 exhibits a resistivity of 0.010 Ω·cm at 20 MPa, comparable to the best reported nickel sulfide composites. These findings introduce DES as a versatile medium for the atmospheric‑pressure synthesis of transition‑metal sulfides, with direct implications for electrode additive design and scalable catalyst fabrication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文报道了一种在常压下合成 NiS2/Ni3S4 复合物的一步法，采用氯化胆碱-乙二醇深共熔溶剂作为反应介质，并以 Ni(NO3)2·6H2O 和 Na2S2O3·5H2O 为原料。研究表明，该深共熔溶剂不仅稳定，而且还能作为内禀形貌调控剂，将颗粒尺寸限制在 50–100 nm。作者结合 pH、氧化还原电位和硫酸根浓度监测，提出了硫代硫酸根歧化生成 Ni3S4 与 NiS2 的反应路径。

articles.title: A Certified Interval Method for the Distance from a Point to an Ellipse
articles.title_zh: 点到椭圆距离的认证区间算法
articles.abstract: We present a certified algorithm that computes the Euclidean distance dstar from a point P=(x₀,y₀₎ to an ellipse E: x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 and returns an interval [dlo,dhi] that is emphguaranteed to contain dstar. Thealgorithm isolates the real roots of the quarticS(u)=b y₀ u⁴ + 2(a²⁻b²⁺a x₀₎ᵤ³ - 2(a²⁻b²⁻a x₀₎ᵤ - b y₀,which arises from the critical-point equation of the squared distanceunder the half-angle substitution u=tan(θ/2). Root isolationis emphseed-free: derivative bracketing partitions each chartdomain into pieces on which S is provably monotone, every piece iseither certified root-free or enclosed and evaluated, and completenessof the enclosure is a theorem rather than a seed heuristic(Theorem~e̊fthm:coverage andLemmas~e̊flem:monofilter--e̊flem:flatgap). Two furtherfacts keep the algorithm simple and rigorous. First, theemphCertified Distance Principle (Theorem~e̊fthm:cdp): sincedstar² is the global minimum of the squared distance,emphevery box kept by the filter chain (proven to contain a rootor not) satisfies minᵢ loᵢ łe dstar² łeminᵢ hiᵢ; hence no root-existence proof is needed for thedistance bound, and boxes near multiple roots (where interval Newtondegenerates) only widen the interval negligibly. Second, a emphdual parameterization: theu-chart u=tan(θ/2) and the w-chart w=tan((π-θ)/2)together cover the ellipse (Theorem~e̊fthm:coverage), and everyemphsimple critical point is well-conditioned in at least onechart --- in particular minimizers near the pole θ=π (farpoints, |P|gg a) and near the cusp of the evolute, which areill-conditioned (κ sim 10¹⁵) in the u-chart, become tinywell-conditioned roots in the w-chart; near-double configurations,ill-conditioned in both charts, are covered by the value-flatnessestimates behind saturation acceptance(Proposition~e̊fprop:saterr).Thealgorithm is validated against a 50-digit variable-precision oracle(exact binary input reconstruction) on a 372-point battery includingknown failure cases from the literature, exact tangencies, astroidcusps, the circle limit and flat ellipses (a/b up to 10⁶⁾, onsix adversarial families of 10⁵ points each, on three independentrandom streams, and in an ǎrepsilon-scan of CAD clearancetolerances: the certified interval consistently satisfied theenclosure guarantee in every one of these experiments, with medianrelative width at the machine precision level and roughly 15~msper query on the validation battery.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种经认证的区间算法，用于计算平面上一点到椭圆的欧氏距离，并返回必然包含真实距离的区间。方法通过半角代换将问题化为四次多项式的实根隔离，再借助导数分割与单调性筛选实现无初值、可证明完备的根包络。文中还给出“认证距离原理”，说明无需先证明存在根，也能直接给出距离平方的严格上下界。

articles.title: A Hybrid Quantum Classical Optimization Framework for Pickup and Delivery Problems with Parcel Lockers Using Quantum Graph Attention Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于量子图注意力网络的取送货与包裹柜问题混合量子-经典优化框架
articles.abstract: The significant growth of e-commerce has created a vast demand for last-mile parcel delivery, in which case, parcel lockers will be the future of home delivery. But the Pickup and Delivery Problem with Lockers (PDPL) is computationally hard as it is an NP-hard problem with locker capacities, time windows, and stochastic customer availability. In this paper, we present Q-PDPL, a novel quantum-assisted hybrid approach for optimization that employs Variation Quantum Eigensolver (VQE), Quantum Approximate Optimization Algorithm (QAOA), and Quantum Graph Attention Networks (Q-GAT) in a Dantzig-Wolfe decomposition (DW) scheme. The framework recasts the pricing problem as a ground state of the energy optimization problem, which is quantum efficiently solvable by means of parameterized quantum circuits. In a stochastic setting, a Q-GAT-enhanced deep reinforcement learning module is employed that delivers online routing decisions. Tests with Solomon VRPTW and Li and Lim PDPTW datasets over the SQL demonstrate that Q-PDPL is 18.7% cheaper than classical Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search, 23.4% better than Branch-and-Price, and handles over 500 customers. The quantum pricing sub problem has O(√N⋅"poly" (logN)) complexity (classical O(N2)) and a solution quality within 2.1% of the optimal bound. These results hold out promise for quantum-classical hybrid algorithms for large-scale logistics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Q-PDPL，一种针对带包裹柜的取送货问题的混合量子-经典优化框架。该方法在 Dantzig-Wolfe 分解下结合 VQE、QAOA 和量子图注意力网络，将定价子问题重写为能量优化问题，并在随机场景中用 Q-GAT 增强的深度强化学习模块执行在线路径决策。基于 Solomon 和 Li-Lim 数据集的实验表明，该框架相较多种经典基线具有更低成本和更好的扩展性。

articles.title: Hybrid-Electric Seaplanes: Route-Level Economics and Break-Even Conditions
articles.title_zh: 混合电动水上飞机：航线层面的经济性与盈亏平衡条件
articles.abstract: Decarbonising regional air mobility is a priority for the European aviation sector,and short coastal and island routes are a natural early market for battery-assisted propulsion. Whereas the operating economics of land-based hybrid-electric commuters have been studied repeatedly, the economic and operational implications of applying hybrid-electric propulsion to a seaplane remain largely unexplored. This paper addresses that gap by extending validated Direct Operating Cost (DOC) and project-finance models to a clean-sheet, 18-seat hybrid-electric flying boat sized through a surrogate-based multi-objective optimisation. The optimised configuration is benchmarked against a DHC-6 Twin Otter on a representative Mediterranean route, Valencia–Palma de Mallorca, and compared on three levels: a per-block-hour DOC breakdown, route-level productivity indicators, and a 15-year discounted assessment of Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR) and Payback Period. The hybrid-electric seaplane reaches DOC parity with the turboprop (difference below 1 %): large energy-and CO2-cost savings are almost exactly offset by higher capital charges, new electric-powertrain maintenance and mass-driven airport and navigation fees. At project level the outcome is decided by ticket yield: at a yield of 1.50 €/pax-nm the hybrid-electric seaplane is not viable (negative NPV, IRR below the discount rate), whereas at 1.75 €/pax-nm it becomes viable (positive NPV, IRR above 3 %). The break-even yield is about 1.55 €/pax-nm, a ticket of roughly 295 €. The decisive result is therefore not a fixed ranking but a threshold: the business case is shallow and yield-elastic, and modest movements in fare, battery cost, carbon price and low-emission fee schemes are sufficient to cross it. The hybrid-electric flying boat is best read as a forward-looking investment whose competitiveness is governed by policy and cost-learning levers rather than by aircraft technology alone
articles.abstract_zh: 本文将已验证的直接运营成本与项目融资模型扩展到一款新设计的 18 座混合电动飞船式水上飞机，并用基于代理模型的多目标优化完成尺寸设计。作者以地中海代表航线 Valencia–Palma de Mallorca 为例，将其与 DHC-6 Twin Otter 从单小时运营成本、航线生产率以及 15 年期 NPV、IRR 和回收期等角度进行比较。结果表明，该混合电动方案在所研究航线上可接近与涡桨机的运营成本平价，但资本开支和电推进维护成本会抵消部分能源与减碳收益。

articles.title: GADE-YOLO: An Efficient Geometry-Adaptive Network for Industrial Wood Surface Defect Inspection
articles.title_zh: GADE-YOLO：一种用于工业木材表面缺陷检测的高效几何自适应网络
articles.abstract: Wood surface defect detection is critical for guaranteeing product quality in intelligent manufacturing. However, it remains highly challenging due to complex wood-grain background interference, extreme scale variations, blurred defect boundaries, and irregular defect morphologies. To address these issues, this paper proposes GADE-YOLO, a geometry-adaptive network for industrial wood surface defect detection based on YOLOv11n. Specifically, for the issues of severe texture noise interference and blurred micro-defect edges, we design an adaptive multi-scale feature enhancement module (AMFE), which dynamically selects multi-scale receptive fields and leverages spatial attention to filter out wood-grain noise. Meanwhile, an adapted multi-scale edge enhancement module (MEEM) is embedded into the high-resolution layer to strengthen boundary perception and sharpen the blurred boundaries of tiny defects. To tackle geometric misalignment caused by fixed-grid convolution on irregular contours, we introduce the C3k2_DCN unit with modulated deformable convolution for adaptive spatial sampling. Furthermore, we construct a geometry-adaptive fusion network (GAFN) with triple-branch feature aggregation (TFA) to extend the feature pyramid to the P6 layer, optimize cross-scale information flow, mitigate semantic dilution and adapt to large-span defects. Extensive experiments on a self-built industrial wood defect dataset demonstrate that GADE-YOLO achieves 83.6% precision, 75.7% recall and 84.9% mAP@0.5, outperforming the baseline YOLOv11n by 6.4, 4.7 and 7.3 percentage points, respectively. Meanwhile, GADE-YOLO has 5.6 GFLOPs of computational complexity, maintaining the advantages of lightweight design and efficient parameterization. In addition, GADE-YOLO improves mAP@0.5 by 9.7 percentage points over YOLOv11n on the public wood defect dataset, demonstrating its feasibility, robustness, and potential for real-time industrial deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对木材表面缺陷检测中纹理噪声强、尺度变化大、边界模糊和缺陷形态不规则等问题，提出基于 YOLOv11n 的 GADE-YOLO。网络引入自适应多尺度特征增强模块、边缘增强模块以及带调制可变形卷积的几何自适应单元，以提升多尺度表征、边界感知和不规则目标的空间采样能力。作者还构建了几何自适应融合网络，以进一步增强缺陷检测性能。

articles.title: Microencapsulation of Nisin in Polyelectric complexes of alginate-chitosan for extended antimicrobial activity
articles.title_zh: 海藻酸盐-壳聚糖聚电解质复合物中尼生素的微胶囊化及其延长抗菌活性
articles.abstract: Nisin is a promising antimicrobial peptide widely used in food preservation due to its efficacy against Gram-positive spoilage and pathogenic bacteria. Although Nisin is increasingly applied in the food sector, the biopeptide suffers from instability within food matrixes and can rapidly lose its antimicrobial potential following interaction with food biomolecules. Thus, it is necessary to investigate approaches that can be employed to extend the stability and activity of Nisin. Hence, the aim of this study was to develop and characterise a chitosan–alginate polyelectrolyte microencapsulation system capable of enhancing Nisin stability while retaining antimicrobial activity. The microencapsulation of Nisin was achieved by pre-gelation of alginate using calcium chloride and subsequent direct electrostatic interaction between cationic Nisin and chitosan with pre-gelled anionic alginate at pH 5.0. Following microcapsule formation, physicochemical and structural characterisation was performed using Zeta potential determination and measurement of the polydispersity index (PDI) via dynamic light scattering. SEM micrographs were used to confirm morphology, while Fourier-transform infrared (FTIR) spectroscopy and high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC) were utilised to assess chemical integrity and functional group preservation of encapsulated Nisin. Following this, stable microcapsules with diameters ranging from 150–200 nm and smooth surface morphology were obtained. Microcapsule formation was strongly influenced by formulation parameters, particularly pH, calcium ion concentration, and chitosan content, with deviations from optimal acidic conditions (< pH 5.0) resulting in aggregation, increased polydispersity, and reduced encapsulation efficiency. The microcapsules were monodispersed (PDI ≈ 0.30) and electrostatically stable, exhibiting a Zeta potential of approximately + 36 mV. These microcapsules remained stable over a prolonged storage period of 21 days under refrigerated conditions while retaining antimicrobial activity against Bacillus cereus. Encapsulation efficiency reached approximately 65%, confirming effective retention of Nisin within the polymer matrix. Overall, the findings demonstrate that chitosan–alginate ionic gelation is a non-denaturing and effective encapsulation strategy for extending the functional stability of Nisin. These microcapsules show strong potential as natural antimicrobial delivery systems for food and beverage applications, particularly in acidic food matrices, with implications for improved food safety and shelf-life extension.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究将尼生素封装于海藻酸盐-壳聚糖聚电解质微胶囊中，以提升其稳定性并延长抗菌活性。制备过程先用氯化钙对海藻酸盐预凝胶化，再在 pH 5.0 条件下利用带正电的尼生素、壳聚糖与预凝胶化海藻酸盐的静电相互作用形成微胶囊。作者随后通过 Zeta 电位、粒径分布、SEM 和 FTIR 等手段对其理化性质与结构特征进行表征。

articles.title_zh: Li2RuxIr1−xO3中的各向异性Kitaev自旋玻璃
articles.abstract: npj Quantum Materials, Published online: 19 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41535-026-00935-y Anisotropic Kitaev spin glass in Li 2 Ru x Ir 1− x O 3
articles.abstract_zh: 该文围绕Li2RuxIr1−xO3体系中的各向异性Kitaev自旋玻璃态展开研究，关注Ru/Ir混杂引发的磁无序与受挫相互作用。由于输入摘要仅包含题目与元数据，具体实验或理论结论需查阅原文。总体上，这是一项关于Kitaev候选材料中自旋玻璃行为及其各向异性特征的研究。

articles.title: Turning a quantum battery's environmental sensitivity into an advantage
articles.title_zh: 将量子电池对环境的敏感性转化为优势
articles.abstract: Quantum batteries, devices that store energy by exploiting quantum mechanical phenomena, could, in principle, be charged faster and more efficiently than classical ones. Despite their potential, connecting these batteries to chargers is known to create quantum correlations that can trap some energy inside the combined battery-charger system. This can reduce useful work, or the energy available to complete a task that can be extracted from the battery alone.
articles.abstract_zh: 文章讨论量子电池与充电器耦合后产生的量子关联如何导致能量被困在联合系统中，从而降低可提取的有用功。作者进一步提出，量子电池对环境的敏感性未必只是缺点，也可能被转化为性能优势。该工作从资源与控制角度重新审视了量子电池的充放电问题。

articles.title: Normalized Cross-Gradient Screening and Consistency Assessment of ERT and GPR Data for Near-Surface Structural Mapping
articles.title_zh: 用于近地表结构制图的ERT与GPR数据归一化交叉梯度筛选及一致性评估
articles.abstract: The integration of electrical resistivity tomography (ERT) and ground-penetrating radar (GPR) is commonly performed through visual comparison of independently processed sections. This approach is useful but subjective because the two methods respond to different physical properties and provide different spatial resolutions. This study presents a reproducible framework for campus-scale ERT-GPR structural consistency assessment using normalized cross-gradient logic, quality-controlled geophysical products, and a pixel-wise ERT-GPR Consistency Index (ECI, reported as mean SCI over valid cells). ERT datasets were screened using repeat-error thresholds, non-positive-resistivity checks, and apparent-resistivity consistency tests. GPR data were processed using dewow filtering, background removal, and time gain, with candidate 200 MHz profiles selected for line-scale comparison and depth conversion using an assumed electromagnetic velocity of 0.10 m/ns. The most defensible core ERT pairing is Line 1 L101 and Line 2 L205WA because both use Wenner-alpha geometry and have high QC pass rates of 94.6% and 96.4%, respectively. Final shallow-overlap normalized cross-gradient (NCG) and Structural Consistency Index (SCI) statistics were computed from Res2DInv iteration-5 INV model blocks and processed GPR envelope-proxy grids. The resulting ECI values are 0.573 for Line 1 and 0.607 for Line 2, indicating slightly stronger structural consistency in Line 2 under the adopted common-grid and valid-cell criteria. The results demonstrate a transparent screening workflow rather than a full-depth equivalence test between ERT and GPR responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一套可复现的电阻率层析成像（ERT）与探地雷达（GPR）联合分析框架，用归一化交叉梯度逻辑和像素级一致性指标评估两类地球物理数据的结构一致性。作者对ERT数据进行重复误差、非正电阻率及视电阻率一致性筛查，并对GPR数据执行去直流漂移、背景去除和时间增益等处理。该方法旨在减少人工目测比对的主观性，提高浅层结构解释的稳健性。

articles.title: Time-Resolved Atomic Mechanisms of Nickel Oxide Transformations
articles.title_zh: 镍氧化物转变的时间分辨原子机制
articles.abstract: The formation and reduction of metal oxides play key roles in processes such as corrosion, catalysis, and energy conversion. However, understanding the atomic events that drive transformations within oxide lattices has proven challenging. In this study, we present a platform and workflow that enable time-resolved imaging to reveal the atomic mechanisms involved in the interconversion between metals and metal oxides. We achieved this by controlling the rate of electron–atom interactions and synchronising it with the image-capture rate, allowing us to link the reaction kinetics to movements of individual atoms during the formation, growth, dissociation, and sintering of nickel oxide (NiO) crystals. This approach determined key parameters governing metal-metal oxide transformations, such as the critical nucleus size of ~ 4–5 NiO lattice units required for oxide crystal growth, and a similar critical size for the reverse process, demonstrating a fundamental link between the two. Time-resolved imaging of crystal growth revealed the crucial role of an atomic step edge on the (100) facet, serving as an active site for the incorporation of incoming nickel atoms. Furthermore, the sintering of oxide particles follows a sequence of steps: interparticle contact, rotational alignment, crystal lattice reconstruction, and particle merging. The critical parameter in this multistep process is lattice misorientation, which must be below 5° to allow a stable, continuous crystalline NiO interface. Opportunities for the control and visualisation of transformations in metal oxides offered by our approach provide deeper insights into the atomic mechanisms that underpin the functional properties of materials, harnessed in catalysis, magnetism, and optics, where a precise metal-metal oxide interface is essential.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了一个时间分辨成像平台与工作流，用于揭示金属与氧化物相互转化过程中原子尺度的动力学机制。作者通过控制电子—原子相互作用速率并将其与图像采集速率同步，直接追踪了NiO晶体的形成、长大、解离与烧结过程。研究还给出了氧化物晶体生长所需的临界成核尺寸，并指出(100)晶面的台阶边缘是镍原子并入晶体的重要活性位点。

articles.title: Electrical Performance of Cement Nanofiller Composites for Low-Grade Thermoelectric Energy Harvesting
articles.title_zh: 用于低品位热电能量采集的水泥纳米填料复合材料电学性能
articles.abstract: Waste heat, causing the urban heat island effect, can be channelized for the generation of low-grade waste heat from pavements and building envelopes with the use of appropriate material. Cement is a key ingredient in modern infrastructure; studies have shown that adding carbon-based nanofillers can turn it into a conductor. In the present study, the inclusion of super-grade graphene (SGG), multi-walled carbon nanotube (MWCNT), and carbon soot-based carbon nanoparticles (CNP) developed a conductive network. Significant improvement in electrical conductivity and formation of conductive pathways are evident from SEM, XRD, Raman spectroscopy, and electrical conductivity analysis. Moreover, the samples exhibited a denser microstructure. The wet method is used to cast the samples. The Four-point probe method is used to investigate electrical performance. Electrical conductivity of 0.07 S/cm at 2% dose of SGG at 60°C, 0.25 S/cm at 15% dose of MWCNT at 60°C, and 0.03 S/cm at 5% CNP at 85°C is displayed by the respective samples. Percolation threshold, tunnelling, and hopping contribute to a jump in electrical conductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究在水泥中引入石墨烯、多壁碳纳米管和碳烟纳米颗粒后形成导电网络的可行性，以提升其电导率并服务于低品位废热采集。作者结合SEM、XRD、拉曼光谱和四探针测试表明，纳米填料可显著改善导电通路并使微结构更致密。结果显示，渗流、隧穿和跳跃等机制共同促成了电导的跃升。

articles.title: Mathematical Analysis of Radiative Darcy-Forchheimer Flow of an Eyring-Powell Nanofluid over a Stretching Cylinder with Convective Heating and Chemical Reaction
articles.title_zh: 带对流加热与化学反应的Eyring-Powell纳米流体在拉伸圆柱上的辐射Darcy-Forchheimer流动数学分析
articles.abstract: The present research paper deals with the analysis of mathematical modeling of Darcy-Forchheimer flow of Eyring-Powell nanofluid over a stretching cylinder under the influence of a magnetic field, thermal radiation, convective boundary condition, chemical reaction, and Cattaneo-Christov heat and mass flux on heat and mass transfer. The resulting nonlinear partial differential equations are transformed into ordinary differential equations through similarity transformations. The derived equations are then solved through the Homotopy Analysis Method (HAM) with the aid of mathematical software. The effects of the various physical parameters on the velocity, thermal, and concentration profiles are analyzed and discussed in light of the various transport phenomena involved. It is observed that the velocity profile is inversely proportional to the values of the Darcy number and magnetic parameter, whereas an increase in the value of the Eyring-Powell fluid parameter and curvature parameter increases the velocity profile. It is also found that there is an inverse relationship between the temperature profile in the boundary layer and the value of the thermal relaxation time parameter (((łambdaₜ₎₎). Furthermore, an increase in the value of the Eyring-Powell fluid parameter leads to a reduction in the value of both the skin-friction coefficient and the Nusselt number. Lastly, the results given presently correspond in good agreement with the literature currently in publication.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文建立了Eyring-Powell纳米流体绕拉伸圆柱流动的数学模型，考虑了磁场、热辐射、对流边界条件、化学反应以及Cattaneo-Christov热/质量通量效应。控制方程经相似变换化为常微分方程，并用同伦分析法求解。作者系统讨论了各物理参数对速度、温度和浓度分布的影响，展示了多种传输机制之间的耦合关系。

articles.title: Quantum simulators gain quantitative error bars in 51-ion test
articles.title_zh: 51离子测试为量子模拟器引入定量误差条
articles.abstract: In the coming years, increasingly larger and more powerful quantum systems are expected to tackle problems that are difficult or impossible to solve using conventional computers. However, the more powerful quantum simulations become, the more difficult it is to independently verify their results. Where classical simulation is still feasible, results can be cross-checked directly; beyond that regime, other methods are needed.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇工作关注量子模拟结果的可验证性问题，特别是在系统规模扩大、经典数值模拟已难以直接交叉检查时如何量化不确定性。题目表明作者在51离子平台上给出了误差条或定量误差评估方法，用于提高量子模拟输出的可信度。由于输入摘要仅为概述，具体方法与误差定义需参考原文。

articles.title: Krypton gas emerges as a new ingredient for quantum computing
articles.title_zh: 氪气被引入量子计算相关超导薄膜制备
articles.abstract: To commercialize quantum computing, manufacturers need high-quality superconducting materials for microchips, but they also require a reliable, sustainable nanofabrication process. Tantalum is a corrosion-resistant metal that meets the first criterion but not the second. That's because it has to be deposited on a substrate at temperatures that typically exceed 400°C (752°F)—too hot for many semiconductor foundries' current tools.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道围绕量子计算芯片所需的高质量超导材料与可扩展纳米制造工艺展开。文中指出，钽虽具备耐腐蚀等优点，但常规沉积温度过高，难以兼容许多半导体工艺线现有设备。引入氪气被视为一种新的制程思路，可能有助于降低工艺温度并提升制造可行性；具体机制与实现细节需结合原文进一步确认。

articles.title: Hydrodynamization in 1D Bose gases at nonzero temperature
articles.title_zh: 非零温度下一维玻色气体中的流体化动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.16980v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hydrodynamization refers to the remarkably rapid process in relativistic heavy-ion collisions by which hydrodynamic descriptions become applicable. Following the observation of analogous behavior in ultracold one-dimensional (1D) Bose gases, hydrodynamization has been conjectured to be a universal dynamical phenomenon in quantum systems following high-energy quenches. Theoretical studies in this cold-atom setting have so far been restricted to quenches from ground states. Here we study how nonzero temperatures affect hydrodynamization. Specifically, using a homogeneous 1D gas of hard-core bosons, we explore how the initial temperature affects the timescales associated with hydrodynamization and prethermalization following a Bragg-pulse quench. We find that while the hydrodynamization coherence time remains unchanged, increasing temperature shortens both the damping time of the hydrodynamization oscillations and the prethermalization time. We argue that this is mainly the result of the broadening of the initial rapidity distribution, and introduce a nonzero-temperature dephasing time defined in terms of the extent of the rapidity distribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究非零温度如何影响一维硬核玻色气体在布拉格脉冲淬火后的流体化动力学与预热化过程。结果表明，随初始温度升高，流体化的相干时间基本不变，但振荡衰减时间和预热化时间都会缩短。作者将这一效应归因于初始快动量分布的展宽，并据此提出了基于快动量分布宽度定义的非零温度去相位时间。

articles.title: Controlling Structure and Properties of Vapor-Deposited Glasses of Organic Semiconductors: Recent Advances and Challenges
articles.title_zh: 有机半导体蒸镀玻璃的结构与性质调控：最新进展与挑战
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The last decade has seen great progress in manipulating the structure of vapor-deposited glasses of organic semiconductors. By varying the substrate temperature during deposition, glasses with a wide range of density and molecular orientation can be prepared from a given molecule. We review recent studies that show the structure of vapor-deposited glasses can be tuned to significantly improve the external quantum efficiency and lifetime of OLEDs (organic light emitting diodes). We highlight the ability of molecular simulations to reproduce experimentally observed structures, setting the stage for in-silico design of vapor-deposited glasses in the coming decade. Finally, we identify research opportunities for improving the properties of organic semiconductors by controlling the structure of vapor-deposited glasses.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇综述，系统总结了近十年来通过控制基底温度等蒸镀参数来调节有机半导体蒸镀玻璃结构的进展。作者指出，同一分子可形成密度与分子取向差异显著的玻璃态，而这些结构变化可显著提升 OLED 的外量子效率和寿命。文章还强调分子模拟在重现实验结构、推动计算设计方面的潜力，并讨论了未来进一步优化器件性能的研究方向。

articles.title: Demonstration of a scalable all-solid-state refrigerator exploiting diffusion geometries and limiting interfacial conductances at temperatures below 1
articles.title_zh: 基于扩散几何与界面导热受限机制的可扩展全固态制冷机演示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.17125v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid-state refrigerators using Normal-metal/Insulator/Superconductor (NIS) junctions have previously demonstrated excellent electron cooling but limited ability to cool phonons. The energy gap of the superconductor is used as an energy filter to allow higher than average energy electrons to preferentially tunnel from the normal-metal through the insulator into the superconductor where they travel as quasi-particles. Typically, the heat is moved and work is done to deposit hot quasi-particles into a normal-metal quasi-particle trap for rejection to the next refrigeration stage. Realizing that (1) the quasi-particles flow diffusively, driven by a concentration gradient in the electric field-free superconductor, and (2) that the undesirable backwards leaking of heat from the hot-side trap can be reduced by engineering the geometry and materials at the superconductor-to-trap interface, enhanced cooling can be achieved. Fabrication of the refrigerator was accomplished using a tungsten and titanium-tungsten alloy as the cold-side normal-metal, aluminum oxide as the insulator, aluminum as the superconductor, and gold as the trap, with the cold-side NIS portion being attached to the hot-side gold trap by bump bonding. The refrigerator consisted of 1121 junction pairs, each pair being an SINIS unit, all electrically connected in series. Using this we have measured the effective phonon temperature of a 3.9 mm x 3.9 mm x 0.65 mm silicon chip driven down to 70 mK from a bath temperature of 120 mK, and down to 174 mK from a 271 mK rejection temperature (a cooling of -97 mK). This is the first demonstration of the sub 1 K cooling of an entire silicon chip using NIS junctions.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文展示了一种基于 NIS（正常金属/绝缘体/超导体）结的全固态制冷方案，重点提升了电子冷却能力，并尝试增强对晶格声子热的抽运。作者利用超导体中的扩散过程以及对超导体-俘获层界面导热的工程化限制，降低热回流并提高制冷效率。器件采用钨和钛钨合金作为冷端正常金属、氧化铝作为势垒、铝作为超导体、金作为准粒子俘获层，展示了面向低温集成应用的可扩展性。
