articles.abstract_zh: 该工作围绕 Ti 基 MXene 与 MoS₂ 范德华异质结构中的莫尔超胞展开，重点讨论其激子态分布及能带对齐特征。作者从标题所示结果指向准 I 型带边排列及由莫尔调制带来的激子景观变化。该研究有助于理解二维异质结构中的光电响应与激子工程，具体模型与定量结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Arsenical bronze at Jinsha: Evidence for technological transmission and adaptive alloying in Bronze Age Southwest China
articles.title_zh: 金沙遗址的砷青铜：青铜时代中国西南地区技术传播与适应性合金化的证据
articles.abstract: Arsenical bronze is well documented in northwestern China but remains poorly understood in Southwest China. This study presents the first archaeometallurgical investigation of twelve arsenic-bearing bronze artefacts from the Jinsha site (c. 1600–600 BCE), integrating metallography, elemental composition, and lead isotope analyses. Arsenic contents exceeding 2 wt.% occur in both binary Cu–As and quaternary Cu–Sn–Pb–As alloys, demonstrating intentional alloying rather than the incidental use of arsenic-rich ores. Metallographic evidence indicates that different alloy recipes were selected to achieve distinct technological properties. Lead isotope data reveal diverse metal sources, suggesting flexible metal procurement rather than reliance on a specialized ore supply. These findings provide the first clear evidence for intentional arsenical bronze production at Jinsha, extending the known distribution of this technology in ancient China and indicating its transmission through interregional exchange networks and local adaptation in Southwest China.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究首次对金沙遗址出土的 12 件含砷青铜器进行冶金学分析，综合了金相、元素组成和铅同位素数据。结果显示，部分器物中砷含量超过 2 wt.% ，且同时存在二元 Cu–As 与四元 Cu–Sn–Pb–As 合金，说明砷并非偶然杂入，而是被有意用于合金配制。铅同位素证据表明金属来源多样，反映出灵活的原料获取方式，以及砷青铜技术经由区域交流网络传播后在西南地区的本地化适应。

articles.title: Mechanical Deterioration and Micro-macro Damage Evolution Mechanisms of Underground Reservoir Coal-Pillar Dams Subjected to Drying-Wetting Cycles
articles.title_zh: 干湿循环作用下地下储库煤柱坝的力学劣化与微-宏观损伤演化机制
articles.abstract: Utilizing underground mine reservoirs for pumped storage power stations represents a highly promising approach for large-scale energy storage. However, the long-term exposure of coal pillar dams to drying-wetting cycles (DWC) poses a severe risk of structural instability. This study investigated the mechanical degradation and damage mechanisms of coal specimens, leveraging triaxial loading coupled with acoustic emission (AE) and nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) monitoring. The results indicated that the compressive strength and cohesion underwent non-uniform, multi-stage degradation with increasing DWC, with the most acute deterioration occurring after the first cycle. AE monitoring revealed that with increasing DWC, the frequency of high-amplitude AE events escalated, and their peaks shifted forward. Concurrently, the overall b-value exhibited a downward trend. Analysis of the RA-AF characteristics confirmed that the proportion of shear fracture events escalated significantly with increasing DWC, triggering a failure mode transition from micro-tensile cracking to macro-shear sliding. NMR testing showed that the T2 spectra exhibited a predominantly unimodal distribution, with micropores dominating the pore network. Under the action of DWC, the dissolution and spalling of hydrophilic minerals drove the transformation of internal micropores and mesopores into macropores. These findings provide a theoretical foundation for the stability assessment of underground reservoir-based PHES systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究以三轴加载结合声发射和核磁共振监测，考察干湿循环对煤柱坝材料力学性能与损伤演化的影响。结果表明，抗压强度和黏聚力随循环次数增加呈非均匀、多阶段衰减，其中首轮循环造成的劣化最为显著。声发射与 RA-AF 分析显示，随干湿循环增加，强剪切破坏比例上升，破坏模式由微张拉裂纹逐步转变为宏观剪切滑移；核磁共振结果则表明孔隙结构持续演化并加剧损伤累积。

articles.title: Overt intentions for answers Yes and No are influenced by feedback and context
articles.title_zh: 答案“是”与“否”的外显意图会受反馈与上下文影响
articles.abstract: Binary agreement and disagreement mental responses represent a promising way for communicating in brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) and BCI feedback verification. However, neural signatures of these mental reactions including error-related potentials (ErrPs) and other disagreement-related evoked activity, remain insufficiently studied due to lack of appropriate experimental paradigm provoking these reactions which in turn hinders their application in the mental control loop. In the present study, we introduce an experimental paradigm inspired by the "Akinator" game to investigate neural signatures of mental (dis-)agreement under various conditions. We found that both the amplitude and temporal characteristics of cortical activity related to agreement and disagreement responses including P3a and N270 components are influenced by various factors such as presentation sequence, stimulus context, and the semantic category of the stimulus. This research contributes to understanding the potential applications of such responses in neurointerface loops incorporating visual feedback and provides further insight into the relationship between these binary agreement and disagreement responses and the underlying mechanisms of attention and working memory.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种受“Akinator”游戏启发的实验范式，用于研究二元赞同/反对反应在脑机接口中的神经表征。结果表明，与赞同和反对相关的皮层活动，其幅值和时间特征会受到呈现顺序、刺激上下文以及语义类别等因素影响，涉及 P3a 和 N270 等成分。该工作为在含视觉反馈的神经接口回路中利用此类二元反应提供了实验基础。

articles.title: Chitosan/PVA nanocomposite incorporated with Momordica charantia extract and green synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles for combating multidrug resistant diabetic foot ulcer pathogens and accelerating wound healing
articles.title_zh: 掺入苦瓜提取物与绿色合成氧化锌纳米粒子的壳聚糖/PVA 纳米复合膜：用于对抗多药耐药糖尿病足溃疡病原体并促进伤口愈合
articles.abstract: In the present study, a chitosan/polyvinyl alcohol (CS/PVA) nanocomposite film incorporated with Momordica charantia extract (ME) and green synthesized zinc oxide nanoparticles (ZnONPs) has been fabricated and evaluated for in vitro wound healing potential. The green synthesized ZnONPs were characterized by using UV-Visible spectroscopy, Fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR), X-ray diffraction (XRD), thermogravimetric analysis (TGA), differential scanning calorimetry (DSC), field emission scanning electron microscopy (FE-SEM) equipped with energy dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HR-TEM). The developed thin films were also characterized by using FT-IR, TGA and FE-SEM analysis. Water vapor transmission rate and moisture content were also evaluated to determine breathability of wound dressing. The nanocomposite prepared in the study was found to have optimized water contact angle of 67.37° suggesting to have favourable wettability for maintaining the moist environment as desirable for the chronic wound healing. Antibacterial assays have further confirmed the significant inhibitory activity of synthesized ZnONPs and the bionanocomposite against various bacteria and multidrug resistant Staphylococcus aureus, Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae isolated from diabetic foot ulcer (DFUs). Furthermore, the synergistic interaction between ZnONPs and the phytoconstituents of M. charantia was found to significantly enhance the antimicrobial and wound healing properties. The MTT assay results revealed the non-toxic nature of ZnONPs in mouse L929 fibroblast cell lines. Furthermore, the scratch wound healing assay has revealed the ZnONPs treatment to significantly enhance the fibroblast migration, to result in substantial wound closure within 72 h. These findings indicate that the CS/PVA/ZnONPs/M. charantia nanocomposite film prepared in the study is a promising cost-effective nanotherapeutic alternative for managing bacterial pathogens associated with DFUs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了掺入苦瓜提取物和绿色合成 ZnO 纳米粒子的壳聚糖/聚乙烯醇纳米复合薄膜，并评估其体外创面修复潜力。作者对 ZnO 纳米粒子及复合膜进行了 UV-Vis、FT-IR、XRD、TGA、DSC、SEM/EDX 和 HR-TEM 等表征，同时测试了透湿性、含水量和润湿性。结果表明，该薄膜具有适合维持湿润创面环境的表面性质，并显示出较强的抗菌活性，适用于抑制糖尿病足溃疡相关耐药病原体。

articles.title: Fluorine-Free Superhydrophobic BiFeO₃@g-C₃N₄/TEOS-PDMS Cotton Fabric with Magnetic Recoverability for Oil–Water Separation and Z-Scheme Photocatalytic Dye Degradation
articles.title_zh: 无氟超疏水 BiFeO₃@g-C₃N₄/TEOS-PDMS 棉织物：具磁可回收性、用于油水分离与 Z 型光催化染料降解
articles.abstract: In this study, a fluorine-free, eco-friendly BiFeO₃@g-C₃N₄/TEOS-PDMS hybrid-coated smart cotton fabric was successfully developed via an integrated sol-gel and dip-coating approach for multifunctional environmental remediation. Comprehensive structural, morphological, and spectroscopic analyzes (XRD, FTIR, SEM-EDX, XPS, VSM, and DRS) confirmed the uniform anchoring of the magnetic perovskite BiFeO₃ and g-C₃N₄ nanocomposite onto the cellulosic fibers through a cross-linked siloxane network. The modified fabric exhibits exceptional superhydrophobic/superoleophilic wettability with water contact angles exceeding 165°, outstanding mechanical durability against abrasion, and a gravity-driven oil-water separation efficiency greater than 99% for both light and heavy organic solvents. Furthermore, the embedded ferromagnetic BiFeO₃ nanoparticles enable remotely controllable active oil collection under an external magnetic field. Under UVA and visible-light irradiation, the hybrid textile achieves superior Rhodamine B degradation efficiencies of 77% and 83%, respectively, driven by a direct Z-scheme charge-transfer mechanism that effectively preserves strong redox potentials while simultaneously generating superoxide and hydroxyl radicals. The multifunctional platform maintains high stability, structural integrity, and reusability over 10 consecutive separation cycles and 5 photocatalytic cycles, offering a sustainable and versatile approach for industrial wastewater treatment and oil spill cleanup.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究通过溶胶-凝胶与浸涂结合的方法，在棉织物上构建了无氟、环境友好的 BiFeO₃@g-C₃N₄/TEOS-PDMS 复合涂层。结构与谱学表征表明，磁性钙钛矿 BiFeO₃ 和 g-C₃N₄ 纳米复合物通过交联硅氧网络均匀锚定在纤维表面，使织物表现出超过 165° 的超疏水性和优异的机械耐磨性。该织物对轻、重有机溶剂均具有超过 99% 的重力驱动油水分离效率，并可在外加磁场下实现主动油液收集；同时在 UVA 和可见光下分别实现 Rhodamine B 的高效降解，机理归因于直接 Z 型电荷转移。

articles.title: Quantum advantage reassessed: More realistic benchmarks for quantum algorithms
articles.title_zh: 量子优势再审视：更现实的量子算法基准
articles.abstract: Quantum advantage refers to the point at which a quantum computer solves a clearly defined task faster or more efficiently than any classical computer—or makes it solvable in the first place. For many practical applications, this has not yet been demonstrated. Research therefore relies heavily on theoretical models and simulations to explore where and under what conditions such an advantage may realistically be achieved in the future.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道讨论了“量子优势”这一概念在现实场景中的重新评估，即量子计算机何时能在明确任务上真正超越经典计算机。文章强调，仅凭理想化模型往往不足以判断实际可行性，因此需要采用更贴近真实应用的基准来衡量量子算法的优势边界。其核心关注点是未来量子优势可能出现的条件、适用任务与评价标准。

articles.title: Long-sought Zhang-Rice singlet visualized directly in cuprate superconductor
articles.title_zh: 长期追寻的 Zhang-Rice 单态在铜酸盐超导体中被直接可视化
articles.abstract: Superconductors are materials that conduct electricity with zero electrical resistance below specific temperatures. Most of these materials become superconducting at very low temperatures, but some also exhibit superconductivity at higher temperatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道指向在铜基高温超导体中直接观测到长期被理论预言的 Zhang-Rice 单态，这是理解铜氧平面强关联电子结构的重要进展。该结果有助于澄清空穴在铜-氧轨道中的局域化方式及其与超导机制的关联。具体实验手段、样品体系和定量分析需结合原文进一步阅读。

articles.title: Ripple Signatures of Majorana Hybridization across a Topological Quantum Quench
articles.title_zh: 跨越拓扑量子淬火的 Majorana 杂化涟漪特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10052v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The crossover between topology and nonequilibrium dynamics has emerged as a rich frontier, in which quantum systems can exhibit unique dynamical phenomena that lie beyond the reach of equilibrium. Of particular interest are quench dynamics across topological phase, as it may reveal the information about the underlying Majorana zero-energy states. Here, we investigate the fate of Majorana boundary modes in a quenched fermionic superfluid using self-consistent time-dependent Bogoliubov-de Gennes theory. For quantum quenches within the topological regime, Majorana boundary modes survive but undergo coherent boundary oscillations arising from the nonadiabatic deformation of their wave functions. Furthermore, a pronounced ripple pattern appears in the post-quench density distribution following a sudden topology-changing quench. Here we identify that these ripple structures originates from the coherent hybridization and interference of the initially separated Majorana boundary states. Our findings establish nonequilibrium boundary dynamics as a new approach for probing Majorana physics, which is complementary to conventional equilibrium measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用自洽的时变 Bogoliubov-de Gennes 理论，研究了费米超流体在拓扑量子淬火过程中 Majorana 边界模的命运。结果表明，在拓扑相内淬火时，Majorana 边界模仍可存活，但会因波函数非绝热变形而产生相干的边界振荡。若发生跨越拓扑相变的突变淬火，淬火后的密度分布会出现明显涟漪结构，其来源是初始分离的 Majorana 边界态发生相干杂化与干涉。
authors: Xin-Xin Wang, Jin-Xin Li, Ya-Wen Tang, Lu Qin, Zun-Lue Zhu, Wu-Ming Liu, Liang-Liang Wang, Xing-Dong Zhao

articles.title: Cell Natural Orbitals in Quantum Materials
articles.title_zh: 量子材料中的晶胞自然轨道
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Understanding correlated quantum matter starts with an accurate model of the single-particle states that interact at low energies: their dispersion, band geometry, orbital content and charge density. In many cases, notably the topological bands of moire materials, it is not straightforward to find a real-space description with a few local orbitals that accomplishes this task. Here we provide a systematic way to identify the local degrees of freedom that best capture the band geometry and charge density of any chosen set of bands. We use the unit-cell one-particle reduced density matrix (UC-1pRDM), obtained by restricting the projector onto the target bands to a single unit cell. Its eigenstates, which we call cell natural orbitals (CNOs), form a local, symmetric basis uniquely determined by the Bloch wavefunctions and the choice of real-space partition. Their eigenvalues measure the occupation of each CNO in the target bands, quantifying entanglement across unit-cell boundaries and the importance of multi-orbital character. A set of CNOs that maximizes total spectral weight and reproduces the target band symmetries provides optimal trial states for Wannierization. We exemplify this by constructing a lattice model for twisted bilayer WSe₂ that tracks the orbital content across twist angles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种从目标能带的布洛赫波函数中系统提取局域自由度的方法，用于刻画低能单粒子态的色散、带几何、轨道成分和电荷密度。作者构造限制在单个晶胞内的单粒子约化密度矩阵，其本征态被定义为晶胞自然轨道，本征值量化目标能带在这些局域轨道上的权重以及跨晶胞边界的纠缠。选取总谱权重最大且保持目标能带对称性的晶胞自然轨道，可为莫尔拓扑能带等难以建立少轨道实空间模型的体系提供优化基组。
authors: Harshitra Mahalingam, Nishchhal Verma, Daniel Muñoz-Segovia, Raquel Queiroz

articles.title: Some features of high-temperature superconductivity on flat bands
articles.title_zh: 平带高温超导的若干特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10231v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this letter, we examine how the presence of flat band leads to the formation of a high-temperature superconductor even in the case of repulsive pairing interactions. We also show that in the case of flat bands, the high-temperature superconducting state deforms the flat band, tilting it and making the effective mass finite. As a result, neither the superfluid weight nor the supercurrent disappear. Our results are in good agreement with experimental data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论平带如何在甚至存在排斥配对相互作用时促进高温超导态形成。作者指出，在平带情形下，超导态会使平带发生形变和倾斜，从而产生有限有效质量，因此超流权重和超电流不会消失。文中声称理论结果与实验数据符合较好。
authors: V. R. Shaginyan, A. Z. Msezane, S. A. Artamonov

articles.title: Experimental Visualization of a Fermi Gas
articles.title_zh: 费米气体的实验可视化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10313v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES) can measure electrons' energy vs momentum relations in solids via photoelectric effect. This pedagogical paper experimental results from this technique as a tool for visualizing the Fermi gas model in quantum statistical mechanics. This model is an important starting point for understanding more complex electronic behaviors in real metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 这是一篇教学性文章，介绍如何利用角分辨光电子能谱通过光电效应测量固体中电子能量—动量关系。作者将ARPES实验结果作为量子统计力学中费米气体模型的直观可视化工具。该模型被强调为理解真实金属中更复杂电子行为的重要起点。

articles.title: Universal Density Control of Surface Reconstruction in Two-Dimensional Metals
articles.title_zh: 二维金属表面重构的普适密度控制规律
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10432v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a unified thickness criterion for surface reconstruction in ultrathin metal sheets. The critical thickness is governed by the change in surface atomic density upon reconstruction: thinning always favors structural changes that increase this density. Thus, thinning suppresses the (1x2) reconstruction of 5d noble metal (110) sheets but promotes the quasi-hexagonal reconstruction of 4d noble metal (001) sheets. Density functional calculations validate these trends and show only minor corrections from surface stress and quantum-oscillation effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出超薄金属片表面重构的统一厚度判据：临界厚度由重构引起的表面原子密度变化控制，减薄总是有利于提高表面原子密度的结构变化。由此，减薄会抑制5d贵金属(110)薄片的(1×2)重构，却促进4d贵金属(001)薄片的准六角重构。密度泛函计算验证了这些趋势，并表明表面应力和量子振荡效应只带来较小修正。

articles.title: Higher-Order Topological States with Cleavage-Dependent Dirac Mass
articles.title_zh: 具有解理依赖Dirac质量的高阶拓扑态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Topological quantum chemistry based on local charge profiles lacks predictive power for the crystalline cleavage of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs). By cleaving an obstructed atomic insulator, we discover a topological phase characterized by e/2 fractional charges localized at precisely half of the corners, while the remaining empty corners host complementary vacancies of interstice charge. These zero-energy charge-vacancies and topological corners form a spatially balanced geometry, confined separately by C2 rotation symmetry. Crucially, we demonstrate that the emergence of corner zero modes dictates that specific dangling bonds-acting as the mass of a Dirac fermion-must explicitly expose in, and subtly slope toward, the corner regions. This strict directionality is verified by the anisotropic evolution of the mass term within a (2+1)-dimensional parameter space. Moreover, we find that the topological corners acquire lower entanglement entropy compared to the bulk, a behavior opposite to that of the real-space energy distribution.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者指出，基于局域电荷分布的拓扑量子化学不足以预测高阶拓扑绝缘体的晶体解理行为。通过解理阻塞原子绝缘体，文中发现一种相：e/2分数电荷精确局域在一半角点，其他空角点承载互补的间隙电荷空位，二者在C2旋转对称性约束下空间分离且平衡。研究进一步表明，角点零模的出现要求特定悬挂键作为Dirac费米子的质量项显式暴露并向角区倾斜，且拓扑角点的纠缠熵低于体区。
authors: Hongyu Chen, Min Long, Chuang Chen, Zi Yang Meng

articles.title: Topological states of generalized dissipative Majorana wires
articles.title_zh: 广义耗散Majorana线的拓扑态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the generalized one-dimensional (1D) quantum dissipative models corresponding to a Majorana wire which can possess more than one Majorana bound state at each end. The system consists of a 1D fermionic open quantum system whose dynamics is governed by a quadratic Lindblad equation. Using the adjoint Lindblad equation for the fermionic two-point correlations, we find the gaps in the damping and purity spectra of a generic 1D model. Then, using the symmetry-based classification, we show that a winding number as the topological invariant can be defined which distinguishes different steady states of the system in the presence of damping and purity gaps. Then we focus on certain models with different Lindblad quantum jump terms and explore their phase diagrams by calculating the damping and the purity gaps as well as the winding number. In particular, we show that by inclusion of quantum jumps between next-nearest-neighbor sites, higher winding numbers and, equivalently, more Majorana bound states can be achieved. Also, by introducing imbalanced couplings, we can switch between states with negative and positive winding numbers. Finally, we should mention that since our formulation is based on the fermionic correlations rather than the Majorana operators, it can be easily extended to the dissipative topological phases belonging to other symmetry classes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一维开放费米体系中的广义耗散Majorana线，其每个端点可支持多个Majorana束缚态，动力学由二次Lindblad方程控制。作者利用费米双点关联的伴随Lindblad方程求取阻尼谱隙和纯度谱隙，并基于对称性分类定义绕数作为区分不同稳态的拓扑不变量。通过考察不同量子跳跃项的模型，文中显示次近邻跳跃可实现更高绕数和更多端点Majorana束缚态，而不平衡耦合可在正、负绕数相之间切换。

articles.title: Geometric Phonon Energy Pumping in a Layer-Hybridized Moiré Exciton Manifold
articles.title_zh: 层杂化莫尔激子流形中的几何声子能量泵浦
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10631v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Slow cyclic modulation of an open quantum system can generate a geometric contribution to its energy transfer statistics, separable from the dynamic background. In this work we construct an experimentally anchored four state open system model for a gate-tunable WSe2/WS2 moiré exciton manifold within a population level full counting statistics framework. We first drive the system uniformly through a closed gate and pump loop and separate the geometric contribution from the dynamic background by reversing the loop direction. We then examine how this response changes with environmental rates, exciton coupling, control conditions, and static spectral broadening. A shorter cycle period followed by nonuniform traversal of the driving loop substantially improves detectability while preserving the geometric response. Combined with enhanced phonon relaxation and reduced radiative loss, this gives about a fourteenfold fixed time signal to noise gain relative to the uniform loop. Our results show that the geometric phonon response remains robust against realistic variations in the system and its environment, and that we can improve its detectability more effectively by suppressing dynamical noise through frequency modulated driving.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构建了一个面向栅压可调WSe2/WS2莫尔激子流形的四态开放量子系统模型，并在布居层面的全计数统计框架下研究慢周期调制产生的几何能量转移。作者通过反向驱动回路将几何贡献与动力学背景分离，并分析环境速率、激子耦合、控制条件和静态谱展宽的影响。结果表明，缩短周期并采用非均匀回路遍历可显著提高可探测性；结合增强声子弛豫和降低辐射损耗，可在固定时间内获得约十四倍信噪比提升，且几何声子响应对现实参数变化较稳健。
authors: Bitap Raj Thakuria, Himangshu Prabal Goswami

articles.title: Two-component ultracold Bose gases with spin-orbit coupling
articles.title_zh: 具有自旋—轨道耦合的双组分超冷玻色气体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10722v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: These lecture notes provide an introduction to Bose-Einstein condensates with Raman-induced spin-orbit coupling. Owing to the interplay between the peculiar single-particle dispersion, featuring a double-minimum structure, and the two-body interaction, these systems possess a complex phase diagram. Three different quantum phases can be observed, i.e., a stripe, a plane-wave, and a single-minimum phase, each characterized by different broken symmetries. The condensate dynamics is also significantly affected by the spin-orbit coupling, as revealed by the behavior of the Bogoliubov spectrum in infinite systems and the behavior of the discretized collective mode frequencies in trapped configurations, especially close to the phase transitions. In turn, the superfluid and rotational properties are also deeply modified by the coupling between the motional and spin degree of freedom. Finally, a special attention is devoted to the stripe phase and its supersolid character, which can be clearly revealed by the study of its dynamic features.
articles.abstract_zh: 这些讲义介绍拉曼诱导自旋—轨道耦合的玻色—爱因斯坦凝聚体。由于具有双极小结构的单粒子色散与两体相互作用相互竞争，体系呈现条纹相、平面波相和单极小相三类量子相，并伴随不同的对称性破缺。讲义还讨论自旋—轨道耦合对Bogoliubov谱、俘获体系集体模、超流性质和转动响应的影响，并特别强调条纹相的超固体特征及其动力学表征。

articles.title: Composite-Boson Ansatz for Fractional Quantum Hall Manifolds of Lattice Bosons at Generic Fillings ν<1/2
articles.title_zh: 通用填充ν<1/2下晶格玻色子分数量子霍尔流形的复合玻色子拟设
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hofstadter systems provide a lattice route to fractional quantum Hall physics, but their low-energy manifolds often lack simple wave-function descriptions. Here we present a composite-boson ansatz for a broad family of finite-size lattice-split Laughlin-quasihole manifolds in the low-flux Hofstadter--Bose--Hubbard model on a torus at generic fillings (ν<1/2). Attaching two vortices to each boson yields reduced-flux orbitals from which we construct a many-body trial basis. Its translation-resolved rank reproduces the expected low-energy-manifold dimension and provides a composite-boson interpretation of the established quasihole counting previously inferred from generalized exclusion rules and thin-torus arguments. For smaller systems, diagonalization within the lowest-band-projected ansatz span closely reproduces the exact projected spectrum, while variational Monte Carlo extends the rank and energetic analysis to larger systems for which explicit subspace construction becomes costly. To probe the fractional quantum Hall character of these manifolds, we calculate their many-body Chern-numbers and show that localized added-flux excitations exhibit quasihole-like behavior, with fractional density depletion and an Aharonov--Bohm-free braiding phase that both track the effective filling. Together, these results establish a microscopic composite-boson framework for organizing a broad family of sub-half-filled fractional quantum Hall manifolds of lattice bosons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对低磁通Hofstadter–Bose–Hubbard模型中有限尺寸、晶格劈裂的Laughlin准空穴低能流形，提出适用于ν<1/2通用填充的复合玻色子试探波函数框架。通过为每个玻色子附着两个涡旋，作者构造约化磁通轨道和多体试探基，其按平移量子数分解的秩再现预期低能流形维数，并为既有准空穴计数提供复合玻色子解释。小体系中，在最低能带投影拟设空间内对角化可较好重现实验精确投影谱；较大体系则用变分蒙特卡洛扩展秩与能量分析，并进一步计算多体Chern数以检验分数量子霍尔特征。
authors: Umut Can Turhan, A. Levent Subaşi, Rifat Onur Umucalilar

articles.title: High-pressure electride superconductor Li5N for multifunctional applications: A theoretical insight into the physical properties
articles.title_zh: 面向多功能应用的高压电子化物超导体Li5N：物性理论研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This study aims to unveil the physical properties of multifunctional Li5N electride under high pressure in the range of 150-350 GPa through first principles analysis within the density functional theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论第一性原理计算，考察150–350 GPa高压范围内多功能电子化物Li5N的物理性质。摘要信息较简略，主要表明工作关注其高压稳定性、电子结构及可能的超导相关性质，具体结果和数值需查阅原文。
authors: M. Abdul Hadi Shah, S. H. Naqib

articles.title: Future perspective of muons; a quantum particle measuring quantum processes
articles.title_zh: μ子的未来视角：测量量子过程的量子粒子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10856v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Although considered a niche technique, muon spectroscopy provides a unique and complementary insight into a range of different materials from hard condensed matter to biological samples and everything in between. In matter, the muon has a mass of frac19~mₚ or 207~mₑ, and is a local probe of quantum states that can provide a focus on the bulk properties of materials. While often interpreted in a classical framework, the muon is itself a quantum particle and it is increasingly common for researchers to take account of this when thinking about muon spectroscopy experiments. In this perspective, we focus on the power of using this quantum treatment of muon spectroscopy, which is a key future direction for the technique.
articles.abstract_zh: 该观点文章讨论μ子谱学作为局域探针在从硬凝聚态材料到生物样品等体系中的独特作用。作者强调，尽管μ子实验常以经典框架解释，但μ子本身是量子粒子，其质量介于质子和电子尺度之间，可探测材料体相量子态。文章认为，在μ子谱学实验与数据解释中显式采用量子处理，是该技术未来发展的关键方向。
authors: Adam Berlie, Sayani Biswas, Alex Louat, Rhea Stewart, John Wilkinson

articles.title: Inferring stealthy hyperuniform correlations from quantum transport
articles.title_zh: 从量子输运反推出隐身超均匀关联
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11188v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Stealthy hyperuniform disordered systems exhibit strongly suppressed long-wavelength fluctuations, producing correlated disorder with unusual consequences for wave propagation. A central quantity characterizing these systems is the stealthiness parameter ḩi, which controls the range of excluded Fourier components in the disorder spectrum. However, in realistic settings, the microscopic disorder configuration may not be directly accessible, making it challenging to determine ḩi from structural information alone. Here, we propose a conductance-based inverse protocol to recover stealthy hyperuniform correlations from transport data. As a proof of concept, we study spinless fermions in a one-dimensional tight-binding chain connected to clean semi-infinite leads, with on-site disorder generated by imposing a stealthy spectrum S(k)=Θ(|k|-K), where K=2πḩi. The energy-dependent transmittance is computed using a recursive Green's function method and compared with target spectra through a misfit function defined over an energy window. We show that the position of the sharp drop separating high- and low-transmittance regions is strongly controlled by ḩi, while the disorder strength W mainly affects the absolute magnitude of the transmittance. As a result, the misfit function displays a clear minimum close to the target stealthy parameter. Our results demonstrate that transmittance spectra can serve as fingerprints of stealthy hyperuniform disorder, providing a practical route to infer correlated-disorder parameters from transport measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于电导的反演方案，用输运数据恢复隐身超均匀无序体系中的关联特征，尤其是控制无序谱中排除傅里叶分量范围的隐身参数χ。作为概念验证，作者研究连接洁净半无限导线的一维紧束缚自旋less费米链，并通过递归格林函数计算能量依赖透射率。结果表明，高透射与低透射区域之间的陡降位置强烈受隐身参数控制，因此可通过与目标透射谱的失配函数比较来推断相关无序的结构信息。
authors: Natanael C. Costa, Mauro S. Ferreira, Caio Lewenkopf, Felipe A. Pinheiro, Paul J. Steinhardt, Salvatore Torquato, Carlo Vanoni

articles.title: Floquet Green's functions for lattice electrons driven by Gaussian quantum light
articles.title_zh: 高斯量子光驱动晶格电子的 Floquet 格林函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11189v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We formulate Floquet Green's functions for noninteracting single-band lattice electrons driven by a reservoir-stabilized single-mode Gaussian quantum light source. The source is prescribed externally and is not updated by the many-electron polarization, while an active electronic probe still conditions the source evolution through the Peierls coupling. The two time arguments of a Green's function share one source history: the lesser and greater components are obtained by convolving a shared-history four-endpoint kernel with the continuous bath kernels before the final source trace, while the bath canonical anticommutation relation yields an equal-time covariance that seeds the retarded and advanced one-leg propagations. The Peierls coupling is treated nonperturbatively within the prescribed-source model, and classical Floquet theory is recovered in the appropriate limit. Numerical calculations on a minimal one-dimensional model show finite-coupling quantum-source corrections beyond a prescribed classical drive, together with spectral reconstruction and occupancy redistribution for squeezed vacuum and squeezed coherent sources. The squeezing parameter and phase provide additional control knobs, beyond classical amplitude modulation, for both sideband structure and occupied weight. This work provides a theoretical framework for quantum Floquet engineering of condensed matter with an externally prescribed quantum light source.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者建立了非相互作用单带晶格电子在储库稳定的单模高斯量子光源驱动下的 Floquet 格林函数形式主义，其中光源外加给定，不由多电子极化自洽更新，但电子探针可通过 Peierls 耦合条件化光源演化。该方法以共享光源历史处理格林函数的双时间结构，非微扰纳入 Peierls 耦合，并在相应极限恢复经典 Floquet 理论。一维最小模型计算显示，相比预设经典驱动，有限耦合量子光源会带来谱重构、占据重分布以及压缩真空/压缩相干源相关修正。

articles.title: States dressing analysis in a transmon-transmon-bus system
articles.title_zh: transmon–transmon–bus 体系中的态修饰分析
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.11514v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The multi-qubit gates fidelity of superconducting quantum processors can be limited due to the dressing of computational states by noncomputational ones. Here, we experimentally and analytically investigate a transmon-transmon-bus system where the computational states dressing is tunable over a broad range. We estimate the dressing using three methods: a full three-element model, an effective mode approach, and an unperturbed mode approach. The obtained results highlight the importance of the accurate estimation and control of the computational states dressing in order to optimize gates on superconducting platform.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究超导量子处理器中计算态被非计算态修饰所导致的多量子比特门保真度限制。作者对一个 transmon–transmon–bus 体系进行实验与解析分析，并用三元件完整模型、有效模方法和未扰动模方法估计态修饰程度。结果强调，为优化超导平台上的量子门，需要准确评估并控制计算态修饰。
authors: P. A. Gladilovich, R. A. Migdisov, A. V. Sabluk, P. S. Burtsev, N. N. Abramov, N. Y. Rudenko, V. I. Chichkov, N. A. Maleeva

articles.title: State preparation via measurement and feedback: pushing relations, state structures, and non-invertible symmetries
articles.title_zh: 通过测量与反馈制备量子态：推移关系、态结构与不可逆对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.08821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum circuits with measurements and unitary feedback (MF) can prepare long-range entangled states in constant depth, but a systematic construction of the MF preparation circuit for a given target state remains underexplored. We develop such a scheme for one-dimensional states, based on the notion of pushable defects: virtual-bond operators of a matrix product state that can be pushed through the tensor at the price of a physical feedback unitary. We show that the set of pushable defects, together with their pushing relations classifies finite-depth MF-preparable states and dictates their preparation circuits. To each class of the target state |Aångle, we associate a state |Bångle from which |Aångle can be prepared using a 1-round MF circuit; in particular, |Aångle is preparable from a product state using a circuit with 1 round of MF whenever |Bångle is preparable by a finite-depth local unitary (FDLU) circuit. For a general target state, the scheme is obtained by iterating this procedure until the associated state is FDLU-preparable. For open-boundary matrix product states, the scheme is complete: it constructs a preparation circuit whenever finite-depth MF preparation with left-conditioned feedback corrections is possible. Pushable defects and pushing relations thus emerge as a unifying principle for quantum state preparation via measurements and feedback. This characterization further reveals an intrinsic connection between MF circuits and non-invertible symmetries: states with certain classes of pushing relations are related to a product state by Tambara-Yamagami duality operators, or by continuous cosine symmetry operators with fusion rules Lα Lα' = Lα₊α' + Lα₋α', together with their generalizations up to (not necessarily transversal) gates.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一维长程纠缠态的测量—反馈常深度制备方案，核心是矩阵乘积态虚键算符的“可推移缺陷”：缺陷可穿过张量，同时代价为物理反馈幺正操作。可推移缺陷及其推移关系分类有限深度测量—反馈可制备态，并决定相应制备线路。对开边界矩阵乘积态，该方案给出完备构造；一般目标态可通过迭代关联态直至其可由有限深度局域幺正线路制备。
authors: Yabo Li, Aditi Mitra, Tsung-Cheng Lu

articles.title: Observation of node-dependent Rydberg molecular bound states
articles.title_zh: 节点依赖的里德堡分子束缚态观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.09950v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ultralong-range Rydberg molecules, formed by the interaction between a highly excited Rydberg atom and a ground-state atom, provide a unique platform for exploring quantum phenomena spanning nanometer-to-micrometer distances as well as exotic few-body interactions. The formation mechanisms and resultant physical properties differ markedly between s-wave and p-wave scattering channels. Here we report the experimental observation of node-dependent p-wave molecular signals in Rb(nS)-Rb(5S) Rydberg molecular spectra, where variations in the principal quantum number n directly reveal the shift of molecular binding energies induced by the moving nodal structure of the Rydberg electron wavefunction. This node-dependence is attributed to a cooperative effect between the local gradient of the nS-electron wavefunction and the energydependent p-wave scattering length. In addition, resolving two p-wave bound states associated with adjacent nodes highlights the remarkable sub-nanometer spatial resolution achieved in our experiment. Our findings reveal a more profound quantum control mechanism, wherein the principal quantum number acts as a switch for nodal-selective molecular bound states, and the reported method provides a sensitive spectroscopic probe of electron-atom scattering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该实验在 Rb(nS)–Rb(5S) 超长程里德堡分子光谱中观测到节点依赖的 p 波分子信号，主量子数变化直接反映里德堡电子波函数节点移动引起的分子束缚能位移。该节点依赖性来源于 nS 电子波函数局域梯度与能量依赖 p 波散射长度的协同作用。实验还分辨出相邻节点对应的两个 p 波束缚态，显示出亚纳米级空间分辨能力，并表明主量子数可作为调控分子束缚的量子开关。
authors: Qing Li, Shi-Yao Shao, Jun Zhang, Han-Chao Chen, Li-Hua Zhang, Bang Liu, Guang-Can Guo, Dong-Sheng Ding, Bao-Sen Shi

articles.title: Coupled-Layer Codes: Beyond Quantum Product Constructions
articles.title_zh: 耦合层码：超越量子乘积构造
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10069v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Product codes are an important class of quantum error-correcting codes constructed from multiple input codes, which can give rise to asymptotically good quantum low-density parity check codes. In previous work, we showed how the product between two codes can be physically implemented by coupling layers of the first code using checks of the second code. In this work, we further unify product code constructions with coupled-layer constructions of phases of matter by introducing coupled-layer codes. The essential strategy is to condense general excitations created by Pauli operators among multiple decoupled layers of the first code. The condensation is specified by an excitation algebra, which encodes the excitations, along with an algebra-preserving map. This coupling between layers generalizes the notion of gauging in physics as well as the mapping cone in homological algebra, and can be used to produce non-CSS codes. As examples, we show how coupled-layer codes reproduce the X-cube and Chamon models. We further generalize the balanced product code by allowing a unitary transformation in addition to a group action by free permutation and describe its corresponding coupled-layer construction. In particular, we show how balancing by a ZX-duality can reproduce non-CSS codes such as the fermionic toric code and the 3-fermion Walker-Wang model in 3D.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出“耦合层码”，将量子乘积码构造与物质量子相的耦合层构造统一起来。其基本思想是在多个解耦的第一类码层之间凝聚由 Pauli 算符产生的一般激发，凝聚规则由激发代数及其保代数映射指定。该框架推广了物理中的规范化与同调代数中的映射锥，可生成非 CSS 码，并能重现 X-cube 与 Chamon 模型，同时推广平衡乘积码构造。
authors: Shuyu Zhang, Tzu-Chieh Wei, Nathanan Tantivasadakarn

articles.title: Kinetics of sliding-window quantum error correction
articles.title_zh: 滑动窗口量子纠错的动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10081v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Practical implementations of quantum error correction (QEC) require rapid measurement and continuous processing of the syndrome information in order to prevent a backlog of unprocessed data. While ``static'' QEC is theoretically well understood via mappings to equilibrium statistical mechanics models, such an understanding of ``real-time'' QEC is currently lacking. Here, we study the kinetics of sliding window decoding (SWD), an implementation of real-time decoding that acts on temporally local windows of noisy syndrome information and commits to corrections irreversibly at a nonzero rate. We propose an effective description of SWD in terms of a stochastic kinetic process, where Z₂₋charged point particles undergo parity-conserving reaction and diffusion. This model describes dynamics at length and time scales large compared to the window size W, whereas physics at scales smaller than W leads to nontrivial W-dependent scaling of the effective parameters. We identify the rate of decoding 1/W as a relevant perturbation to the decodable phase. We also show broad applicability of our results by changing many microscopic details of SWD without affecting the effective description.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究实时量子纠错中滑动窗口解码的动力学，其中解码器只处理时间局域的带噪综合信息，并以非零速率不可逆地提交纠正。作者提出有效随机动力学描述：带 Z₂ 荷的点粒子发生守奇偶的反应与扩散，可刻画大于窗口尺寸 W 的长尺度行为。研究表明解码速率 1/W 是可解码相中的相关扰动，而小于 W 的微观过程会导致有效参数具有非平凡的 W 依赖标度；结论对多种滑动窗口解码细节具有普适性。
authors: Adithya Sriram, Charles Stahl, Aleksander Kubica, Yaodong Li

articles.title: Bounds for Apparent Second-Law Violations in Quantum Trajectories
articles.title_zh: 量子轨迹中表观第二定律违背的界限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10118v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Negative stochastic entropy production is commonly called an apparent violation of the second law. In general quantum-trajectory dynamics, however, the physical entropy production σ need not obey a forward detailed fluctuation theorem. A general arbitrary-coupling formulation identifies a dynamical-asymmetry term σ^ast that completes it into Ømega=σ+σ^ast, whose mean is łangleØmegaångle=Σ+Σ^ast. We prove that the likelihood-ratio sign is optimal among reversal-odd trajectory observables and use this fact to transfer an established sharp fluctuation-theorem floor to the tie-corrected physical sign statistic Π_σ=Pr(σ<0)+Pr(σ=0)/2. When Pr(σ=0)=0, the result reads Pr(σ<0)ge[1-łangleØmegaångle/g(łangleØmegaångle)]/2, where g is the inverse of amapsto atanh(a/2). The physical integral fluctuation theorem simultaneously suppresses large negative events, producing a quantitative ``frequent but mild'' law, while the sign imbalance lower-bounds the hidden mean Σ^ast. We formulate the measured-record protocol explicitly and illustrate and numerically audit the tie-corrected theorem in random finite-coupling collision models and a coherently driven qubit interacting with thermal ancillas.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文讨论量子轨迹动力学中随机熵产生为负的“表观第二定律违背”。作者指出一般量子轨迹的物理熵产生 σ 不必满足正向详细涨落定理，引入动力学不对称项 σ^ast 后，组合量 Ω=σ+σ^ast 才满足相应结构。论文证明似然比符号在反演奇的轨迹观测量中最优，并由此给出负熵产生概率的严格下界，同时说明物理积分涨落定理抑制大幅负事件，形成“频繁但温和”的违背规律。

articles.title: Spin Rotatory Strength as the Equilibrium Observable for Chiral-Induced Spin Selectivity
articles.title_zh: 作为手性诱导自旋选择性平衡观测量的自旋旋光强度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10697v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We identify the spin rotatory strength---a chirality-odd, finite-frequency spin--dipole cross response---as the equilibrium observable for chiral-induced spin selectivity. Time-reversal symmetry forces the static response to vanish, while nonzero SU(2) Wilson-loop flux is an independent necessary condition. Exact diagonalization of a Kane--Mele--Hubbard model (N=4,6,8) reveals that gapped molecules robustly suppress the response, whereas near-degenerate systems show amplification at small N whose persistence at larger sizes remains open.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出自旋旋光强度——一种手性奇、有限频率的自旋—偶极交叉响应——可作为手性诱导自旋选择性的平衡观测量。时间反演对称性要求静态响应为零，而非零 SU(2) Wilson 环通量是另一个独立必要条件。对 Kane–Mele–Hubbard 模型的小尺寸精确对角化显示，有能隙分子会显著抑制该响应，而近简并体系在小尺寸下可出现增强，其在更大体系中的持续性仍待确定。

articles.title: Impact of strain and dark states on spectroscopic measurements of silicon-vacancy centers in diamond
articles.title_zh: 应变与暗态对金刚石硅空位中心光谱测量的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11168v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Negatively charged silicon-vacancy (SiV⁻⁾ centers in diamond offer an attractive platform for the development of many forms of quantum technology. However, questions remain in connection to how large ensembles of SiV⁻ centers behave in concert. Here, we develop a computational model designed to simulate recent experiments where optical multidimensional coherent spectroscopy (MDCS) was used to examine a high-concentration sample of SiV⁻ centers in diamond, revealing significant variations in spectral signature depending on the detection scheme. Simulation results reveal that strain effects are highly random in this system, with a characteristic axial strain of 2.8 × 10⁻⁴ and a shear strain of 3.5 × 10⁻⁵. They suggest in addition that highly strained centers (with values exceeding 1.5 × 10⁻⁵) may become significantly decoupled from optical emission. The results have implications for the use of SiV⁻ centers as quantum sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作建立计算模型，用于模拟光学多维相干光谱实验中高浓度金刚石负电硅空位中心集合的谱响应，并解释不同探测方案下谱特征的显著差异。模拟表明体系中的应变高度随机，特征轴向应变约为 2.8 × 10⁻⁴，剪切应变约为 3.5 × 10⁻⁵。结果还提示强应变中心可能与光发射显著解耦，这对将 SiV⁻ 中心用于量子传感具有重要影响。
authors: Tommy Chin, Kesav V. Narayan, Imran Bashir, Kelsey M. Bates, Liam G. Stanton, Ehsan Khatami, Christopher L. Smallwood

articles.title: Work distribution for strongly coupled many-body open quantum systems
articles.title_zh: 强耦合多体开放量子系统的功分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11196v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The non-equilibrium quantum thermodynamics of many-body open systems is notoriously rich, especially in the strong-coupling regime where strong system-bath correlations develop and interactions produce non-perturbative effects. Such systems can be described by `quantum impurity models' where the system and bath are treated on an equal footing as a single composite. Paradigmatic examples are the spin-boson and Anderson impurity models, in which system degrees of freedom interact with either bosonic or fermionic gapless baths. Here we study the quantum work distribution function (WDF) of such systems following a quench. Capturing the full continuum of many-body excitations in the WDF requires a non-perturbative solution of the underlying non-equilibrium quantum impurity problem. For this purpose, we extend the time-dependent numerical renormalization group (TDNRG) approach to the calculation of the WDF, which applies directly in the thermodynamic limit, can be used for arbitrary quench amplitudes at zero or finite temperature, and provides exponentially fine low-energy resolution. Our numerically-exact solution reveals power-law threshold behavior due to the Anderson orthogonality catastrophe when the work approaches its minimum value, with universal scaling collapse of the distribution below an emergent low-energy scale induced by system-bath correlations.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究强耦合多体开放量子系统在淬火后的量子功分布函数，这类系统可用系统与浴等价处理的量子杂质模型描述，如自旋玻色子模型和 Anderson 杂质模型。为捕捉功分布中连续多体激发，论文将含时数值重整化群方法扩展到功分布计算，可在热力学极限、任意淬火幅度及零温/有限温下非微扰求解，并提供低能指数级精细分辨率。数值精确结果揭示了功分布阈值附近的幂律奇异等强关联非平衡特征。
authors: H. T. M. Nghiem, T. A. Costi, S. Campbell, A. K. Mitchell

articles.title: Constraints from global symmetries of quantum ice on the planar pyrochlore lattice
articles.title_zh: 平面烧绿石晶格量子冰的全局对称性约束
articles.abstract: arXiv:2306.02522v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study the low energy effective theory of spin-1/2 quantum ice on the planar pyrochlore lattice from the perspective of its global symmetries. We show that the Fourier transform of the spin operator, SzQ, can be expressed in terms of conserved quantities associated with a 1-form U(1) symmetry along two high-symmetry momentum paths, leading to constraints on both the static and dynamical structure factors. We also derive Lieb-Schultz-Mattis type constraints that forbid the existence of a unique gapped ground state in the low energy effective theory. Our findings also apply to the (2+1) dimensional U(1) quantum link model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文从全局对称性角度研究平面烧绿石晶格上自旋 1/2 量子冰的低能有效理论。作者证明，在两条高对称动量路径上，自旋算符傅里叶分量 SzQ 可表示为与 1-形式 U(1) 对称性相关的守恒量，从而约束静态与动力学结构因子。论文还推导了 Lieb–Schultz–Mattis 型约束，排除低能有效理论中唯一有能隙基态的存在；相关结论同样适用于 2+1 维 U(1) 量子链路模型。

articles.title: Emergent spacetime supersymmetry in an interacting Kitaev chain with explicit supersymmetry
articles.title_zh: 具有显式超对称的相互作用 Kitaev 链中的涌现时空超对称
articles.abstract: arXiv:2410.13354v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the emergence of spacetime supersymmetry (SUSY) in an interacting Kitaev chain model with explicit microscopic N=1 quantum mechanical SUSY. As the interaction strength is varied, the model transitions from a weak-coupling gapless phase with spontaneously broken SUSY to a strong-coupling phase with restored SUSY. In this paper, we numerically determine the transition point and investigate the phase structure around it. The weak-coupling phase is governed by the Ising conformal field theory (CFT) with central charge c=1/2, which agrees with the prediction made in our previous paper. At the SUSY restoration transition, which borders the strong-coupling gapped phase, the transition belongs to the c=7/10 tricritical Ising universality with emergent superconformal invariance. Crucially, the phase structure around the transition closely aligns with the scenario proposed by Zamolodchikov and others based on the integrable deformation of CFTs. These findings provide a concrete example of a lattice model where explicit microscopic supersymmetry at criticality enriches the understanding of phase transitions governed by supersymmetric conformal field theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究带显式微观 N=1 量子力学超对称的相互作用 Kitaev 链中时空超对称的涌现。随相互作用增强，模型从弱耦合、超对称自发破缺的无能隙相转变到强耦合、超对称恢复的相；数值结果确定了转变点并分析其邻域相结构。弱耦合相由中心荷 c=1/2 的 Ising 共形场论支配，而超对称恢复转变属于 c=7/10 的三临界 Ising 普适类并涌现超共形不变性，符合基于可积 CFT 微扰的理论图景。

articles.title: Dissipative Generation of Currents by Nonreciprocal Local and Global Environments
articles.title_zh: 非互易局域与全局环境的耗散电流产生
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.07498v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the mechanisms necessary for the stabilization of complex quantum correlations by exploring dissipative couplings to nonreciprocal reservoirs. We analyze the role of locality in the coupling between the environment and the quantum system of interest, as we consider either local couplings throughout the system, or a single global coupling. We contrast the results obtained for the two scenarios in which a chain of strongly interacting hardcore bosonic atoms is coupled directly to Markovian kinetic dissipative processes, or experiences effective dissipation through the mediation of the field of a lossy optical cavity. To investigate the dissipative dynamics of the many-body quantum systems considered we perform numerical simulations employing matrix product states methods. We show that by coupling atomic tunneling terms to the global field of a dissipative cavity we can stabilize at long times both finite currents and current-current correlations throughout the atomic chain. This is in contrast to the setup in which dissipation acts directly via local tunneling processes, where currents arise in a narrow region of the system and the current-current correlations are rapidly decaying.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究通过耦合非互易库来稳定复杂量子关联所需的机制，重点比较环境—系统耦合的局域性：全链局域耦合与单一全局耦合。作者以强相互作用硬核玻色原子链为例，对比直接马尔可夫动能耗散与由有损光学腔场介导的有效耗散，并用矩阵乘积态模拟多体耗散动力学。结果表明，将原子隧穿项耦合到耗散腔的全局场可在长时间稳定有限电流及全链电流—电流关联，而局域隧穿耗散只在较窄区域内诱导电流。

articles.title: High-Temperature Quantum Oscillations of a Non-equilibrium Non-Fermi Liquid
articles.title_zh: 非平衡非费米液体的高温量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.21763v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A periodically driven Fermi gas coupled to a simple boson bath reaches a non-equilibrium steady-state occupation with sharp non-analyticities at certain momenta. Here, we demonstrate that these non-analyticities behave as emergent Fermi surfaces by showing that they give rise to quantum oscillations of observables with a period controlled by the effective Fermi surface area enclosed by these non-analyticities. However, these oscillations have several striking differences with standard equilibrium quantum oscillations. For example, they remain non-analytic at finite temperatures, their amplitude can survive up to extremely high temperatures comparable to the frequency of the drive, and they can display non-monotonic temperature dependence completely at odds with standard Lifshits-Kosevich behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 周期驱动费米气体与简单玻色浴耦合后可形成非平衡稳态分布，并在特定动量处出现尖锐非解析结构。作者证明这些非解析点类似涌现费米面，会导致观测量的量子振荡，其周期由这些结构围成的有效费米面面积控制。与平衡量子振荡不同，该振荡在有限温度下仍保持非解析，振幅可持续到与驱动频率相当的高温，并可能呈现不符合 Lifshitz-Kosevich 规律的非单调温度依赖。
authors: Oles Matsyshyn, Li-kun Shi, Inti Sodemann Villadiego

articles.title: Thermalization in a closed quantum system from randomized dynamics
articles.title_zh: 随机化动力学导致的闭合量子系统热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00056v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The emergence of statistical mechanics from quantum dynamics is conventionally understood through quantum chaos, the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH), and canonical typicality, which together explain the thermal behavior of local observables in quantum many-body systems. We provide a distinct mechanism in which, for a quantum many-body system under strong random perturbation, the chaotic behavior of the system's eigenvectors and a constraint on the total energy directly generate a canonical ensemble for the entire system. The canonical ensemble occurs as the first moment of the Porter-Thomas distribution of the system's chaotic eigenstates, and the constraint on the total energy sets the temperature in the ensemble. This yields canonically distributed expectation values without invoking ETH, a microcanonical ensemble, or a subsystem-bath partition for local and global observables. We numerically demonstrate the mechanism for the 1D transverse-field Ising model by showing canonically distributed eigenstate projectors and spin-spin correlators with distinctive temperature dependence of the correlation length. An implementation of this thermalization approach on a quantum computer can be utilized for thermal state preparation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种不同于量子混沌、ETH 与典型性叙事的热化机制：在强随机扰动下，多体系统混沌本征矢与总能量约束可直接为整个系统生成正则系综。正则分布来自混沌本征态 Porter-Thomas 分布的一阶矩，而能量约束决定温度，无需引入微正则系综、ETH 或子系统—热浴划分。作者在一维横场 Ising 模型中数值展示了本征态投影算符和自旋关联函数的正则分布及其特征温度依赖。
authors: Nikolay V. Gnezdilov, Andrei I. Pavlov

articles.title: Fast and robust cat state preparation utilizing higher order nonlinearities in Rydberg ensembles
articles.title_zh: 利用里德堡系综高阶非线性快速且鲁棒地制备猫态
articles.abstract: arXiv:2312.05218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In optical and solid-state architectures, low-order nonlinearities are commonly exploited for quantum state preparation due to their practical accessibility and controllability, while higher-order contributions are typically much weaker and treated as unwanted perturbations. Here, we alternatively show that detuned Rydberg ensembles provide a natural platform where higher-order Kerr nonlinearities can become comparable in strength to lower-orders near multiphoton resonances. We demonstrate that these nonlinearities can be harnessed as a resource for the rapid preparation of non-Gaussian states, with the coexistence of multiple Kerr orders substantially accelerating the evolution of an initial coherent state into Schrödinger cat states. Furthermore, by combining the nonlinear dynamics with a controllable linear drive, we can gain the full control over the evolution trajectory, thereby achieving cat-state generation directly from vacuum on timescales beyond the genuine Kerr evolution. Our results establish a paradigm in which naturally occurring higher-order nonlinearities are transformed from unwanted imperfections into a valuable resource for quantum state engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作指出，在失谐里德堡系综中，靠近多光子共振时高阶 Kerr 非线性可与低阶项强度相当，而不只是微弱扰动。作者展示这些高阶非线性可作为资源，加速初始相干态向薛定谔猫态的非高斯演化；多阶 Kerr 项共存显著缩短制备时间。进一步结合可控线性驱动，可调控演化轨迹，实现从真空直接生成猫态，并突破纯 Kerr 演化的时间尺度限制。
authors: S. Zhao, M. G. Krauss, T. Bienaime, S. Whitlock, C. P. Koch, S. Qvarfort, A. Metelmann

articles.title: Quantifying mixed-state entanglement via partial transpose and realignment moments
articles.title_zh: 通过部分转置矩与重排矩量化混态纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.13840v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Entanglement plays a crucial role in quantum information science and many-body physics, yet quantifying it in mixed quantum many-body systems has remained a notoriously difficult problem. Here, we introduce families of quantitative entanglement witnesses, constructed from partial transpose and realignment moments, which provide rigorous bounds on entanglement monotones as well as entanglement dimensionality. Our witnesses can be efficiently measured using SWAP tests or variants of Bell measurements, thus making them directly implementable on current hardware. Leveraging our witnesses, we present several novel results on entanglement properties of mixed states, both in quantum information and many-body physics. We develop efficient algorithms to test whether mixed states with bounded entropy have low or high entanglement, which previously was only possible for pure states. We also provide an efficient algorithm to test the Schmidt rank using only two-copy measurements, and the operator Schmidt rank using four-copy measurements. Further, our witnesses robustly certify the quantum circuit depth in the presence of noise, as well as the Schmidt rank of mixed states. Finally, we show that the entanglement phase diagram of Haar random states, quantified by the partial transpose negativity, can be fully established solely by computing our witness, a result that also applies to any state 4-design. Our witnesses can also be efficiently computed for matrix product states, thus enabling the characterization of entanglement in extensive many-body systems. Finally, we make progress on the entanglement required for quantum cryptography, establishing rigorous limits on pseudoentanglement and pseudorandom density matrices with bounded entropy. Our work opens new avenues for quantifying entanglement in large and noisy quantum systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作构造了基于部分转置矩和重排矩的一族定量纠缠见证，可严格给出纠缠单调量和纠缠维数的界。此类见证可通过 SWAP 测试或 Bell 测量变体高效测量，适用于当前量子硬件。作者进一步给出针对有界熵混态的低/高纠缠判定算法、基于两份拷贝测量的 Schmidt 秩测试和基于四份拷贝测量的算符 Schmidt 秩测试，并说明这些见证可在噪声下鲁棒认证量子线路深度。

articles.title: Dissipation stabilizes Dicke Time Quasicrystals
articles.title_zh: 耗散稳定 Dicke 时间准晶
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.05994v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Quasi-periodic driving protocols provide a powerful route to realize novel non-equilibrium phases of matter beyond the Floquet paradigm. However, these protocols inevitably lead to infinite-temperature heat death in isolated systems, which poses a major challenge to their experimental realization. We demonstrate that dissipation can be harnessed to stabilize quasi-periodically driven systems, enabling the realization of robust non-equilibrium phases. Using the paradigmatic open Dicke model, we provide a blueprint for realizing a stable time quasicrystal (TQC) by Fibonacci driving. This TQC is characterized by a robust sub-harmonic quasi-periodic response that is dictated by, but qualitatively distinct from the external Fibonacci drive. By directly analyzing the time evolution in the thermodynamic limit, we establish the existence of TQC order in this system for a wide parameter regime. We trace the origin of the stability of the TQC to the attractor structure induced by dissipation. Strikingly, the TQC order persists in the deep quantum regime with as few as two qubits. We systematically study the dependence of the TQC lifetime, τast, on the number of qubits and demonstrate that τast increases monotonically with the system size. Crucially, the TQC is not observed in the absence of dissipation. Our work establishes dissipation as a mechanism for stabilizing non-equilibrium phases of matter under quasi-periodic drive.
articles.abstract_zh: 准周期驱动可实现超越 Floquet 范式的非平衡相，但孤立系统中通常会走向无限温热死亡。该工作表明耗散可用于稳定准周期驱动体系，并以开放 Dicke 模型给出通过 Fibonacci 驱动实现稳定时间准晶的方案。该时间准晶表现出鲁棒的亚谐准周期响应，其形式受外部 Fibonacci 驱动支配但与之定性不同；作者将其稳定性归因于耗散诱导的吸引子结构，并指出即使在少至两个量子比特的深量子区域中该序仍可存在。
authors: Sk Anisur, Shuva Mondal, Tanaya Ray, Sayan Choudhury

articles.title: Controlling emergent dynamical behavior via phase-engineered strong symmetries
articles.title_zh: 通过相位工程强对称性控制涌现动力学行为
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.18563v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Symmetry constraints provide a powerful means to control the dynamics of open quantum systems. However, the set of accessible control parameters is often limited. Here, we show that a tunable phase in the collective light-matter coupling of a cavity QED system induces a phase-dependent strong symmetry of the Liouvillian, enabling dynamical control of the open quantum system evolution. We demonstrate that tuning this phase substantially reduces the critical driving strength for dissipative phase transitions between stationary and non-stationary phases. We illustrate this mechanism in two experimentally relevant cavity QED settings: a two-species ensemble of two-level atoms and a single-species ensemble of three-level atoms. Our results establish phase control as a versatile tool for engineering dissipative phase transitions, with implications for quantum state preparation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究开放量子系统中由对称性约束实现动力学控制的机制，提出腔 QED 系统集体光—物质耦合中的可调相位可诱导 Liouvillian 的相位依赖强对称性。调节该相位能够显著降低平稳相与非平稳相之间耗散相变的临界驱动强度。作者在两种实验相关体系中展示该机制：双组分二能级原子系综和单组分三能级原子系综，表明相位控制可作为工程化耗散相变与量子态制备的通用工具。
authors: Marc Nairn, Beatriz Olmos, Parvinder Solanki

articles.title: Dispersion Control of Chiral Exciton-Polariton Transport with Dielectric Metasurfaces
articles.title_zh: 利用介电超表面调控手性激子-极化激元输运的色散
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10558v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Exciton-polaritons provide a powerful platform for manipulating hybrid light-matter states with low effective masses and strong nonlinearities. Introducing chirality into these quasiparticles enables selective control over their spin and propagation, opening new opportunities for chiral transport and spin-selective polaritonic devices. We exploit the strong chiral light-matter coupling in silicon metasurfaces composed of tilted nanorod dimers to demonstrate selective transport of organic chiral exciton-polaritons. The metasurface supports surface lattice resonances and quasi-bound states in the continuum that simultaneously provide high photonic confinement and extrinsic chirality, giving rise to chiral exciton-polaritons in the achiral molecules. These exciton-polaritons exhibit a large magnitude of the dissymmetry factor, reaching a value of 0.93. Using photoluminescence Fourier microscopy and real-space imaging, we show that chiral exciton-polaritons propagate over distances exceeding 50 um without significant degradation of their dissymmetry, with characteristic propagation lengths of approximately 6-13 um. These propagation lengths correspond to an enhancement of 3 orders of magnitude compared to bare excitons. This work constitutes the first demonstration of enhanced and selective chiral transport of organic exciton-polaritons, driven by strong light-matter coupling, in achiral metasurfaces, paving the way for spin-selective polaritonic technologies using simple metasurfaces.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用由倾斜纳米棒二聚体构成的硅超表面中的强手性光—物质耦合，实现有机手性激子-极化激元的选择性输运。该超表面同时支持表面晶格共振和准连续域束缚态，提供高光场限域与外禀手性，并能在非手性分子中诱导手性激子-极化激元。实验显示其不对称因子最高达 0.93，极化激元可传播超过 50 μm 且手性退化不显著，特征传播长度约为 6–13 μm。
authors: Juhyeong Jeon, Kehan Wang, Yu-Chen Wei, Francesca Cussiol, Matthijs Berghuis, Fan Xu, Shunsuke Murai, E. W. Meijer, Jaime Gómez Rivas

articles.title: Strong, Mode-Selective Evxciton-Photon Coupling Driven by Polariton Scattering in the Mo2 Complexes at Ambient Conditions
articles.title_zh: 常温下 Mo2 配合物中由极化激元散射驱动的强且模式选择性激子-光子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10652v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quadruply bonded Mo2 complexes provide a distinctive molecular platform in which multiple two-level electronic transitions interact with quantized scattering modes under ambient conditions. Here we show that, in the Mo2 complexes, the intrinsic photonic modes selectively couple to molecular excitations, including the characteristic delta-delta(star), ligand to metal charge transfer (LMCT) and metal to ligand charge transfer (MLCT) transitions, to form the well-resolved exciton-photon hybrid states. By combining steady-state absorption, resonance fluorescence, and ultrafast transient spectroscopies, we identify distinct polaritonic branches associated with these electronic manifolds, with coupling strengths spanning the strong and ultrastrong regimes (g/omega0 up to 0.1). Mode-selective coupling accounts for the pronounced spectral reorganization for the singly oxidized complexes, including the emergence of absorption valleys and sidebands of the associated resonances in the steady-state spectra, characteristic polaritonic emissions in the photoluminescence spectra, and long-lived low-energy hybrid states in the transient spectra. These results support the picture that the Mo2 unit functions as an integrated molecular resonator whose intrinsic quantized field selectively drives and redistributes molecular excitations. This work strengthens the emerging view of bonded dimetal complexes as ambient-condition molecular quantum systems and provides a chemically defined platform for exploring polaritonic chemistry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究四重键 Mo2 配合物中多个二能级电子跃迁与量子化散射模式在常温下的耦合。通过稳态吸收、共振荧光和超快瞬态光谱，作者识别出与 δ-δ*、配体到金属电荷转移和金属到配体电荷转移跃迁相关的不同极化激元分支，耦合强度覆盖强耦合至超强耦合范围，g/ω0 最高约 0.1。模式选择性耦合解释了单氧化配合物中明显的谱重构，包括吸收谷、共振边带、特征极化激元发光以及瞬态谱中的长寿命低能杂化态。
authors: Miao Meng, Ying Ning Tan, Zi Cong He, Yuli Zhou, Chun Y. Liu

articles.title: Quantum Theory of Third-harmonic Generation in Epsilon-Near-Zero Materials
articles.title_zh: 近零介电常数材料中三次谐波产生的量子理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10794v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a theoretical framework, based on the Green's tensor quantization method, to describe third-harmonic generation in epsilon-near-zero (ENZ) materials and derive analytical, closed-form solutions for the generation efficiency. We validate our model against experimental measurements of wavelength- and angle-resolved third-harmonic generation efficiency from 30 nm-thin ITO nanolayers at low pump intensity, described under the undepleted pump approximation. Our results provide a local and scalar effective model for quantum nonlinear processes in dispersive and lossy ENZ media, and establishes a simple and reliable framework for investigating a variety of nonlinear optical phenomena with applications to quantum sensing, quantum information, and quantum nondemolition measurements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作基于格林张量量子化方法，建立描述近零介电常数材料中三次谐波产生的理论框架，并推导生成效率的解析闭式表达。作者用 30 nm 厚 ITO 纳米层在低泵浦强度下的波长和角度分辨三次谐波效率实验验证模型，采用未耗尽泵浦近似。该理论为色散、损耗 ENZ 介质中的量子非线性过程提供局域标量有效模型，可用于研究量子传感、量子信息和量子非破坏测量相关的非线性光学现象。
authors: Sonia Alipour, Riccardo Franchi, Tornike Shubitidze, Smridhi Chawla, Luca Dal Negro, Marco Ornigotti

articles.title: High-dimensional Supermode Photonics Enabled by Hierarchical Supersymmetric Transformation
articles.title_zh: 层级超对称变换实现的高维超模光子学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.11099v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Modes provide a fundamental degree of freedom for photonic information processing, yet conventional multimode waveguides exhibit non-equidistant effective-index distributions, making closely spaced modes vulnerable to intermodal crosstalk. Supermode photonics can overcome this limitation by geometrically engineering coupled waveguide arrays to realize large and equidistant effective-index spacing, but precise supermode excitation and detection remain challenging at the subwavelength scale. Here, we report a hierarchical second-order discrete supersymmetric (DSUSY) transformation method that enables high-purity excitation and extraction of arbitrary target supermodes in a compact and scalable architecture. We experimentally demonstrate six-supermode multiplexing systems on silicon-on-insulator and silicon nitride platforms. Benefiting from the large supermode index spacing and the isospectrality of DSUSY transformations, the fabricated devices exhibit low insertion losses (<2.6 dB) and intermodal crosstalk (<-11.1 dB) for all channels over a 100-nm wavelength range. A high-speed transmission experiment on the silicon device achieves an aggregate data rate of 1.2 Tbit/s, with all channel bit error rates below the 7% hard-decision forward-error-correction threshold. The method can further support polarization-insensitive architectures, enabling compact polarization-supermode hybrid multiplexing.This work provides a scalable route toward high-dimensional supermode photonics for high-capacity optical interconnects, highly parallel AI optical computing, and high-dimensional quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出层级二阶离散超对称变换方法，用于在紧凑可扩展结构中高纯度激发与提取任意目标超模。作者在绝缘体上硅和氮化硅平台上实验演示了六超模复用系统；得益于较大的超模有效折射率间隔和超对称变换的等谱性，器件在 100 nm 波长范围内实现低插入损耗（小于 2.6 dB）和低模间串扰（小于 -11.1 dB）。该方法为高维片上光子信息处理和模式复用提供了可扩展路径。
authors: Yuan Zhong, Kaile Chen, Qi Lu, Chunxue Wang, Jingchi Li, Yuru Li, Zhaohui Li, Chao Lu, Xinchen Ji, Yikai Su, Lu Sun

articles.title: Private Correlations Certify Sensing Capability
articles.title_zh: 私有关联认证传感能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2608.10377v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that private correlations in a bipartite quantum state constitute a metrological resource for distributed sensing assisted by a possibly noisy channel from one party to the other. We begin with an example with distillable secret key but poor locally accessible sensing performance and show that an assisting channel substantially improves its performance. We then prove a general theorem showing that positive private information in the encoding basis certifies a quantitative lower bound on the locally accessible sensing capability after assistance. We further show that classical correlations alone provide no analogous guarantee, whereas, in the absence of the assisting subsystem, the privacy-based guarantee reduces to an entanglement-based one. Finally, in a channel formulation, we show that a channel with positive private information allows nonzero locally accessible sensitivity when paired with a suitable assisting channel.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作证明，二分量子态中的私有关联可作为一种分布式传感计量资源，尤其是在一方到另一方存在可能含噪的辅助信道时。作者先给出具有可蒸馏密钥但局域可访问传感性能较差的例子，并说明辅助信道可显著提升其性能。随后证明一般定理：编码基中的正私有信息可为辅助后的局域可访问传感能力给出定量下界；纯经典关联不提供类似保证，而在无辅助子系统时该保证退化为基于纠缠的保证。
authors: Yunkai Wang, Peixue Wu, Graeme Smith, Sisi Zhou

articles.title: Long-Range Blockade Between Counter-Propagating Photons
articles.title_zh: 反向传播光子之间的长程阻塞
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.01124v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Realizing strong interactions between individual photons, mediated by matter, is a cornerstone for advancing photonic quantum computing and quantum nonlinear optics. In such systems, the interaction range is typically limited by the narrow bandwidth of the material excitation, resulting in a tradeoff between interaction strength and pulse duration. Here, we address this limitation by exploring interactions between counter-propagating photons mediated by Rydberg polaritons. We experimentally demonstrate strong photon-photon interactions, achieving a record-long anti-correlation range exceeding 1~μ s. This extended range enables photon pulses that are long enough to fit within the polariton bandwidth, yet short enough to remain within the interaction range. Under these conditions, we observe complete photon blockade of entire pulses, tunable via their relative timing. Extending to the three-photon regime, we observe enhanced interactions when a photon encounters a counter-propagating pair. These results, supported by analytical theory and numerical simulations, establish counter-propagating Rydberg polaritons as a powerful platform for engineering interactions in quantum light fields, enabling deterministic photonic operations and opening new directions in few-photon quantum dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究由里德堡极化激元介导的反向传播光子相互作用，旨在突破材料激发带宽对相互作用范围的限制。实验实现了超过 1 微秒的超长反关联范围，使得光子脉冲既能落入极化激元带宽，又能保持在相互作用范围内。作者观察到整段脉冲的完全光子阻塞，并展示其可通过相对时序调控；在三光子情形下也观测到增强相互作用。
authors: Bankim Chandra Das, Ashley Harkavi, Aditya Prakash, Ariel Nakav, Lee Drori, Ofer Firstenberg

articles.title_zh: 利用对称性适配的 Wannier 哈密顿量与多极展开对面内反常霍尔效应的第一性原理分析
articles.abstract: Author(s): Hiroto Saito and Takashi Koretsune The in-plane anomalous Hall effect occurs when the magnetization lies within the same plane as the electric field and the Hall current, and requires magnetic point groups lacking rotational or mirror symmetries. While it is observed in both Weyl semimetals and elemental ferromagnets, the microscopic… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 084410] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从第一性原理出发，研究磁化、电场与霍尔电流位于同一平面时的面内反常霍尔效应。作者结合对称性适配的 Wannier 哈密顿量与多极展开方法，分析该效应的微观来源及其与磁点群对称性的关系。工作为理解无转轴或镜面对称破缺体系中的面内霍尔响应提供了统一框架。

articles.title: Ferroelectricity-driven antiferromagnetism in a Ti-intercalated NbS₂ bilayer
articles.title_zh: Ti 插层 NbS₂ 双层中的铁电驱动反铁磁性

Here we propose a type-III multiferroics, where antiferromagnetism is driven by ferroelectric polarization, providi… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125410] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种由铁电极化驱动反铁磁性的 III 型多铁体系，研究对象为 Ti 插层的 NbS₂ 双层。作者表明，极化翻转可调控反铁磁有序，从而为电场控制磁性提供新的材料平台。该结果对低成本、高密度自旋电子器件具有潜在意义。

articles.title_zh: p 波磁体中的非相对论 Ising 超导性
articles.abstract: Author(s): M. Khodas, Libor Šmejkal, and I. I. Mazin We discuss a possibility of superconductivity in the p-wave magnets. These are recently discovered materials that have zero net magnetization by symmetry and finite nonrelativistic spin splitting of electron bands, like in altermagnets. Similarly, the spin polarizations are collinear in the moment… [Phys. Rev. B 114, L080505] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论了 p 波磁体中超导出现的可能性，这类材料具有由对称性保护的零净磁化和有限的非相对论自旋分裂。作者指出，其自旋极化呈共线结构，类似于近年受到关注的交替磁体。研究表明，这类磁体可能支持 Ising 型超导行为，并为非常规超导与自旋分裂磁体的关联提供新的理论视角。

We derive a new analytical expression for the gyration coefficients within the recent fr… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125108] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026

Particularly, we consider the ground state of a one-dimensional spin-1/2 system with next-nearest-neighbor exchange interactions (K), which shows an analogous phase transition to DQCP in… [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125109] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作数值研究了弱测量对去禁闭量子临界点基态纠缠性质的影响。作者以含次近邻交换相互作用的一维自旋 1/2 系统为例，考察其与 DQCP 类似的相变背景下，测量如何诱导方向不对称的纠缠结构。结果表明，测量过程可显著改变量子关联的分布特征。

Here, we investigate the non-Hermitian strong coupling of pure multipolar resonances with two-dimensional excitons … [Phys. Rev. B 114, 125307] Published Wed Aug 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究局域纳米腔中纯多极共振与二维激子的强光-物质耦合问题，重点关注背景散射干扰下的非厄米行为。作者分析了核壳异质结构中的多极模与激子耦合特征，揭示了纯多极共振实现强耦合的条件。该研究为在复杂纳米光子体系中实现可控量子光学相互作用提供了思路。
